https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.body: ABUJA — President of the Senate, Senator Godswill Akpabio, has expressed confidence that Akwa Ibom State will deliver the highest number of votes for President Bola Tinubu in the South-South region in the 2027 presidential election. Akpabio made the declaration on Sunday during a special church service at the International Christian Worship Centre, Uyo, organised to dedicate the All Progressives Congress (APC) 2027 election campaigns to God. In a statement by his Special Assistant on Media, Jackson Udom, the Senate President said Akwa Ibom indigenes, particularly APC members, must close ranks and present a united front to ensure the party’s success at the polls. He said the state had a responsibility to reciprocate the support President Tinubu had given him by mobilising votes for the President. According to him, the support of Tinubu contributed to his emergence as Senate President, making him the number three citizen in the country. “Whether you like him or not, he is there today. The only way to thank Mr President for that support is to give him all our votes. “From what I have seen here today, Akwa Ibom State will give Mr President the highest number of votes in the South-South region,” he said. In an address titled, “One Family, One Destiny, One Akwa Ibom Under God”, Akpabio said while the people acknowledged God’s sovereignty over their individual and collective destinies, they must also uphold righteousness, justice and mercy. He described Akwa Ibom as a Nigerian success story, attributing its progress to purposeful leadership, peace and development. The Senate President said development should not be measured only by roads and buildings but also by the bridges built between people and the hope restored in their lives. He urged political leaders and party members to sustain the state’s progress and ensure that its future achievements surpassed those already recorded. On party unity, Akpabio cautioned against divisions between old and new members of the APC, insisting that all members should be treated equally. “In the APC family, there should be no aborigines and no newcomers; no landlords and no tenants; no first-class members and no second-class members. There should be only one big family, united by a common purpose and a shared responsibility,” he said. Using a biblical reference from John 14:2, he said there was room for everyone in the party, regardless of when they joined or their political standing. He added that political ambitions should not override the welfare of the people, urging party members to conduct their campaigns in ways that respect human dignity. Akpabio further said the development of Akwa Ibom was inseparable from the progress of Nigeria, stressing that the state could not remain indifferent to insecurity and hardship in other parts of the country. “Nigeria is not merely the nation to which Akwa Ibom belongs; it is the larger destiny to which Akwa Ibom contributes,” he said. Earlier, Governor Umo Eno thanked the people for their support during the last election and appealed for increased support for Tinubu, Akpabio, himself and other APC candidates in the 2027 elections. Eno also pledged to continue serving the people with the fear of God if given another mandate. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.title_zh: 2027年：阿克帕比奥预测蒂努布将在阿夸伊博姆获得最高南方选区票数
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.body_zh: 阿布贾——参议院议长戈德斯威尔·阿kpabio表示，他确信在2027年总统选举中，阿夸伊博姆州将在南南地区为博拉·蒂努布总统争取到最多选票。阿kpabio于周日在乌约国际基督教敬拜中心举行的特别礼拜活动上作出上述表态。此次活动旨在将全进步大会党（APC）2027年选举竞选活动献给上帝。参议院议长在接受其媒体特别助理杰克逊·乌多姆的声明中表示，阿夸伊博姆本地居民，尤其是APC成员，必须团结一致，形成统一阵线，以确保该党在选举中获胜。他说，该州有责任通过动员选票支持蒂努布总统，以回报蒂努布总统此前对他的支持。据他所说，蒂努布的支持促成了他成为参议院议长，使他成为尼日利亚国内地位第三高的公民。他说：“无论你喜欢他还是不喜欢他，他今天都在那里。报答总统先生这种支持的唯一方式，就是把我们的全部选票投给他。‘从今天我在这里看到的情况来看，阿夸伊博姆州将在南南地区为总统先生投出最多选票。’”在一篇题为《在上帝之下，一个家庭、一个命运、一个阿夸伊博姆》的讲话中，阿kpabio表示，尽管民众承认上帝主宰着他们个人和集体的命运，但他们也必须秉持正直、公正和怜悯。他把阿夸伊博姆描述为尼日利亚的一个成功范例，并将该州的进步归功于有明确目标的领导、和平与发展。参议院议长表示，衡量发展不能只看道路和建筑物，还要看人与人之间架起的桥梁，以及他们生活中重新燃起的希望。他敦促政治领导人和党内成员维持该州的发展势头，确保其未来成就超越已经取得的成果。在谈及党内团结时，阿kpabio警告不要在APC新老成员之间制造分裂，坚持所有成员都应受到平等对待。他说：“在APC这个大家庭里，不应有原住民和新来者，不应有房东和租客，也不应有一等成员和二等成员。这个大家庭应当只有一个，大家由共同的目标和共同的责任团结在一起。”他引用《约翰福音》14章2节指出，无论党员何时加入该党，也无论其政治地位如何，党内都有容纳每个人的空间。他补充说，政治野心不应凌驾于民众福祉之上，并敦促党内成员以尊重人的尊严的方式开展竞选活动。Akpabio还表示，阿夸伊博姆的发展与尼日利亚的进步密不可分，强调该州不能对尼日利亚其他地区的不安全状况和困境无动于衷。他说：“尼日利亚不仅仅是阿夸伊博姆所属的国家；它也是阿夸伊博姆为之作出贡献的更大命运。”此前，州长乌莫·埃诺感谢民众在上次选举期间给予的支持，并呼吁在2027年选举中进一步支持蒂努布、阿kpabio、他本人以及其他APC候选人。埃诺还承诺，如果再次获得授权，他将继续怀着对上帝的敬畏服务民众。此处发表的评论不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点

https://www.rfi.fr/fr/podcasts/le-grand-.summary_zh: 收听——05:33 在马里，自本周二起已有六个月。致力于捍卫民主的律师、前部长蒙塔加·塔尔在夜间被一群蒙面的国家安全部门人员从他家中绑架。他本人也是马里的民主捍卫者，十分了解蒙塔加·塔尔，因而对其命运表示担忧，并谴责马里过渡政权政治和司法当局的行为。但他既没有否定司法部门的专业能力，也没有无视国家的义务。
https://www.rfi.fr/fr/podcasts/le-grand-.body: Écouter - 05:33 Au Mali, cela fait six mois, ce mardi, que l’avocat et ancien ministre Mountaga Tall, engagé pour la défense de la démocratie, a été enlevé chez lui, de nuit, par des hommes encagoulés de la Sécurité d’État. C’était dans la nuit du 2 au 3 mai. Quelques jours après lui, les services maliens ont enlevé son fils, également détenu depuis dans un lieu inconnu en dehors de toute procédure légale. Malgré les démarches entreprises par les avocats de la famille, les autorités maliennes de transition demeurent silencieuses. Mamadou Ismaïla Konaté est avocat et ancien ministre malien de la Justice. Lui-même défenseur de la démocratie au Mali, il connaît bien Mountaga Tall, s’inquiète de son sort et dénonce le comportement des autorités politiques et judiciaires du régime malien de transition. Invité Afrique de RFI, Mamadou Ismaïla Konaté répond aux questions de David Baché. RFI : Six mois de détention, dans un lieu et dans des conditions inconnus, sans que personne n’ait pu lui rendre visite, ni famille, ni avocat, ni médecin… Faut-il s’inquiéter pour Mountaga Tall ? Mamadou Ismaïla Konaté : D'abord, en tout premier, je voudrais vous remercier de continuer à parler de Mountaga Tall. Il faut que sa situation reste dans le débat public. Sa famille a droit à des réponses. Je m'inquiète et, comme moi, des milliers de personnes s'inquiètent. Nous demandons depuis très longtemps une preuve de vie vérifiable, un contact avec ses avocats et un examen médical indépendant. La famille doit savoir où il est et les soins nécessaires doivent lui être garantis. Une privation de liberté doit avoir un fondement légal. Lorsque les agents de l'État, ou des personnes agissant avec son autorisation ou son acquiescement, privent quelqu'un de liberté puis refusent de reconnaître cette privation ou dissimulent son sort, la question de la disparition forcée se pose. Il faut immédiatement localiser Mountaga Tall et établir les responsabilités. Le silence ne peut pas tenir lieu de réponse dans son cas. Pourquoi le régime de transition s’en prend-il à Mountaga Tall ? Qu’est-ce qui pourrait lui être reproché ou que représente-t-il ? En premier, c'est un avocat et pas des moindres : le troisième qui est inscrit au tableau de l'ordre des avocats. En second, Mountaga Tall, toute sa vie durant, a milité, a été un acteur politique essentiel pour le 26 mars (1991, date du renversement de la dictature militaire du général Moussa Traoré, Ndlr) et l'avènement de la démocratie, l'ouverture démocratique et le libéralisme. Et Mountaga Tall, en tant que ministre, a eu une implication assez forte dans la vie politique du Mali. Avant, pendant et après son ministère, (jusqu’à, Ndlr) aujourd'hui. Tout le monde sait les opinions que Mountaga Tall a dû exprimer durant ce régime de transition militaire. Il s'est opposé justement au caractère précaire, incertain et dangereux de cette transition qui est sans fin. Quelques jours après Mountaga Tall, la Sécurité d’État a enlevé son propre fils, en lui proposant un rendez-vous pour donner des médicaments à son père. C’était un piège, Cheick Mamadou Tall n’est jamais revenu. Pourquoi les services maliens retiennent-ils également le fils de Mountaga Tall ? Le fils, personne ne lui connaît un rattachement politique et il n'a pas non plus exprimé d'opinion contraire à ce qui se passe au Mali. Simplement parce qu'il est le fils, c'est un moyen pour l’anéantir. C'est là l'expression, véritablement, de l'indignité de ce qui se passe en République du Mali aujourd'hui. Cela fait six mois de détention au secret. Les avocats de la famille de Mountaga Tall ont saisi la justice malienne et le comité des disparitions forcées des Nations unies, mais les autorités maliennes de transition refusent toujours de communiquer quoi que ce soit, elles restent mutiques. Dans quel but, selon vous ? La caractéristique essentielle des États autoritaires, des régimes militaires comme ceux que nous connaissons au Mali et ailleurs aujourd'hui, c'est de vivre en vase clos et de narguer tout le monde en face. D'abord, un : tout ce qui peut être représentation des Nations unies au plus haut sommet. Et deuxièmement, tout ce qui peut éventuellement représenter le droit et les cadres juridiques. C'est un silence qui empêche les familles de comprendre et rend la défense beaucoup plus difficile. Mais il n'efface ni la compétence de la justice, ni les obligations de l'État. Le procureur de la République, alerté, n'a pas cru devoir donner une suite. Le procureur général à la cour d'appel de Bamako encore moins. Et ne parlons pas du procureur général. Tous pensent peut-être que ce qui arrive à Mountaga Tall est tellement normal qu'il faut garder le silence. Ils oublient simplement que la vie de Mountaga est en danger, mais toutes les autres vies sont en danger, y compris celles des autorités qui représentent la justice aujourd'hui. Justement, quatre autres militants pro-démocratie avaient également disparu depuis mai dernier : Youssouf Daba Diawara, Aboubacar Soumaré, Moussa « Abba » Djiré et Ibrahima Tamega ont été déposés le 20 octobre par la Sécurité d’État au pôle judiciaire anticybercriminalité. Ils sont désormais officiellement poursuivis pour, notamment, « atteinte au crédit de l’État ». On sait désormais où ils sont emprisonnés, ils auront droit à un procès… Est-ce que cela vous rassure ? Ça doit rassurer sans doute les familles de ces personnes concernées. Mais en réalité, je vais vous rappeler simplement la caractéristique essentielle de l'état de non-droit d'un régime militaire, y compris en cours de transition sans limite dans le temps : il s'intéresse au droit uniquement pour violer le droit. Quand des militants ont été arrêtés par un service de l'État qui n'est pas un service judiciaire, qu'ils ont été enlevés dans les conditions que l'on sait, qu'ils ont été gardés dans des maisons qui ne sont pas des maisons de justice, qu'ils ont été cuisinés et souvent torturés - parce que des témoignages indiquent cela - et qu'ils soient représentés encore aux autorités judiciaires qui récupèrent ces proies judiciaires pour en faire des personnes poursuivies, j'appelle cela du recyclage judiciaire, du blanchiment de procédure. C'est une violation de la loi. Il faut simplement que les personnes qui s'adonnent à cette violation de la loi comprennent et entendent que leurs visages sont connus, que leurs noms sont connus, que leurs fonctions sont connues. Ils agissent au nom d'un État qui lui-même n'est pas dans le cadre de la loi. C'est à dénoncer avec la dernière vigueur. Alors que doit-on espérer pour Mountaga Tall et son fils ? Qu’ils soient présentés à la Justice et qu’ils soient jugés - on ne sait pas pour quels faits, du reste ? Qu’ils soient relâchés, tout simplement ? Relâchés immédiatement, parce qu'ils ne sont poursuivis pour rien et ils ne sont détenus qu’illégalement, du fait d'un commando qui a agi masqué et cagoulé. https://www.rfi.fr/fr/podcasts/le-grand-.title_zh: 马里Mountaga Tall遭绑架事件：沉默“既不能抹去司法机构的专业能力，也不能免除国家的义务”
https://www.rfi.fr/fr/podcasts/le-grand-.body_zh:
收听——05:33

在马里，到本周二为止，捍卫民主的律师、前部长穆ntaga Tall已经失踪6个月。5月2日至3日夜间，国家安全人员蒙面闯入他家中，将他绑架。几天后，马里有关部门又绑架了他的儿子；此后，这名儿子也一直被关押在某个地点，至今下落不明，也未经过任何法律程序。尽管穆ntaga Tall的家属四处交涉，马里过渡当局始终保持沉默。

马马杜·伊斯梅拉·科纳特是律师，曾任马里司法部长。他本人也是马里的民主捍卫者，与穆ntaga Tall十分熟悉。他对穆ntaga Tall的命运深感担忧，并谴责马里过渡政权政治和司法当局的行为。

马马杜·伊斯梅拉·科纳特应RFI《非洲》节目邀请，回答David Baché的提问。

RFI：穆ntaga Tall已被秘密拘押6个月，关押地点和条件均不明，任何人都无法探视他——无论是家属、律师还是医生……是否应该为穆ntaga Tall担忧？

马马杜·伊斯梅拉·科纳特：首先，我要感谢你们继续关注穆ntaga Tall。他的处境必须继续留在公共讨论之中。家属有权得到答复。我感到担忧，而且同我一样，数千人也在担忧。我们长期以来一直要求提供可核实的生存证明、允许其律师与他联系，并进行独立医学检查。家属必须知道他人在哪里，他必须获得必要的医疗保障。剥夺自由必须具有法律依据。当国家人员，或经国家授权、默许行事的人剥夺他人自由后，又拒绝承认这一剥夺，或隐瞒其下落时，就构成强迫失踪问题。必须立即找到穆ntaga Tall，并查明责任。就他的情况而言，沉默不能代替答复。

RFI：为什么过渡政权要针对穆ntaga Tall？人们可能指责他什么，他代表了什么？

马马杜·伊斯梅拉·科纳特：首先，他是一名律师，而且是律师中的佼佼者——名列律师协会名册的第三位。其次，穆ntaga Tall终其一生都在为民主奔走，是推动1991年3月26日（推翻穆萨·特拉奥雷将军军事独裁的日期，编者注）以及民主到来、民主开放和自由主义的重要政治人物。穆ntaga Tall担任部长期间，也深度参与了马里的政治生活。在任职之前、任职期间和卸任之后，一直持续到今天。众所周知，在这一军事过渡政权统治下，穆ntaga Tall曾不得不表达自己的意见。正是他反对这场没有期限、前途不明确且充满危险的过渡。

穆ntaga Tall遭绑架几天后，国家安全人员又绑架了他的亲生儿子。他们以给父亲送药为由，约他见面。那是一个圈套，Cheick Mamadou Tall从此再也没有回来。

RFI：为什么马里有关部门也扣押穆ntaga Tall的儿子？

马马杜·伊斯梅拉·科纳特：这个儿子，人们都知道他没有任何政治关系，也没有就马里发生的事情表达过反对意见。仅仅因为他是穆ntaga Tall的儿子，他们便想借此将其摧毁。这才真正体现出今日马里共和国发生之事的可耻与荒谬。他已经被秘密拘押6个月。穆ntaga Tall家属的律师已向马里司法部门和联合国强迫失踪问题委员会提出申诉，但马里过渡当局仍拒绝透露任何信息，始终缄默。

RFI：依您看，他们这样做的目的是什么？

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Plug-in hybrid SUV combines comfort and efficiency with aggressive pricing Starting BYD Korea's Sealion 6 DM-i plug-in hybrid SUV, the first thing that stood out was the exceptional quietness of its cabin. Driving through city streets and along highways, the SUV felt more like a mid-size luxury sedan than a family-oriented SUV. In the name Sealion 6 DM-i, DM-i stands for “Dual Mode-intelligent,” BYD’s proprietary plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) technology, which powers the vehicle's long-range drive. Its cabin remained remarkably quiet at low speeds, when the electric motor does most of the work. Minor vibrations were barely noticeable, while the suspension softened the impact of speed bumps and uneven pavement. The result was a relaxed, composed ride that made long-distance driving less tiring. On a roughly 100-kilometer round trip between Seoul and Paju, Gyeonggi Province, the SUV proved remarkably easy on the driver, with minimal fatigue and impressive fuel efficiency that exceeded expectations. The Sealion 6 DM-i is not built to deliver the explosive acceleration or sharp handling of a performance electric vehicle (EV). Its appeal lies elsewhere: comfortable cruising, low running costs and the freedom to travel long distances without constantly searching for a charging station. BYD Korea claims a combined driving range approaching 1,000 kilometers, making efficiency one of the SUV's strongest selling points. Its 18.3-kilowatt-hour battery provides up to 70 kilometers of all-electric driving, enough to cover many daily commutes without using gasoline. When the battery charge falls below 25 percent, the gasoline engine can generate electricity to sustain operation. That flexibility addresses one of the biggest inconveniences of owning a pure EV. Drivers can charge at home and use electric power for shorter trips, while relying on the hybrid system for longer journeys. The powertrain pairs a 1.5-liter turbocharged gasoline engine, producing 130 horsepower and 220 newton-meters of torque, with an electric motor. The SUV accelerates from zero to 100 kilometers per hour in 8.3 seconds — a figure seen as fairly unremarkable — but this is still enough for customers who prioritize smooth, predictable progress over outright speed. Pricing, however, may prove its most disruptive feature. Starting at 37.5 million won ($27,000), the Sealion 6 DM-i undercuts many plug-in hybrid rivals, which typically occupy price brackets above 60 million won. BYD's vertically integrated manufacturing, spanning batteries to finished vehicles, helps explain its ability to offer the SUV at such an aggressive price. Seven airbags and driver-assistance features, including adaptive cruise control, lane-departure prevention and rear cross-traffic alerts, come standard. For buyers seeking the refinement of a quiet sedan, the flexibility of a hybrid and the range for extended road trips, the Sealion 6 DM-i makes a compelling case — particularly at a price that puts plug-in hybrid ownership within reach of a much wider market
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 【试驾】比亚迪海狮6 DM-i在静谧性和续航方面表现出色
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 比亚迪韩国海狮6 DM-i插电式混合动力SUV以激进定价兼顾舒适性与效率。试驾BYD Korea的Sealion 6 DM-i插电式混合动力SUV时，最先给人留下深刻印象的是其座舱出色的静谧性。行驶在城市街道和高速公路上，这款SUV给人的感觉更像是中型豪华轿车，而非家庭取向的SUV。在Sealion 6 DM-i这一名称中，DM-i代表“智能双模式”（Dual Mode-intelligent），这是比亚迪自主研发的插电式混合动力电动车（PHEV）技术，为车辆的长续航行驶提供动力。低速行驶时，大部分工作由电动机完成，车内始终保持非凡安静。轻微振动几乎难以察觉，悬架也缓和了减速带和不平整路面带来的冲击。由此带来的乘坐体验从容沉稳，让长途驾驶不易疲劳。在京畿道首尔与坡州市之间约100公里的往返行程中，这款SUV让驾驶者感到格外轻松，疲劳程度极低，燃油经济性也超出预期。Sealion 6 DM-i并非为追求性能电动车（EV）那种爆发式加速或灵敏操控而打造。它的吸引力另有其处：舒适的巡航体验、低使用成本，以及无需不断寻找充电站便可长途旅行的自由。BYD Korea声称，该车综合续航里程接近1,000公里，使效率成为这款SUV最突出的卖点之一。其18.3千瓦时电池可支持最长70公里的纯电行驶，足以应对许多日常通勤，全程无需使用汽油。当电池电量降至25 percent以下时，汽油发动机可持续发电以维持车辆运行。这种灵活性解决了拥有纯电动车所面临的最大不便之一。驾驶者可以居家充电，短途出行使用电力，而长途旅行则依靠混合动力系统。这套动力系统将最大输出130马力、220牛·米扭矩的1.5升涡轮增压汽油发动机与电动机结合。该SUV从零加速至每小时100公里需8.3秒——这一成绩只能算中规中矩——但对于更看重平顺、可预期加速表现而非极致速度的消费者而言，仍然足够。不过，定价可能成为其最具颠覆性的特点。Sealion 6 DM-i起售价为3,750万韩元（$27,000），低于许多插电式混合动力竞品，后者的售价通常处于6,000万韩元以上的区间。比亚迪从电池到整车的垂直一体化生产模式，有助于解释该SUV为何能够以如此激进的价格推出。7个安全气囊以及一系列驾驶辅助功能均为标配，包括自适应巡航控制、车道偏离防系统和车后方交叉交通警报。对于希望拥有安静轿车般的精致感、混合动力车的灵活性以及长途自驾续航能力的消费者而言，Sealion 6 DM-i具有很强的说服力，尤其是其价格让插电式混合动力汽车进入了更广泛的市场。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea's consumer prices rose 2.8 percent in October from a year earlier, data showed Tuesday, as agricultural product prices continued to decline despite energy costs remaining elevated. According to data from the Ministry of Data and Statistics, consumer price growth eased to 2.8 percent in October from 2.9 percent in September and 3.1 percent in August. The data ministry said petroleum products' prices advanced 14.9 percent year-on-year in October, contributing 0.56 percentage point to the month's year-on-year inflation rate. It was the sharpest growth since 15.5 percent posted in July. In detail, diesel prices jumped 19.7 percent year-on-year in October, while gasoline prices increased a sharp 11.6 percent. The report showed that prices of industrial products overall rose 4.4 percent year-on-year in October due to higher global energy prices, with those of mobile phones and computers climbing 10.8 percent and 26.2 percent, respectively. Prices of imported automobiles, on the other hand, fell 3.9 percent over the same period. In addition, prices of agricultural, livestock and fishery products fell 1.7 percent over the same period, the findings showed, lowering the overall inflation rate by 0.14 percentage point. It marked the third consecutive month of an year-on-year decline. Prices of apples, napa cabbages and cucumbers fell 13.4 percent, 44.3 percent and 39.5 percent, respectively. Those of domestically produced beef, however, rose 9.1 percent. The service sector's prices moved up 2.7 percent, led by higher insurance premiums and overseas package tour prices, which increased 13.4 percent and 11.5 percent, respectively. Dining-out prices climbed 2.9 percent year-on-year in October, marking the highest increase since February, when they also increased 2.9 percent, and contributing 0.42 percentage point to the overall inflation rate. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国消费者价格10月同比上涨2.8%，数据周二显示，尽管能源成本仍处高位，但农产品价格继续下降。韩国数据统计部数据显示，消费者价格涨幅从9月的2.9%和8月的3.1%放缓至10月的2.8%。数据部表示，10月石油产品价格同比上涨14.9%，对当月同比通胀率贡献0.56个百分点。这是7月录得15.5%以来的最大涨幅。分项来看，10月柴油价格同比飙升19.7%，汽油价格也大幅上涨11.6%。报告显示，受全球能源价格上涨影响，10月工业品价格整体同比上涨4.4%，其中手机和计算机价格分别上涨10.8%和26.2%。另一方面，进口汽车价格同期下降3.9%。此外，结果显示，农产品、畜产品和渔业产品价格同期下降1.7%，使总体通胀率降低0.14个百分点。这标志着同比价格连续第三个月下降。苹果、大白菜和黄瓜价格分别下跌13.4%、44.3%和39.5%。不过，韩国国产牛肉价格上涨9.1%。服务部门价格上涨2.7%，主要受保险费和海外套餐旅游价格上涨推动，两者分别上涨13.4%和11.5%。10月外出就餐价格同比上涨2.9%，创下2月以来的最大涨幅，当时涨幅同样为2.9%，并对总体通胀率贡献0.42个百分点。电力、燃气和水价同期上涨0.4%。剔除波动较大的食品和能源价格的核心通胀率10月同比维持在2.8%

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/cry.summary: Korea’s cryptocurrency industry is on alert following a $6.3 billion hack at Binance, the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange. The U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) attributed the theft to North Korea in a statement released Saturday, saying the attackers stole about $6.3 billion in cryptocurrency from Binance on Thursday. That ambiguity has raised concerns that exchanges could violate the law by freezing withdrawals as a precaution following an incident like the Binance hack.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/cry.summary_zh: 全球最大的加密货币交易所Binance发生价值63亿美元的黑客攻击事件后，韩国加密货币行业进入戒备状态。美国联邦调查局（FBI）在星期六发布的一份声明中，将这起盗窃归咎于朝鲜，称攻击者于星期四从Binance窃取了约63亿美元的加密货币。这一情况引发了担忧：交易所可能因Binance遭黑客攻击等事件而预防性冻结提款，从而违反法律。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/cry.body: Korea’s cryptocurrency industry is on alert following a $6.3 billion hack at Binance, the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange. As signs emerge that the stolen assets are being laundered, domestic exchanges are seeking regulatory changes that would allow them to promptly halt withdrawals following hacks at other platforms, financial authorities and industry officials said Tuesday. The U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) attributed the theft to North Korea in a statement released Saturday, saying the attackers stole about $6.3 billion in cryptocurrency from Binance on Thursday. Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis said the North Korean hackers appeared to have entered a second stage of laundering the proceeds. Funds were being moved out of temporary holding wallets and transferred to blockchain networks such as Solana. The firm also detected efforts to convert 970,522 Solana tokens, valued at approximately 129 billion won ($96.3 million), into bitcoin. The transfers across networks and subsequent conversion into bitcoin are believed to be aimed at making the funds harder to trace. Amid growing concerns, the Financial Services Commission (FSC), the country’s top financial regulator, convened an emergency meeting of local cryptocurrency service providers Monday to examine the fallout for the domestic market and assess their readiness to respond. Domestic exchanges argue that an effective emergency response requires greater clarity on when they can legally suspend withdrawals. The Virtual Asset User Protection Act bars exchanges from arbitrarily blocking deposits and withdrawals while permitting such measures on legitimate grounds set out in a presidential decree. Industry representatives said a breach of an exchange’s own systems could warrant a suspension to safeguard customers, but the rules are less clear when the incident occurs elsewhere. That ambiguity has raised concerns that exchanges could violate the law by freezing withdrawals as a precaution following an incident like the Binance hack. During the meeting, representatives requested more flexible rules and clearer guidance on responding to security incidents at other platforms. Authorities also urged providers to bolster their defenses against further attacks. The Binance theft reportedly involved assets held in a hot wallet, which remains connected to the internet. Possible routes of compromise include access to internal systems through employees’ work laptops and unauthorized access to systems that approve and sign transactions. The regulator specifically called for a larger share of assets to be stored in offline cold wallets to reduce the risk of similar breaches. Current regulations require providers to hold at least 80 percent of customers’ deposited cryptocurrency assets in cold storage. “We will continue to strengthen our response framework in close cooperation with relevant agencies and the industry to prevent further breaches, including hacks, and limit the spread of damage,” an FSC official said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/cry.title_zh: Binance遭黑客攻击窃取63亿美元后，韩国加密货币交易所进入戒备状态
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/cry.body_zh: 韩国加密货币行业在全球最大加密货币交易所 Binance 遭黑客攻击、损失 63 亿美元后进入戒备状态。金融当局和行业官员周二表示，随着被盗资产被洗钱的迹象浮现，韩国国内交易所正寻求修改监管规定，以便在其他平台遭黑客攻击后，能够迅速暂停提款。美国联邦调查局（FBI）周六发布声明，将这起盗窃归咎于朝鲜，称攻击者周四从 Binance 窃取了约 63 亿美元的加密货币。区块链分析公司 Chainalysis 表示，朝鲜黑客似乎已进入洗钱处理所得的第二阶段。资金正从临时托管钱包转出，并转入 Solana 等区块链网络。该公司还发现，有人试图将价值约 1290 亿韩元（9630 万美元）的 970,522 枚 Solana 代币兑换成比特币。跨网络转账以及随后兑换成比特币，被认为旨在增加资金追踪难度。鉴于担忧日益加剧，韩国最高金融监管机构金融服务委员会（FSC）周一召集本地加密货币服务商紧急会议，评估事件对国内市场造成的影响，并核查其应对准备情况。国内交易所认为，有效的紧急响应需要更明确规定它们何时可以合法暂停提款。《虚拟资产用户保护法》禁止交易所无正当理由阻止存取款，但允许其依据总统令规定的合法理由采取措施。行业人士表示，交易所自身系统遭到入侵时，可以采取暂停措施保护客户，但当事件发生在其他平台时，相关规则就不够明确。这种模糊性引发担忧：在 Binance 遭黑客攻击之类的事件发生后，交易所可能因预防性冻结提款而违反法律。会议期间，代表们要求制定更灵活的规则，并就如何应对其他平台发生的安全事件提供更明确的指导。当局还敦促服务商加强防御，以抵御进一步攻击。据报道，Binance 盗窃事件涉及存放于热钱包中的资产，而热钱包仍连接互联网。可能的入侵途径包括通过员工的工作笔记本电脑访问内部系统，以及未经授权访问用于审批和签署交易的系统。监管机构特别要求将更大比例的资产存放在离线冷钱包中，以降低类似安全事件发生的风险。现行规定要求服务商将客户存入的加密货币资产至少 80% 存放于冷存储中。一名金融服务委员会官员表示：“我们将继续与相关机构和行业密切合作，加强响应框架，防止包括黑客攻击在内的进一步安全事件，并限制损害扩大。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: CJ ONE, a lifestyle membership program run by CJ OliveNetworks, is holding its November Wonder Week promotion with discounts at CJ CheilJedang’s online mall and the convenience store chain emart24, the company said Tuesday. CJ ONE is the loyalty program of CJ Group, one of Korea’s largest conglomerates. Members earn and spend points across the group’s businesses and its partner brands. The promotion runs until Nov. 10. It offers coupons for CJ The Market, the official online store of food giant CJ CheilJedang, and is tied to the store’s monthly sale event. Through Sunday, CJ ONE members also get an instant 50 percent discount, up to 5,000 won per purchase, on rice-based ready meals at emart24 stores. These include lunch boxes, gimbap rolls and triangle gimbap. Members must earn points with their membership barcode to qualify. The company said the emart24 deal targets members of the MZ generation, which in Korea refers to Millennials and Gen Z. Many of them buy convenience store meals for quick, filling food. CJ ONE launched its monthly Wonder Series promotions in July with partner brands such as bakery chain Tous les Jours and Mega MGC Coffee. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: SK Telecom has been named a 2027 LEAD company by the UN Global Compact (UNGC) Network Korea in recognition of its sustainability leadership, the mobile carrier said Tuesday. The company received the designation at the 2026 Korea Leaders Summit, which the network hosted at Grand Hyatt Seoul. The UN Global Compact is the world’s largest corporate sustainability initiative, launched by the United Nations in 2000. It encourages companies to build principles on human rights, labor, the environment and anti-corruption into their operations. Each year, the Korean network chooses about 10 companies and institutions as LEAD participants from its roughly 360 members. The selections recognize contributions to spreading sustainability management and developing the country’s ESG ecosystem. ESG stands for environmental, social and governance, the standards used to measure a company’s sustainability and ethical practices. SK Telecom co-chairs the network’s environment working group. In that role, it shared its experience handling major ESG issues and its know-how in building ESG management systems. The company also presented examples of how it applies artificial intelligence (AI) to ESG work, helping other members strengthen their own use of AI. Um Jong-hwan, head of SK Telecom’s sustainability management office, delivered a talk at the summit, where he introduced ways the company uses AI to improve energy efficiency and cut carbon emissions from AI infrastructure. SK Telecom pursues environmental management in two directions, which it calls “AI for decarbonization” and “decarbonization for AI.” It uses AI-based power-saving technology on its telecom network and is working to run its data centers more efficiently. “The energy transition and decarbonization require cooperation among various stakeholders, including companies, governments and financial institutions,” Um said. “We will share our experience and know-how with UNGC members and link AI innovation with environmental management to strengthen the foundation for sustainable growth.” This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: SK Telecom被联合国全球契约评为2027年LEAD企业
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 韩国SK Telecom周二表示，联合国全球契约（UNGC）韩国网络授予该公司“2027年LEAD企业”称号，以表彰其在可持续发展领域的领导力。该公司在网络于首尔Grand Hyatt举办的首尔大会上获此殊荣。联合国全球契约是全球规模最大的企业可持续发展倡议，由联合国于2000年发起，旨在鼓励企业将人权、劳工、环境和反腐败原则融入日常运营。韩国网络每年从约360家成员中评选约10家企业和机构成为LEAD参与者，旨在表彰其在推广可持续管理和推动韩国ESG生态系统建设方面的贡献。ESG即环境、社会和治理，是衡量企业可持续发展与道德实践的标准。SK Telecom担任该网络环境工作组的联席主席，并以这一身份分享了应对重大ESG问题的经验以及建设ESG管理体系的专门知识。该公司还介绍了如何将人工智能（AI）应用于ESG工作的案例，帮助其他成员加强自身对AI的应用。SK Telecom可持续发展管理办公室主任Um Jong-hwan在大会上发表演讲，介绍了公司如何利用AI提高能源效率，并减少AI基础设施的碳排放。SK Telecom从两个方向推进环境管理，即公司所称的“为脱碳而用AI”和“为AI而脱碳”。该公司在电信网络上采用基于AI的节能技术，并努力提高数据中心的运行效率。Um表示：“能源转型和脱碳需要企业、政府和金融机构等各类利益相关方合作。我们将与UNGC成员分享自己的经验和专门知识，推动AI创新与环境管理相结合，为可持续增长夯实基础。”本文在生成式AI协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/sports/2026.body: Korean infielder Kim Ha-seong has not received a qualifying offer from the Atlanta Braves after an injury-plagued season. Eight players received the one-year qualifying offer worth $23.15 million, the mean salary of the 125 highest-paid players in Major League Baseball (MLB), on Monday (U.S. local time). Kim played this season on a one-year, $20 million deal but batted just .116 with zero home runs and nine RBIs in 51 games. He missed the early part of the season after suffering a finger injury in January while in Korea — he slipped on ice and fell, tearing a tendon in his right middle finger — and never found his rhythm at the plate. He made his season debut on May 12 but then missed about a month, from early July to early August, with inflammation in his surgically repaired finger. He batted just 1-for-28 in June. After four seasons with the San Diego Padres from 2021 to 2024, Kim joined the Tampa Bay Rays in early 2025 as a free agent. He only played in 24 games for the Rays after returning from shoulder surgery he had undergone the previous winter, and then the Braves selected him off waivers in September 2025. Kim batted .253 with three homers and 12 RBIs in his 24-game audition for the Braves, who brought him back on that one-year contract to be their primary shortstop for 2026. Those plans went awry even before the season began as Kim suffered his finger injury, and it remains to be seen if any other club will go after the 31-year-old who has been slowed by injuries the past two seasons. Players who have received a qualifying offer have until 4 p.m. (Eastern Time) on Nov. 17 to accept it. Those who do so are signed with that team for the 2027 season at the designated value. Players who reject this offer remain free agents, and if they sign with a new team, then their previous club receives a draft pick as compensation. Since the system was implemented in 2012, only 18 players to receive a qualifying offer have accepted it. It is a way for players to bet on themselves to have one more productive season to further increase their value before exploring the open market. Former Korean big leaguer Ryu Hyun-jin accepted the qualifying offer from the Los Angeles Dodgers in 2018, and it worked out well for the left-hander. In 2019, Ryu led MLB with a 2.32 ERA and started the All-Star Game while also finishing second in the National League Cy Young Award voting. Ryu parlayed that into a four-year, $80 million contract in free agency with the Toronto Blue Jays
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/sports/2026.title_zh: 金河成未获亚特兰大Braves提供合格报价
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/sports/2026.body_zh: 亚特兰大 Braves 在金河善（Kim Ha-seong）饱受伤病困扰的一个赛季后，尚未向他提供合格报价。周一（美国当地时间），共有 8 名球员获得了价值 2315 万美元的一年期合格报价，这一金额等于美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）薪资最高的 125 名球员的平均年薪。金河善本赛季效力于一份价值 2000 万美元的一年期合同，但他出战 51 场比赛，打击率仅为 .116，没有本垒打，只有 9 分打点。1 月在韩国期间，他因手指受伤而缺席赛季初段——他在冰面上滑倒并摔伤，导致右手中指肌腱撕裂——此后在打击区始终未能找到状态。他于 5 月 12 日完成赛季首秀，但随后因接受手术后手指出现炎症，又从 7 月初到 8 月初缺席了约一个月。6 月份，他的打击率仅为 1 射 28 中。2021 年至 2024 年效力于 San Diego Padres 四个赛季后，金河善于 2025 年初以自由球员身份加盟 Tampa Bay Rays。他在接受上一年冬天进行的肩部手术后仅为 Rays 出战 24 场比赛，随后 Braves 于 2025 年 9 月从 waivers 名单上签下他。金河善为 Braves 试打 24 场比赛，打击率为 .253，击出 3 支本垒打，并有 12 分打点。Braves 依据那份一年期合同重新签下他，让他担任 2026 年的主力游击手。然而，这些计划甚至在赛季开始前就因金河善手指受伤而受挫；这位 31 岁的球员过去两个赛季一直受到伤病拖累，如今仍有待观察是否有其他球队会追求他。收到合格报价的球员必须在 11 月 17 日下午 4 时（美东时间）前决定是否接受。接受报价的球员将按照指定金额与该球队签约，出战 2027 赛季。拒绝报价的球员仍可成为自由球员；如果他们与新球队签约，原球队将获得一个选秀权作为补偿。自该制度于 2012 年实施以来，18 名收到合格报价的球员中只有 18 人接受了报价。这让球员可以押注自己再打出一个高效力的赛季，进一步提升自身价值，然后再进入公开市场。前韩国大联盟球员柳贤振（Ryu Hyun-jin）于 2018 年接受了 Los Angeles Dodgers 的合格报价，而这一选择对这位左投手来说带来了良好结果。2019 年，柳贤振以 2.32 的自责分率位居 MLB 榜首，并入选全明星赛首发，同时在国家联盟年度最佳投手奖投票中排名第二。柳贤振以此为基础，在自由市场上与 Toronto Blue Jays 签下了一份为期四年、价值 8000 万美元的合同

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Dongwha Electrolyte is joining a major national research initiative to develop sodium-ion batteries, as Korea seeks to advance alternatives to lithium-based energy storage and strengthen its position in the next generation of battery technology. The company, an affiliate of Dongwha Enterprise, said Tuesday that it would participate in the Market-Leading Next-Generation Secondary Battery Innovation Strategic Research Group, known as K-BIC, under the government's Global TOP Strategic Research Group support program. The initiative has a total budget of 130 billion won ($95 million) and brings together major players from industry, academia, research institutions and government to overcome technical barriers, secure foundational technologies and build a collaborative research platform. Dongwha Electrolyte is currently the only electrolyte manufacturer among the participating institutions, according to the company. The company will join the second phase of a project aimed at developing low-cost, long-life, nonlithium secondary batteries, targeting sodium-ion technology with production costs below $50 per kilowatt-hour. Research will expand beyond materials development to include battery cell development, commercial-scale manufacturing processes and safety verification, with an emphasis on practical demonstration. Dongwha Electrolyte will focus on manufacturing and supplying standard electrolytes, identifying their critical quality characteristics and establishing quality standards. The research project is led by the Korea Institute of Energy Research. "By joining K-BIC, we will be able to secure sodium-ion battery materials technology ahead of market demand, reflecting the needs of the energy storage system industry, while establishing a market-oriented demonstration research framework," Dongwha Electrolyte co-CEO Kim Jong-hoon said. The initiative is overseen by the Ministry of Science and ICT and the National Research Council of Science and Technology, with the Korea Research Institute of Chemical Technology coordinating the overall battery research program. 东华Electrolyte将参与一项重要的国家级研究计划，开发钠离子电池。韩国正寻求推进锂基储能之外的替代方案，并巩固其在下一代电池技术领域的地位。

东华Electrolyte是东华企业的关联公司。该公司周二表示，将参与政府“全球顶尖战略研究组支持计划”旗下的“市场主导型下一代二次电池创新战略研究组”，简称K-BIC。

该计划总预算为1300亿韩元（9500万美元），将业界、学界、研究机构和政府的主要力量汇聚起来，以突破技术障碍、掌握基础技术并建立协同研究平台。

据该公司介绍，东华Electrolyte目前是参与机构中唯一的电解液制造商。

该公司将参与该项目的第二阶段。该项目旨在开发低成本、长寿命、非锂二次电池，重点研发钠离子技术，目标是将生产成本降至每千瓦时50美元以下。

研究范围将从材料开发扩展至电池电芯开发、商业规模制造工艺和安全验证，并着重开展实际演示。

东华Electrolyte将专注于制造和供应标准电解液，确定其关键质量特性并制定质量标准。

该计划由韩国科学技术信息通信部和韩国国家科学技术研究委员会监督，韩国化工研究院负责协调整个电池研究项目。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title: Wave of cyber breaches exposes growing risks to Korea's digital economy
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: A relentless wave of cyberattacks on Korean banks, telecom operators, businesses and government agencies has exposed growing risks to the country's digital economy, highlighting the need for stronger cybersecurity. The scale and frequency of the breaches have raised concerns that cyber threats could extend beyond personal data theft to disrupt financial services, business operations and industrial supply chains.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 针对韩国银行、电信运营商、企业和政府机构持续不断的一波网络攻击，暴露出该国数字经济面临的风险日益加剧，也凸显了加强网络安全的必要性。安全 breaches 的规模和频率引发担忧，人们担心网络威胁可能不再局限于窃取个人数据，还可能扰乱金融服务、业务运营和工业供应链。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: A relentless wave of cyberattacks on Korean banks, telecom operators, businesses and government agencies has exposed growing risks to the country's digital economy, highlighting the need for stronger cybersecurity. The scale and frequency of the breaches have raised concerns that cyber threats could extend beyond personal data theft to disrupt financial services, business operations and industrial supply chains. The latest series of security breaches has brought those concerns to the highest levels of government. Most recently, police have launched a preliminary investigation into the online leak of personal information belonging to 168 individuals who traveled aboard the presidential aircraft during a trip to Europe in June, including President Lee Jae Myung, the first lady and Cabinet ministers. Following the incident, the foreign ministry said it is taking steps to reissue the passports of the president and first lady. The leak has raised fresh questions about how government agencies handle sensitive information, prompting broader scrutiny of cybersecurity practices. On Tuesday, the National Intelligence Service (NIS) said it will launch emergency security inspections at some 2,100 government agencies nationwide, including central government ministries and local governments. The spy agency also plans to conduct direct security checks on critical public information and communications infrastructure under its oversight, with the inspections expected to be completed by mid-November. The financial sector has also been hit by a series of breaches, exposing the scale of the problem. On Oct. 14, the Financial Services Commission (FSC) said cybersecurity incidents had been confirmed at 16 financial firms, affecting approximately 100,000 customer records. The affected institutions included commercial banks, savings banks and credit finance companies. Concerns deepened on Oct. 28, when Daishin Securities, Mirae Asset Global Investments and cryptocurrency exchange Bithumb reported separate cybersecurity incidents involving customer information. The threat is growing as hackers increasingly turn to artificial intelligence (AI) tools to find security weaknesses and launch attacks against multiple targets. The recent incidents have highlighted the risks facing Korea's highly digitalized economy, where financial institutions and businesses rely heavily on shared networks and online services. A breach at a telecom operator, for example, could expose customer information used for banking and other online services, while an attack on a major cloud provider could disrupt multiple businesses at once. Experts say the risks also extend to Korea's key manufacturing industries, including semiconductors, automobiles and shipbuilding, which increasingly rely on connected factories and automated production systems. Against this backdrop, the government has stepped up efforts to strengthen cybersecurity defenses. Last month, the Ministry of Science and ICT raised the country's cyber crisis warning level by one notch to "caution," the second lowest in its four-tier system, amid global efforts to address two critical security flaws in PHP, a widely used programming language. The ministry also plans to inspect around 170 major private-sector IT infrastructure facilities as part of efforts to identify security weaknesses before further breaches occur. Financial regulators have announced plans to tighten identity checks and access controls, improve information sharing and increase corporate executives' responsibility for cybersecurity. While major banks, companies and government agencies have pledged to increase cybersecurity spending and tighten security measures, concerns remain that AI-powered attacks could exploit vulnerabilities faster than organizations can address them. Industry experts say companies need to focus more on preventing attacks rather than simply responding after breaches occur. "The top priority is to strengthen the fundamentals of cybersecurity by properly establishing basic defenses, including firewalls, encryption, multifactor authentication, and vulnerability detection and response systems," said Kim Jin-soo, chairman of the Korea Information Security Industry Association (KISIA). "To achieve this, both businesses and the government must significantly increase their cybersecurity investments from current levels," he stressed
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 网络攻击浪潮暴露出韩国数字经济日益严峻的风险
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 针对韩国银行、电信运营商、企业和政府机构的一波持续不断的网络攻击，暴露出该国数字经济面临的风险日益加剧，也凸显出加强网络安全的必要性。数据泄露的规模和频率引发担忧，人们担心网络威胁可能超出窃取个人数据的范围，进而扰乱金融服务、企业运营和工业供应链。最近发生的一系列安全泄露事件，已将这些担忧反映到政府最高层级。最近，警方对168名个人的个人信息遭网上泄露一事展开初步调查。这些人在6月总统专机赴欧洲期间搭乘该机，其中包括总统李在明、第一夫人和内阁部长。事件发生后，外交部表示，正采取行动为总统和第一夫人重新签发护照。此次泄露事件再次引发对政府机构如何处理敏感信息的质疑，并促使外界更广泛地审视网络安全 practices。周二，韩国国家情报院（NIS）表示，将在全国约2,100个政府机构开展紧急安全检查，包括中央政府各部委和地方政府。该情报机构还计划对其监管的关键公共信息和通信基础设施直接进行安全检查，预计检查将于11月中旬前完成。金融部门同样遭遇一系列数据泄露，凸显出问题的严重程度。10月14日，韩国金融服务委员会（FSC）表示，已确认16家金融机构发生网络安全事件，涉及约100,000条客户记录。受影响机构包括商业银行、储蓄银行和信用金融公司。10月28日，Daishin Securities、未来资产全球投资和加密货币交易所Bithumb分别报告涉及客户信息的网络安全事件，相关担忧进一步加深。随着黑客日益频繁地利用人工智能（AI）工具寻找安全弱点并同时对多个目标发动攻击，威胁正在加剧。近期事件凸显出韩国高度数字化经济所面临的风险。在这一经济中，金融机构和企业高度依赖共享网络及在线服务。例如，电信运营商发生数据泄露，可能暴露客户用于银行及其他在线服务的个人信息；而针对大型云服务商的攻击，则可能同时扰乱多家企业的运营。专家表示，风险还延伸至韩国的主要制造业，包括半导体、汽车和造船业。这些行业日益依赖互联工厂和自动化生产系统。在此背景下，政府加大了加强网络安全防御的力度。上个月，在全球各方努力应对广泛使用的编程语言PHP中两个严重安全漏洞之际，韩国科学技术与信息通信部将全国网络危机警告级别上调一级至“注意”，这是四级体系中的次低级别。该部还计划检查约170处大型私营部门IT基础设施设施，努力在进一步发生数据泄露前找出安全弱点。金融监管机构宣布，将加强身份核查和访问控制、改善信息共享，并提高企业高管对网络安全的责任。虽然大型银行、企业和政府机构均承诺增加网络安全支出并收紧安全措施，但人们仍担心，利用AI发动的攻击可能比组织解决问题的速度更快地利用漏洞。行业专家表示，企业需要更加注重预防攻击，而不只是发生泄露后再作出响应。韩国信息安全产业协会（KISIA）会长金진秀表示：“首要任务是夯实网络安全基础，合理建立包括防火墙、加密、多因素身份认证，以及漏洞检测和响应系统在内的基础防线。要实现这一目标，企业和政府都必须在现有基础上大幅增加网络安全投资。”他强调。

The National Intelligence Service (NIS) has called on the central government agencies and local governments to carry out their own security checks based on a checklist, the sources said. Separately, the NIS plans to conduct its own vulnerability assessments of critical information and communications infrastructure in the public sector under its jurisdiction, the sources said. The NIS has called for particular attention to be paid to the management of potential cyberattack entry points, the operation of security monitoring systems and the application of security patches. Separately, the agency is conducting direct vulnerability assessments of internet-facing systems at public-sector facilities designated as critical information and communications infrastructure

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Rare photos, video tapes, personal items of Jürgen Hinzpeter on display A special exhibition honoring the late German journalist Jürgen Hinzpeter (1937-2016) will open in Gwangju on Thursday, marking the 10th anniversary of his passing. Titled "Records Live On — The Blue-Eyed Witness, Hinzpeter's Legacy," the exhibition will run through March 28, 2027, at the former South Jeolla Provincial Office. The event is co-hosted by the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism's Restoration Project Team and the May 18 Memorial Foundation. Hinzpeter is widely remembered in Korea and abroad as the real-life foreign correspondent portrayed in the hit 2017 feature film "A Taxi Driver." In May 1980, Korea's military dictatorship unleashed a violent crackdown on pro-democracy demonstrators in the southwestern city — an uprising now remembered as the Gwangju Massacre. As martial law authorities surrounded the city, cut off communications and enforced a strict media blackout while troops killed hundreds of innocent citizens, Hinzpeter risked his life to sneak past military checkpoints into the blockaded city. His haunting video footage and photography provided the global community with its first undeniable visual evidence of the atrocities, effectively shattering the regime's official state propaganda. The upcoming exhibition is organized into three comprehensive sections. Part 1, titled "Reviving May," details his high-risk journey into Gwangju alongside his original photo albums, broadcast footage, travel expense receipts and reconstructed route maps. Part 2, "Viewing the World," broadens the focus to showcase his lifelong reporting career across various global conflict zones. This section includes a meticulous recreation of his personal workspace featuring his original passport, reporting notebooks, typewriter, video tapes and personal book collection. Part 3, "Connecting May," examines his enduring journalistic legacy through his personal awards and commemorative materials related to the Hinzpeter International News Awards. Following the exhibition’s opening ceremony, the 2026 Hinzpeter International News Award ceremony will take place in the conference room of the former provincial office. Alongside the opening, an academic forum titled "Citizens' Participation, Continuing Democracy" will be held at Jeonil Building 245. Scholars and researchers will gather to discuss the intangible heritage value of the 1980 pro-democracy movement, emphasizing civic solidarity and exploring practical ways to pass these democratic ideals down to future generations, according to the ministry. "This special exhibition and academic forum will offer a vital opportunity to reflect on the historical power of record-keeping and to shine a renewed light on the democratic values defended by citizens," an official from the restoration team said. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title_zh: 展览向记录光州大屠杀的德国记者致敬
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh:
于尔根·希茨佩特尔的珍贵照片、录像带及个人物品展出

纪念已故德国记者于尔根·希茨佩特（1937—2016）的特别展览将于周四在光州开幕，纪念他逝世10周年。展览题为《记录长存——蓝眼睛的见证者：希茨佩特尔的遗产》，展期截至2027年3月28日，地点为前全罗南道地方政府办公楼。活动由文化体育观光部复原项目组与5·18 Memorial Foundation共同主办。

在韩国及海外，人们广泛记得希茨佩特是2017年热门剧情长片《出租车司机》中原型人物对应的外国记者。1980年5月，韩国军政府以暴力镇压韩国西南部城市支持民主的示威者，这场起义如今被称为光州大屠杀。当戒严当局包围城市、切断通信并实施严格媒体封锁，士兵杀害数百名无辜市民时，希茨佩特冒着生命危险，绕过军事检查站潜入被封锁的城市。他拍摄的撼人影像和摄影作品为全球社会提供了有关这些暴行的首批无可否认的视觉证据，彻底击碎了该政权的官方国家宣传。

即将举行的展览分为三个内容完整的部分。第一部分题为《重温五月》，讲述他冒险前往光州的经历，同时展出其原始相册、广播影像资料、差旅费用收据和复原的路线地图。第二部分《观看世界》将视野拓宽，展示他一生在各个全球冲突地区的报道生涯。该部分精心重建了他的个人工作空间，陈列其原始护照、采访笔记本、打字机、录像带和私人藏书。第三部分《连接五月》通过他的个人奖项以及与于尔根·希茨佩特国际新闻奖有关的纪念资料，考察他长久延续的新闻业遗产。

展览开幕式后，2026年于尔根·希茨佩特国际新闻奖颁奖仪式将在前道地方政府办公楼的会议室举行。展览开幕之际，还将在Jeonil Building 245举行题为《公民参与，延续民主》的学术论坛。据该部介绍，学者和研究人员将聚集一堂，讨论1980年支持民主运动作为非物质文化遗产的价值，强调公民团结，并探索将这些民主理念传递给后代的实际途径。

复原项目组一名官员表示：“这场特别展览和学术论坛将提供一次宝贵机会，让人反思记录历史的力量，并以新的光芒照亮公民所捍卫的民主价值观。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Advanced lithium-powered warship marks milestone for naval power, defense exports Korea’s Navy and Defense Acquisition Program Administration (DAPA) launched the Seo Hui (SS-088), the nation’s second 3,600-ton Dosan Ahn Changho-class Batch-II diesel-electric attack submarine, during a ceremony at Hanwha Ocean’s Geoje Okpo Shipyard on Tuesday. The vessel is named after Seo Hui (942–998), a prominent diplomat and statesman of the Goryeo Dynasty renowned for using strategic negotiation to fend off a massive invasion by the Khitan-led Liao Empire in 993, securing vital territory along the northwestern border without shedding blood. Navigating regional security threats around the peninsula, Korea designated his name to symbolize military foresight, national crisis resolution and maritime sovereignty defense. The ceremony was attended by around 200 officials, including National Assembly Speaker Cho Jeong-sik. Following naval tradition, Cho’s wife, Cho Mi-seon, cut the launching ribbon attached to the vessel, symbolizing new life breathed into the newly built warship, followed by a ceremonial champagne bottle break against the hull. Measuring 89 meters in length, the 3,600-ton Seo Hui is the second vessel under the KSS-III (Dosan Ahn Changho-class) Batch-II program, following the lead ship Jang Yeong-sil (SS-087). It represents a significant upgrade over the earlier 3,000-ton Batch-I submarines (Dosan Ahn Changho, An Mu and Shin Chae-ho). Equipped with an advanced combat management system, enhanced sonar suites and vertical launch system cells capable of firing both submarine-launched ballistic missiles and cruise missiles, the Seo Hui offers expanded multitarget precision attack capabilities and improved underwater survivability. A defining feature of the Seo Hui is its locally developed lithium-ion battery system, paired with an Air-Independent Propulsion framework. Compared to traditional lead-acid batteries, the lithium-ion power plant significantly extends underwater endurance and high-speed operation times. To ensure operational safety, the system underwent multilayered safety design verifications and land-based test facility evaluations before deployment, according to DAPA. The submarine also incorporates 70 domestically produced systems — adding 12 new localized components beyond Batch-I — achieving high indigenous content. This substantial localization guarantees efficient follow-on logistical support and strengthens Korea's competitive edge in the global defense export market for K-submarines. "The Seo Hui is a cutting-edge national strategic asset capable of responding effectively to security threats based on its formidable underwater operational capabilities," said Rear Adm. Lee Koo-sung, director general for planning and management at Navy Headquarters. "We will continue to build up naval power based on advanced science and technology to fulfill our mission as an elite navy protecting the public." Following extensive sea trials, the Seo Hui is scheduled for delivery to the Navy in 2028 before entering full operational deployment. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国下水3600吨潜艇，提升海上威慑力和国防出口能力
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国海军和国防采办计划管理局（DAPA）于周二在韩华海洋巨济玉浦造船厂举行的仪式上，为该国第二艘3600吨级“安昌浩”级Batch-II柴电攻击潜艇“徐熙”（SS-088）举行下水仪式。这艘潜艇以徐熙（942–998）的名字命名，他是高丽王朝杰出的外交家和政治家，以在993年通过战略谈判成功抵御契丹领导的辽帝国大规模入侵而闻名，在未流血的情况下保卫了西北边境的重要领土。面对半岛周边地区安全威胁，韩国选用他的名字来象征军事远见、国家危机解决能力和海上主权捍卫。约200名官员出席了仪式，包括国会议长赵正植。按照海军传统，赵正植的夫人赵美善剪断了系在潜艇上的下水彩带，象征为这艘新建战舰注入新生命，随后举行了香槟瓶撞击艇身的仪式。这艘89米长的3600吨级“徐熙”号是KSS-III（“安昌浩”级）Batch-II计划下的第二艘潜艇，首舰为“张永实”（SS-087）号。它代表了对早期3000吨级Batch-I潜艇（“安昌浩”、“安武”和“申采浩”）的重大升级。“徐熙”号配备了先进的作战管理系统、增强型声纳套件以及可发射潜射弹道导弹和巡航导弹的垂直发射系统单元，提供了扩展的多目标精确打击能力和改进的水下生存能力。“徐熙”号的一个标志性特点是其本土开发的锂离子电池系统，并搭配了不依赖空气推进框架。与传统铅酸电池相比，锂离子动力装置显著延长了水下续航时间和高航速运行时间。据DAPA称，为确保操作安全，该系统在部署前经历了多层安全设计验证和陆基测试设施评估。这艘潜艇还整合了70个国产系统——比Batch-I增加了12个新的本土化组件——实现了高本土化率。这种大幅本土化保证了高效的后续后勤支持，并增强了韩国在全球K-潜艇国防出口市场的竞争力。韩国海军总部规划与管理局长李求成少将表示：“‘徐熙’号是一项尖端的国家战略资产，能够凭借其强大的水下作战能力有效应对安全威胁。”“我们将继续以先进科学技术为基础加强海军力量，履行我们作为保护公众的精英海军的使命。”在进行广泛的海试后，“徐熙”号计划于2028年交付海军，随后进入全面作战部署。本文在生成式人工智能协助下发布，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: Political appointees and career diplomats each have their own strengths. Which group is better suited to representing Korea at overseas missions: career diplomats or political appointees? If a diplomatic post is politically sensitive or strategically important, political appointees may have an advantage over career diplomats because they can leverage their personal ties with the president to address urgent and contentious issues.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 政治任命人员与职业外交官各有优势。哪一类人更适合在海外使团代表韩国：职业外交官还是政治任命人员？如果某个外交职位政治敏感或具有战略意义，政治任命人员可能比职业外交官更具优势，因为他们可以利用与总统的个人关系，妥善处理紧急且存在争议的问题。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: In October, a business gala reception was held in one of the 10 largest cities of the United States. Forgive me for not providing further details about the event or the city where it took place. In this column, everything — from the attendees and their names and genders to other details that might help identify the person I am referring to — will remain anonymous to protect their identities. The only exception is the gender of my friend, who shared the story with me. My friend, who was also invited as a VIP guest, said she approached the Korean diplomat to share something she considered important. According to her, the diplomat repeatedly clapped with both hands raised above the head. “It was an invitation-only event, and all the attendees were VIPs affiliated with the host organization. The Korean diplomat’s way of clapping bothered me throughout the event. I thought the behavior was awkward and highly undiplomatic,” she said. She added that the diplomat also seemed to be unfamiliar with table etiquette, randomly using forks while eating the full-course dinner served that evening. My friend acknowledged that such etiquette might seem like a minor issue to ordinary people, but she took it seriously because the diplomat was representing Korea at the event. It would be inappropriate to judge diplomats and their professional performance solely by their table manners. Nevertheless, in diplomatic circles, such behavior can become a subject of gossip, reflecting not only on the diplomat but also on the country they represent. Back home, once such an episode becomes public, it can give critics further ammunition to challenge the practice of appointing non-career diplomats in key foreign postings. The diplomat in question was a political appointee with no prior diplomatic experience before assuming the post. Before leaving Korea, first-time ambassadors and consuls general are required to undergo three weeks of intensive training. During this period, they learn what it means to serve as heads of mission and what is expected of them in their overseas postings. Diplomatic etiquette, protocol and leadership are among the subjects covered in the three-week program. Political appointees to overseas missions came under fire during the National Assembly's annual audit of Korea's Permanent Mission to the United Nations in New York on Oct. 13. Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon criticized President Lee Jae Myung's choice of Cha Ji-hoon, who currently serves as Korea's ambassador to the U.N., questioning Cha's suitability for the position. Han described the lawyer-turned-envoy as an "amateur" who had landed the prestigious diplomatic post through his personal ties to the president. "Mr. Ambassador, you have no prior diplomatic experience. Would it have been possible for an amateur like you to rise to a position previously held by highly trained diplomatic professionals if not for your personal ties to the president?" Han asked. Cha responded that since arriving in New York last year, he had met many ambassadors who, like him, were political appointees. Although Han did not elaborate on why he considered Cha an amateur, his subsequent question offered a clue as to his belief that Cha is unqualified to represent Korea at the United Nations. "Is your English good enough to communicate freely with others without difficulty?" the lawmaker asked. Cha replied that he had been communicating properly in English. The spoils system has drawn criticism since Lee appointed his lawyer, Cha, to the key diplomatic post in September last year. As Han pointed out, Cha's lack of experience in foreign policy and diplomacy was a major source of controversy surrounding his appointment. Political appointees and career diplomats each have their own strengths. Thanks to their professional training at the foreign ministry and experience in previous overseas postings, career diplomats have an insider's understanding of how diplomacy works. Political appointees, by contrast, generally enjoy relatively easier access to their appointing authority — the head of state — because of their personal ties. This can lead senior officials in host countries to view them as potential conduits to the highest levels of government. However, both groups also have their respective shortcomings. Career diplomats, in general, tend to rely heavily on diplomatic rhetoric and well-honed communication skills when interacting with others. Conversations with them can sometimes leave their counterparts wondering: So what? Political appointees, meanwhile, may behave undiplomatically, as illustrated by the incident at the gala reception, making themselves — and sometimes their countries — a subject of gossip because of their unfamiliarity with diplomatic etiquette. Which group is better suited to representing Korea at overseas missions: career diplomats or political appointees? The answer depends on the nature of the mission to which they are assigned. If a diplomatic post is politically sensitive or strategically important, political appointees may have an advantage over career diplomats because they can leverage their personal ties with the president to address urgent and contentious issues. If bilateral relations with the host country are stable and free of particularly sensitive issues, career diplomats may be better suited to the job. Therefore, the real question the president should ask is not whether a candidate is a career diplomat or a political appointee. Rather, the focus should be on whether the person is capable of getting the job done. Some people have stellar résumés, but their actual performance in the workplace fails to live up to their credentials. In this regard, I believe there is something wrong with Han's criteria for distinguishing diplomatic professionals from amateurs. Although he did not explicitly spell out his standards, his questions suggest that foreign language proficiency and prior diplomatic experience are two essential qualifications for an ideal candidate for a diplomatic post. By his reasoning, career diplomats who speak English fluently would be the perfect candidates. While covering the diplomatic circuit in Seoul about a decade ago, I met many diplomats, both career officials and political appointees. As Han suggested, foreign language proficiency matters, and prior diplomatic experience is important. But these qualities alone rarely make a diplomat great. What matters most is dedication and a commitment to getting things done. Those whose actual job performance falls short of their credentials should be the first to be excluded from consideration for diplomatic appointments. Finding capable heads of mission to represent Korea overseas can be as difficult as finding a diamond in the rough. This helps explain why the search for suitable candidates so often ends in disappointment. Nevertheless, the president must keep trying
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 职业外交官与政治任命人员：什么样的人才是一名优秀外交官？
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 10月，美国十大城市之一举办了一场商务晚宴招待会。请原谅我不再提供有关这场活动或举办城市的进一步细节。在本专栏中，从出席者及其姓名和性别，到其他可能有助于识别我所指之人的细节，所有信息都将匿名处理，以保护他们的身份。唯一的例外是我的那位朋友的性别，她曾向我讲述此事。我的朋友也受邀作为贵宾出席，她说自己曾主动接近那名韩国外交官，想与其分享某件她认为重要的事情。据她表示，那名外交官把双手举过头顶，不停鼓掌。她说：“这是一场仅限受邀者参加的活动，所有出席者都是与主办机构有关联的贵宾。整个活动期间，那名韩国外交官鼓掌的方式一直让我感到不适。我认为这种行为既尴尬，也极不符合外交礼节。”她还补充说，那名外交官似乎也不熟悉餐桌礼仪，在当晚供应的全套正餐中用餐时，随意使用叉子。我的朋友承认，在普通人看来，这类礼仪可能只是小事，但她认真对待此事，因为那名外交官当时正代表韩国出席活动。仅凭餐桌礼仪就评判外交官及其职业表现并不恰当。然而，在外交圈中，这类行为可能成为谈资，不仅会影响外交官本人，也会影响其所代表的国家。类似事件一旦在国内公开，批评者便可进一步借题发挥，质疑在重要外交职位上任命非职业外交官的惯例。相关外交官是一名政治任命人士，在担任该职位前没有任何外交经验。在离开韩国前，首次担任大使和总领事的人员必须接受为期三周的强化培训。在此期间，他们要学习担任驻外机构负责人意味着什么，以及海外任职对自己的要求。外交礼节、礼仪规范和领导能力均在这三周培训课程的涵盖范围之内。10月13日，韩国常驻联合国代表团在纽约接受国会年度审计时，驻外机构的政治任命人士受到批评。独立议员韩东勋批评总统李在明任命现任韩国驻联合国大使车寄勋，质疑车寄勋是否适合担任该职位。韩东勋将这位由律师转任外交官的人士形容为“外行人”，称他凭借与总统的私人关系获得了这一重要外交职位。韩东勋问道：“大使先生，您没有任何外交经验。如果不是凭借与总统的私人关系，像您这样的外行人有可能升任此前由受过严格训练的专业外交人士担任的职位吗？”车寄勋回应称，自去年抵达纽约以来，他已见过许多与他一样由政治任命而来的大使。韩东勋没有进一步说明自己为何认为车寄勋是外行人，但他随后提出的问题却透露出其看法：车寄勋没有资格代表韩国常驻联合国。“您的英语是否足以与他人自如交流，不会感到困难？”这名议员问道。车寄勋回答说，他一直能够用英语恰当沟通。自李在明去年9月任命自己的律师车寄勋担任这一重要外交职位以来，“ spoils system”（分赃制）一直受到批评。正如韩东勋所指出的，车寄勋缺乏外交和外交事务经验，是围绕其任命产生争议的主要原因。政治任命人士和职业外交官各有长处。凭借在外交部门接受的专业训练以及此前在海外任职的经历，职业外交官对 diplomacy（外交）如何运作有内部人士式的理解。相比之下，政治任命人士凭借私人关系，通常更容易接触到任命他们的权力机构，即国家元首。这可能使东道国的高级官员把他们视为通往政府最高层的潜在渠道。然而，两类人士也各有缺点。职业外交官通常在与他人交流时，过度依赖外交辞令和经过磨炼的沟通技巧。与他们交谈有时会让对方产生一种“然后呢？”的感受。与此同时，正如这次招待会事件所显示的，政治任命人士可能作出不符合外交礼节的行为，并因不熟悉外交礼节而让自己、有时甚至让自己的国家成为谈资。哪类人士更适合代表韩国常驻海外机构：职业外交官还是政治任命人士？答案取决于他们所执行任务的具体性质。如果某一外交职位在政治上敏感或具有战略意义，政治任命人士可能比职业外交官更具优势，因为他们可以利用与总统的私人关系，处理紧迫且存在争议的问题。如果韩国与东道国的双边关系稳定，且没有特别敏感的问题，职业外交官可能更适合这份工作。因此，总统真正应该提出的问题，不是候选人属于职业外交官还是政治任命人士，而应关注此人是否有能力完成工作。有些人的履历光彩夺目，但其实际工作表现却未能达到履历所显示的水平。在这方面，我认为韩东勋区分专业外交人士与外行人士的标准存在问题。尽管他没有明确阐明自己的衡量标准，但他提出的问题表明，外语能力与先前外交经验是理想外交职位候选人的两项基本资格。按照他的逻辑，英语流利的职业外交官将是完美人选。大约十年前，我在首尔跑外交新闻时，接触过许多外交官，既有职业官员，也有政治任命人士。正如韩东勋所说，外语能力确实重要，先前的外交经验也很重要。但仅凭这些 qualities（素质）很少能让一名外交官成为卓越外交官。最重要的是奉献精神，以及把事情做好的决心。那些实际工作表现未能达到自身履历水平的人，应当首先被排除在外交任命人选之外。寻找能够代表韩国的优秀驻外机构负责人，可能如同从粗砺原石中寻找钻石一样困难。这也有助于解释为何寻找合适候选人的过程往往以失望告终。尽管如此，总统仍必须继续努力……

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.summary: Only Amadi the politician could have claimed that Enugu State is the most politically violent state in Nigeria without reference to any survey to that effect, thus allowing his intellectualism to take flight in the face of dirty politicking, yet again. Amadi also dabbled into the economy of Enugu.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.summary_zh: 只有政治人物阿马迪才可能声称恩古州是尼日利亚政治暴力最严重的州，而无需援引任何相关调查；于是，他又一次在肮脏的政治把戏面前任由自己的学识飞扬。阿马迪也曾涉足恩古州的经济。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body: The dust raised by the contractual dispute between Amadeo Event Centre, a private enterprise in Enugu, and its client, the Nigeria Institute of Healthcare Givers and Medical Social Work Practitioners, has settled. It is now clear to Ndi Enugu and Nigerians that it was deliberately misrepresented by the Enugu opposition as an attempt by the Enugu State Government to bar the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) and its presidential candidate, Mr Peter Obi, from holding their town hall meeting in the state capital. Unable to campaign against Governor Peter Ndubuisi Mbah on performance, the opposition have adopted a campaign of calumny and the dirty art of disinformation as their only tools for political relevance. They have no single manifesto, except to contrive falsehoods to deceive and destroy reputations. While the factional senatorial candidate of the NDC for Enugu East Senatorial District, one Ada Ogbu, is a prime culprit, it is needless dignifying her with a riposte. Desperate people do desperate things. The real disappointment in the entire drama is Sam Amadi, my good friend of over two decades and a public intellectual now turned politician. As one who has a reputation to protect, his piece on Governor Peter Mbah and Enugu State has left one wondering what came over him. Was it an error of judgement? I do not think so. He is a lawyer. He knows about the late Justice Chukwudifu Oputa’s (JSC) admonition in Garba v. University of Maiduguri (1986) 1 NWLR (Pt. 18) 550. According to the late sage, God gave us two ears to hear both sides. I was just a phone call away if he really wanted to hear the other side. But he chose politics over a balanced commentary. All doubts as to his intention were cleared by his response to the reactions of Governor Mbah’s supporters and aides to his diatribe. Rather than remorsefully withdraw some of his obnoxious and fallacious claims, he embarked on self-glorification. It is the case of the proverbial hen. Her kindred were still expressing shock, watching the way she dismembered a heap of excreta with her toes, only for her to also employ her mouth (beak) in the disgusting enterprise. Not many would understand the dangerousness of Amadi’s commentary, as his crafty art of disinformation was cloaked as genuine concerns of a public intellectual with a civil society background. That is exactly the reason we must separate Amadi the politician and a contender for the Imo State governorship seat on the platform of the NDC come November 2027 from Amadi the public intellectual to understand what drives not only his attack on Mbah’s government but also his takes on national issues going forward. Only Amadi the politician could have claimed that Enugu State is the most politically violent state in Nigeria without reference to any survey to that effect, thus allowing his intellectualism to take flight in the face of dirty politicking, yet again. But Enugu State is adjudged by the Nigerian security sector and even the travel advisories of major world powers like the UK to be one of the most peaceful and secure states in Nigeria today. He equally claimed that “Every week, one person would be shot dead at a political rally in Enugu.” Again, another wicked drinking parlour claim, not backed by verifiable facts. No names. No places. No dates. Just reckless politics and naked dance in the market square. It beggars belief, and one can only wonder how proud of himself Amadi was after reading his piece of diatribe the next morning. There are two major problems with this statement. One is the entitlement mentality. Let us get something straight: Obi is pursuing his political dream, which is well within his rights. But his personal dream does not subsume that of every Igbo man or woman. By the way, I do not think that there is any reasonable Igbo man who does not support the Igbo presidency project. We can only differ in our approach. While some believe they can go it alone here and now, banking on individual popularity, others believe it can only be realised through good timing and strategic alliances with other parts of the country. Neither of the two approaches deserves to be demonised, as both are working towards the same goal. Only time will prove one group right and the other wrong. Besides, from the colonial era, when Samuel Goomsu Ikoku squared up against his father, Dr Alvan Ikoku, and defeated him to claim the Arochukwu constituency seat in the Eastern Region House of Assembly election in 1957, to the 1983 general elections, when Dr Edwin Onwudiwe of Dr Nnamdi Azikiwe’s Nigerian People’s Party (NPP) took on Dim Chukwuemeka Odumegwu Ojukwu of Shehu Shagari’s National Party of Nigeria (NPN) in the battle for the Onitsha (old Anambra State) Senatorial District in 1983, politicians have always done their thing. Even Ojukwu joined the NPN instead of Zik’s NPP. Ojukwu’s wife is a serving minister in Tinubu’s cabinet. Does that mean the Ojukwu household is anti-Igbo? Not at all. I equally cringe at the hypocrisy of praising Yoruba or Northern leaders who support Obi as heroes while demonising Igbo leaders who decide to support Tinubu or Atiku Abubakar. The likes of Amadi seem to forget that if everybody should strictly support his or her tribesman, then the South East, with the least number of registered voters (only 11,976,218 voters, or 11.58 per cent of INEC’s 103,428,715 voters), might never be able to produce the President of Nigeria. Amadi also dabbled into the economy of Enugu. In acknowledging the state’s jump from the bottom of the Internally Generated Revenue (IGR) table before Mbah’s advent to third place (only behind Lagos and Rivers states) in 2025, he still misfired on how Enugu achieved the feat. As a lawyer, he understands that tax matters are on the Exclusive Legislative List, hence no State Assembly can legislate to increase or reduce tax, yet he still tried to create the false impression that Enugu citizens were being overtaxed. He claimed that the state’s IGR-to-GDP ratio did not justify the huge IGR revenue. However, contrary to this misrepresentation, the state’s IGR surge did not come from tax. In fact, out of the N406.7 billion recorded by the state in 2025, for instance, tax revenue accounted for just N51.5bn, or 12.6 per cent, while non-tax revenue was N355.2bn, or 87.4 per cent of the total IGR. The surge was actually inspired by improved fiscal performance, which is why the state moved from 19th place on the States’ Fiscal Performance Measure in 2023 to 13th in 2025. Mbah has been radical in deploying technology to block revenue leakages and sharp practices that moved public funds into private accounts. The government also widened the tax net to bring in more people to fulfil their civic obligations, while also digitising the entire revenue system to make revenue collection cost-effective. Importantly, the state’s revenue base has been widened by the recovery, revival, optimisation, and monetisation of Enugu’s moribund assets – Nigergas Limited, Enugu United Palm Products Limited, Hotel Presidential, and the International Conference Centre – in addition to new ventures like Enugu Air, which are yielding revenues. When Amadi talked down on Enugu’s GDP, he was apparently too blinded by partisanship to notice the disruptive and exponential economic diversification that has continued to take place in Enugu State since 2023. The Enugu he used to know as a civil service state has now become a major economic hub across all sectors: agriculture, manufacturing, trade, tourism, and others. So, while relying on the obsolete GDP rating, common sense should have told him that, in view of higher economic activities and investments in the last three years, Enugu’s GDP must have improved significantly. In concluding, let it be known that Amadi’s purported pro-Igbo and Obi activism is steeped in selfish political calculations. Since he was unable to secure the Labour Party ticket for the 2023 Imo governorship election, his pedestrian calculation is that a victory for Obi in January will brighten his governorship ambition. And that is well within his rights as he strategises for his political ambition. But he should drop the pretence that he is doing it for Obi or that he loves Alaigbo more. He is actually looking out for himself. Period. *Mr Uche Anichukwu, who is the Special Assistant to Governor Peter Mbah on External Relations, contributed this piece from Enugu
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.title_zh: 埃努古：Sam Amadi判断失误，而且完全是无谓的失误，作者Uche Anichukwu
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body_zh: 恩古埃阿马迪奥活动中心是一家恩古埃的私营企业，它与客户尼日利亚医疗保健提供者及医疗社会工作者协会之间的合同纠纷所掀起的风波已经平息。如今，恩古埃州前州长恩迪和尼日利亚人都很清楚，恩古埃反对派蓄意歪曲此事，称恩古埃州政府企图阻止尼日利亚民主大会（NDC）及其总统候选人彼得·奥比先生在该州首府举行城镇会议。由于反对派无法在施政业绩上与州长彼得·恩杜布伊西·姆巴竞争，便把诽谤和散布虚假信息的卑劣手段当作维持政治存在感的唯一工具。他们没有任何具体的竞选纲领，只会炮制谎言来欺骗他人、毁坏他人名誉。恩古埃东参议院选区NDC派系候选人之一阿达·奥格布是主要祸首，但根本没必要煞费苦心地反驳她，从而抬举她。走投无路的人会做出走投无路的事。整场闹剧中真正令人失望的是萨姆·阿马迪——我二十多年来的挚友，如今从公共知识分子转型为政治人物。作为一个需要维护声誉的人，他那篇评论州长彼得·姆巴和恩古埃州的文章令人不禁揣测他究竟怎么了。这是判断失误吗？我并不认为。他是一名律师。他应该知道已故法官楚库维迪福·奥普塔法官（司法大法官）在《Garba诉迈杜古里大学案》（1986年）1 NWLR（第18部分）第550页中的告诫。据这位已故贤哲所说，上帝赐予我们两只耳朵，以便听取双方的看法。如果他真想听听另一方的意见，只需给我打个电话即可。但他选择了政治，而非客观持平的评论。他对州长姆巴支持者和助手的反应所作的回应，也彻底打消了人们对其动机的所有疑虑。他非但没有悔恨地撤回部分既令人厌恶又站不住脚的说法，反而开始自我标榜。这就应了那句俗话：“母鸡落进汤里，还会再啄一口。”她的同类仍在表达震惊，眼睁睁看着她用脚趾把一堆粪便扯碎，最后竟又用嘴（喙）参与这场令人作呕的勾当。并非很多人能明白阿马迪这番评论的危险性，因为他那套狡猾的虚假信息手法，被包装成一名具有公民社会背景的公共知识分子 genuine 的关切。正是因此，我们才必须把阿马迪这个将于2027年11月以NDC平台角逐伊莫州州长席位的政治人物，与公共知识分子身份区分开来，才能理解究竟是什么驱使他不只是攻击姆巴政府，也将继续对全国性议题发表评论。只有作为政治人物的阿马迪，才会在不援引任何相关调查的情况下宣称恩古埃州是尼日利亚政治暴力最严重的州，从而让其知识分子姿态再次在卑劣的政治操弄面前凌空起飞。然而，尼日利亚安全部门以及英国等世界主要强国的旅行警示都认定，恩古埃州是当今尼日利亚最和平、最安全的州之一。他还声称：“在恩古埃，每周都会有一人在政治集会上中枪身亡。”这又是一个恶劣的酒馆闲话，没有任何可核实事实作为支撑。没有姓名，没有地点，没有日期，只有不计后果的政治操弄和在广场上的 Naked dance。简直难以置信，人们只能 wonders，阿马迪第二天早晨读完自己那篇充满谩骂的文章后，究竟会有多么自我陶醉。这番言论存在两个主要问题。其一是特权心态。让我们把事情说清楚：奥比是在追求自己的政治梦想，这完全属于他的权利。但他的个人梦想并不涵盖每一位伊博族男性或女性的梦想。顺便说一句，我不认为有哪位理智的伊博族男性不支持伊博族人当总统的计划。我们只能在实现方式上存在分歧。有些人认为，他们现在就可以单独依靠个人号召力实现这一目标；另一些人则认为，只有把握有利时机，并与该国其他地区建立战略联盟，这一目标才能实现。这两种方式都不应受到妖魔化，因为它们都在为同一个目标努力。唯有时间才能证明哪一方正确、哪一方错误。此外，从殖民时代起，萨缪尔·古姆苏·伊科库在1957年东部地区议会选举中与父亲阿尔万·伊科库博士对决，并击败父亲，夺得阿罗丘库选区席位；到1983年大选，恩马迪·阿齐克韦所属的尼日利亚人民党（NPP）候选人埃德温·恩武迪韦博士，在奥尼查（旧阿南布拉州）参议院选区争夺战中对阵谢胡·沙加里所属的尼日利亚国家党（NPN）候选人迪姆·楚库埃梅卡·奥杜梅格武·奥jukwu，政治人物向来都会采取这类手段。甚至奥jukwu本人也加入了NPN，而非“齐克”的NPP。奥jukwu的妻子现任蒂努布内阁部长。这是否意味着奥jukwu家族反伊博？完全不是。我同样为一种虚伪感到厌恶：有人把支持奥比的约鲁巴族或北方领导人奉为英雄，却把决定支持蒂努布或阿提库·阿布巴卡的伊博族领导人妖魔化。阿马迪之流似乎忘了，如果每个人都必须严格支持自己的族人，那么登记选民人数最少的东南部——仅有11,976,218名选民，占INEC登记的103,428,715名选民的11.58%——或许永远无法选出尼日利亚总统。阿马迪还曾涉足恩古埃的经济议题。他承认，在姆巴上任前，恩古埃州的地方政府收入（IGR）在全国排名垫底的情况下跃升至第三位（仅次于拉各斯州和 Rivers 州），但他对恩古埃如何实现这一成绩的判断仍然有误。作为律师，他明白税收事务属于专属立法清单，因此任何州议会都无权通过立法增加或减少税收，可他仍试图制造一种错误印象，让人以为恩古埃居民被过度征税。他声称，该州的IGR与GDP之比无法支撑巨额IGR收入。然而，与这种歪曲相反，该州IGR的大幅增长并非来自税收。事实上，该州2025年录得的406.7亿奈拉中，税收收入仅占515亿奈拉，即12.6%；非税收入为3552亿奈拉，占IGR总额的87.4%。这一增长实际上得益于财政表现改善，因此该州在《各州财政表现指标》中的排名从2023年的第19位升至2025年的第13位。姆巴大力运用技术手段，堵住将公共资金转移至私人账户的漏洞和不当行为。政府还拓宽税基，让更多人履行公民义务，同时将整个收入系统数字化，使收入征收更具成本效益。尤为重要的是，该州通过收回、振兴、优化并盘活恩古埃的呆滞资产，拓宽了收入来源，包括Nigergas Limited、Enugu United Palm Products Limited、Hotel Presidential和International Conference Centre，此外还发展了Enugu Air等新业务，并由此创造了收入。阿马迪贬低恩古埃GDP时，显然已被党派之争蒙蔽双眼，未能察觉自2023年以来恩古埃州持续发生的、颠覆性的经济多元化及指数级经济增长。他过去所认识的那个作为公务员州治的恩古埃，如今已成为横跨各行业的重要经济中心：农业、制造业、贸易、旅游业等各个领域。因此，即便他仍沿用过时的GDP排名，常识也应告诉他，鉴于过去三年经济活动和投资增加，恩古埃的GDP必然已显著改善。最后需要指出的是，阿马迪所谓支持伊博族和奥比的行动，浸透着自私的政治算计。由于他未能获得劳动党在2023年伊莫州州长选举中的候选人资格，他那粗浅的盘算是，奥比若在1月获胜，就会为自己的州长野心增添希望。他为自己的政治前途谋划，这完全属于他的权利。但他不该再假装自己这样做是为了奥比，或是因为热爱Alaigbo。他实际上只是在为自己着想。仅此而已。*恩古埃州长彼得·姆巴对外关系特别助理乌切·阿尼丘库先生从恩古埃撰文 contributed this piece。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/refo.body: Layer 1 The Executive Secretary/CEO of the National Sugar Development Council (NSDC), Mr. Kamar Bakrin, has said the bold, macroeconomic reforms put in place by President Bola Ahmed Tinubu have made local sugar production attractive and cleared the pathway for the country to achieve self-sufficiency. He said the reforms have brought stability to the economy, adding that the next step is to turn stability into growth that works for ordinary Nigerians. He stated further: “Our most pressing priorities are well known: jobs, especially for young people; rural livelihoods; security; pressure on foreign exchange; food security; and the cost of living. “Every Government must make choices among competing priorities. Our contribution as a Council is to make sure that, when those choices are made, the full economic picture of the sugar value chain is on the table. This is because very few sectors touch all of these priorities at once the way sugar does.” Responding to the Summit’s theme of turning stability into growth that works for ordinary Nigerians, he said sugar offers a practical route. Under the Nigeria Sugar Master Plan (NSMP) 2.0, the goal is self-sufficiency in sugar production. Bakrin said reaching it would save about $1 billion in foreign exchange every year and create about 110,000 direct jobs, most of them in rural communities, on estates, in mills and on outgrower farms where smallholders grow cane for the mills. “The gains go beyond the factory gate. Sugar estates bring roads, schools, clinics and electricity generated from bagasse, the fibre left after cane is crushed’’. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/refo.body_zh: 第一层 国家糖业发展委员会（NSDC）执行秘书兼首席执行官卡马尔·Bakrin表示，总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布推出的大胆宏观经济改革提高了本地糖业生产的吸引力，并为该国实现自给自足铺平了道路。他说，这些改革为经济带来了稳定，并补充称，下一步是把稳定转化为惠及普通尼日利亚人的增长。他进一步表示：“我们最紧迫的优先事项非常明确：就业，尤其是青年就业；农村生计；安全；外汇压力；粮食安全；以及生活成本。“任何政府都必须在相互竞争的优先事项之间作出选择。我们委员会的作用是确保在作出这些选择时，糖业价值链的完整经济图景都能被纳入考量。因为很少有哪个部门能像糖业一样同时牵动所有这些优先事项。”针对本次峰会“将稳定转化为惠及普通尼日利亚人的增长”这一主题，他表示，糖业提供了一条切实可行的路径。根据《尼日利亚糖业总体规划》（NSMP）2.0，目标是实现糖业生产自给自足。Bakrin表示，实现这一目标每年将节省约10亿美元外汇，并创造约110,000个直接就业岗位，其中大多数位于农村社区、糖厂、榨糖厂以及由小农户种植甘蔗供厂收购的农户农场。“这些收益超出了工厂大门的范围。糖业种植园带来了道路、学校、诊所，以及利用甘蔗压榨后剩余的纤维——蔗渣——所发电的电力。此处发表的评论不代表Vanguard newspapers及其任何员工的意见

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110305.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 김정진 안정훈 기자 = 조국혁신당 신장식 대표는 3일 "더 이상 민주당 간판이 개혁성을 보증하지 못한다"며 2028년 총선에서 이른바 '반(反)개혁 지역구'에 후보를 내겠다고 밝혔다. 더불어민주당 일각에서 다시 제기된 합당론에 대해서는 "결혼은 혼자 하나"라며 신뢰 회복이 우선이라는 입장을 분명히 했다. 신 대표는 이날 국회에서 당 대표 취임 100일 기자간담회를 열고 "지금 민주당은 개혁 정당이 맞느냐"라며 "이대로 가면 2028년 총선은 필패"라고 경고했다. 그러면서 "2028년 총선에서 반개혁 지역구에 가장 선명하고 개혁적인 인물들이 출마할 것"이라며 "김준형 원내대표는 물론이고 정춘생 사무총장, 그리고 저 역시 수도권 반개혁 지역구에 출마하겠다"고 강조했다. 구체적으로는 민주당에서 제명된 무소속 강선우 의원의 지역구인 서울 강서갑에 정 사무총장이 출마할 계획이라고 밝혔다. 조국 혁신정책연구원장의 출마 여부에 대해서는 "평택에서 지역위원회를 1호로 개소했다"며 "그것이 무엇을 의미하는지는 너무 명징하다"고 답했다. 신 대표는 반개혁을 판단하는 기준으로 ▲ 윤(尹)어게인·내란 옹호 ▲ 반검찰개혁 ▲ 초광역특구법(메가특구법) 52시간제 규정 완화 찬성 ▲ 조희대 대법원장 탄핵 반대 등을 들었다. 이어 "혁신당과 민주당 간 밀약설을 퍼뜨리는 사람들, 혁신당에 사회주의를 운운하며 '빨갱이 몰이'를 한 사람들, '문조털래유' 멸칭을 동원해 민주 진보 진영 갈라치기에 몰두한 사람들은 연대와 통합의 대상이 아니라 심판의 대상"이라며 이들도 반개혁 인사에 포함된다고 주장했다. 다만 개별 기준 하나만으로 반개혁 인사를 판단하는 것은 아니라며 여러 기준을 종합적으로 고려하겠다고 덧붙였다. 민주진보 진영 내 표 분산 우려에 대해서는 "개혁 정당인 혁신당 후보가 나서야 경쟁력이 올라간다"며 "어부지리를 주고 싶지 않다면 민주개혁 진영 내 경선을 치르자"고 제안했다. 최근 이재명 대통령과 민주당 중진 의원들의 만찬에서 합당론이 다시 제기된 데 이어 정청래 전 대표가 유튜브 방송에서 내년 1월을 합당 시한으로 언급한 데 대해서는 "내란 극복 연합, 민주 대연합을 민주당 집안싸움에 희생시키지 말라"고 비판했다. 신 대표는 "내부 정치용, 국면 전환용, 국면 타개용 합당 카드 저희는 받아들일 생각 없다"며 민주당의 신뢰 회복, 지난 1월 합당 논의 과정에서 혁신당을 대상으로 제기된 밀약설·색깔론 등에 대한 공식 사과, 가치와 비전의 공감을 전제 조건으로 제시했다. 이어 "지금 중요한 것은 진영 전체가 어떻게 힘을 모아낼까 하는 것"이라며 합당은 선거 연합 등과 마찬가지로 차기 총선과 대선에서 민주 진보 진영의 승리를 위한 방안 중 하나라고 설명했다. 신 대표는 이날 '내란 청산'도 강조하며 민주당을 향해 "5일 본회의에서 조희대 탄핵안을 처리하고 12월 3일 내란 2주년까지 '내란방지 법안'들도 모두 통과시키자"고 촉구했다. 내란방지 법안으로는 계엄 선포 요건을 강화하는 계엄법 개정안, 내란범 사면을 제한하는 사면법 개정안 등을 거론했다. 법원행정처 폐지 필요성도 강조했다. 신 대표는 "대한민국에 전무후무한 어마어마한 재정이 생긴 만큼 그 돈을 쓰는 것에도 국민께서 깜짝 놀랄 만한 발상의 대전환이 필요하다"며 "불평등 양극화 특별회계를 별도로 설치해 주거 안정에 100조원을 투자하자"고 제안했다. 나머지 초과 세수는 돌봄·일자리·교육 등에 투입하자고 제안하는 한편 국회 불평등해소특별위원회와 대통령 직속 불평등대응위원회 설치 필요성도 강조했다. 또 오는 5일에는 '기회의 공정과 사회적 기본권 강화를 위한 불평등 양극화 해소 특별법'을 당론으로 발의하고, 향후 조세특례제한법·주거기본법·도시 및 주거환경 정비법 등 주거 안정을 위한 패키지 법안도 발의할 계획이라고 밝혔다. 신 대표는 오는 27일 창당 1천일을 맞아 당의 강령·중장기 전망을 연구할 '비전랩'을 중심으로 당의 새로운 비전을 담은 '혁신 프로젝트'를 공개하겠다고 예고했다. https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110305.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）金正珍、安定勋记者＝祖国革新党新任党首辛长植3日表示，“民主党这块招牌已无法再保证改革性”，并宣布将在2028年大选中推举候选人参加所谓的“反改革选区”。对于民主党内再次出现的合作论，他明确表态，“婚姻要靠一个人”，恢复信任才是当务之急。辛代表当天在国会举行党首上任100天记者会，称“现在的民主党还是改革政党吗”，并警告说，“照这样下去，2028年大选必败”。他强调：“在2028年大选中，最鲜明、最具改革色彩的人物将参加反改革选区竞选”，“不仅院内代表金俊亨，行政总务长郑春生，我本人也会参加首都圈反改革选区竞选”。具体而言，他表示，计划由郑行政总务长参选民主党开除党籍的无所属议员姜善佑所代表的选区，即首尔江西区。关于他本人是否参加祖国革新政策研究院院长的选举，他回答：“我们在平泽率先设立了地区委员会”，“这意味着什么已经再清楚不过”。辛代表列举了判断反改革的标准，包括▲拥戴尹锡悦、支持内乱▲反对检察改革▲赞成放宽超广域特别区法（“超 mega 特区法”）52小时工作制规定▲反对弹劾大法院院长赵熙大等。他接着主张：“散布革新党与民主党之间存在秘密协议的人，借革新党鼓吹社会主义并煽动‘红营 mates’，以及动员‘文在术语’蔑称、鼓动民主进步阵营分裂的人，不是团结与整合的对象，而是受审对象”，“这些人也应被视为反改革人物”。不过，他补充说，并非仅凭其中一项标准就判断一个人是否反改革，而会综合考虑多项标准。针对民主进步阵营内部选票分散的担忧，他表示：“让革新党的改革派候选人参选，才能提升竞争力”，“如果不想把票白送出去，就在民主改革阵营内举行初选”。继最近李在明总统与民主党中枢议员共进晚餐时再次出现合作论，以及前党首郑清来在YouTube直播中提及明年1月为合作期限后，他批评道：“不要让克服内乱联盟和民主大联盟沦为民主党内斗的牺牲品”。辛代表表示：“不接受把国内政治用、局面转换用、打破局面用的合作牌”，并把恢复民主党的信任、对今年1月讨论合作期间针对革新党提出的秘密协议论、意识形态嫌疑等正式道歉，以及价值观与愿景的共识作为前提。他接着说：“现在最重要的是整个阵营如何凝聚力量”，并解释称，合作与选举联盟等一样，也是为下一届大选和总统选举赢得民主进步阵营胜利的可选方案之一。辛代表当天还强调“清算内乱”，敦促民主党：“在5日全体会议上处理赵熙大弹劾案，并在12月3日内乱发生两周之际，让所有‘防止内乱法案’全部通过”。他提到的防止内乱法案包括强化宣布戒严条件的戒严法修正案、限制对内乱犯人大赦的大赦法修正案等。他还强调有必要废除法院行政处。辛代表表示：“既然大韩民国史无前例地产生了巨额财力，就也需要把钱花在让国民大吃一惊的 drastic 大转换上”，并提议“另行设立不平等两极化特别账户，投资100万亿韩元用于住房稳定”。他建议把其余超额税收投入照护、就业、教育等领域，同时强调有必要设立国会不平等纾解特别委员会和总统直属不平等应对委员会。他还表示，将在5日以党名义提出《为保障机会公平和社会基本权利而消除不平等两极化特别法》，今后还将提出《限制税收特例法》《住房基本法》《城市及住房环境整备法》等旨在保障住房稳定的配套法案。辛代表预告，27日迎来创党1000天之际，将以研究党的纲领和中期前景的“愿景实验室”为核心，公开载有革新党新愿景的“革新项目”。报道可使用KakaoTalk okjebo发送。版权所有© 韩联社，禁止擅自转载、复制及用于人工智能训练与利用。2026年11月3日14时43分发稿。（首尔＝韩联社）移动记者＝祖国革新党辛长植代表3日在国会举行上任100天记者会。2026.11.3 eastsea@yna.co.kr（首尔＝韩联社）移动记者＝祖国革新党辛长植代表3日在国会举行上任100天记者会。2026.11.3 eastsea@yna.co.kr
