https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110312.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 김지헌 기자 = 외교부는 오는 13일 일본 니가타현 사도시에서 사도광산 강제동원 한국인 희생자를 위한 추도식을 개최한다고 3일 밝혔다. 박두순 외교부 대변인은 이날 정례브리핑에서 이렇게 밝히면서 "추도식에는 정부대표인 이혁 주일대사를 비롯한 정부 관계자 및 우리 유가족 9명이 참석할 예정"이라고 전했다. 이어 "추도식이 끝난 후에는 한국인 노동자 기숙사 터를 방문해 헌화하고, 한국인 노동자 관련 주요 장소들을 방문해 추모하는 시간을 가질 것"이라고 덧붙였다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110312.summary_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者金智贤＝外交部3日宣布，将于13日在日本新潟县佐渡市举行追悼仪式，纪念被强制征用的佐渡矿山韩国人遇难者。外交部发言人朴斗顺当天在例行记者会上表示：“政府代表、韩国常驻大使李赫等政府相关人士以及我们的9名家属将出席追悼仪式。”他又说：“追悼仪式结束后，我们将前往韩国劳工宿舍遗址敬献花束，并参观与韩国劳工有关的主要场所，举行追悼活动。”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110312.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 김지헌 기자 = 외교부는 오는 13일 일본 니가타현 사도시에서 사도광산 강제동원 한국인 희생자를 위한 추도식을 개최한다고 3일 밝혔다. 박두순 외교부 대변인은 이날 정례브리핑에서 이렇게 밝히면서 "추도식에는 정부대표인 이혁 주일대사를 비롯한 정부 관계자 및 우리 유가족 9명이 참석할 예정"이라고 전했다. 이어 "추도식이 끝난 후에는 한국인 노동자 기숙사 터를 방문해 헌화하고, 한국인 노동자 관련 주요 장소들을 방문해 추모하는 시간을 가질 것"이라고 덧붙였다. 앞서 일본 정부는 지난달 12일 외무성 국장급이 대표로 참석하는 사도광산 추도식을 개최했고, 조선인 강제 노동은 언급하지 않았다. 사도광산 추도식은 일본이 2024년 7월 사도광산의 세계유산 등재를 추진하는 과정에서 한국이 조선인 강제노동을 포함한 전체 역사를 반영할 것을 요구하자 한국 측 협조를 얻기 위해 약속한 사항이다. 하지만 일본이 2024년 첫 추도식을 준비하면서부터 조선인 노동의 강제성을 인정하지 않는 태도를 보여 한국 정부는 별도의 추도식을 매년 열고 있다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/03 14:43 송고 2026년11월03일 14시43분 송고 (사도[일본]=연합뉴스) 경수현 특파원 = 한국 정부가 21일 일본 니가타현 사도섬 사도 광산에서 강제노역한 조선인 희생자의 한국인 유족들을 위한 추모식을 현지에서 열었다. 사진은 헌배하는 유족들의 모습. 2025.11.21 evan@yna.co.kr
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110312.title_zh: 韩国政府13日在日本举行佐渡矿山追悼式，连续3年与日本分别举办
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110312.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者金志宪＝韩国外交部3日宣布，将于13日在日本新潟县佐渡市举行佐渡金山强制征用韩国人遇难者追悼仪式。外交部发言人朴斗顺当天在例行记者会上表示：“政府代表、驻日大使李赫等政府相关人士以及我们的9名家属将出席追悼仪式。”他补充说：“追悼仪式结束后，将前往韩国劳工宿舍遗址献花，并探访与韩国劳工有关的主要场所，留出时间悼念他们。”此前，日本政府已于上月12日举行佐渡金山追悼仪式，由外务省审议官级官员代表出席，但未提及朝鲜人强制劳动。佐渡金山追悼仪式是日本为推进佐渡金山于2024年7月列入《世界遗产名录》而与韩方约定的相关措施；当时，日本方面为争取韩方合作，答应在申遗过程中反映包括朝鲜人强制劳动在内的完整历史。然而，自日本着手筹备2024年首届追悼仪式以来，日本方面始终表现出不承认朝鲜人劳动具有强制性的态度，因此韩国政府每年另行举行追悼仪式。稿件可通过KakaoTalk okjebo联系（版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再分发及用于人工智能训练和使用）2026/11/03 14:43发稿 2026年11月3日14时43分发稿（佐渡[日本]＝韩联社）特派记者京秀贤＝韩国政府21日在日本新潟县佐渡岛佐渡金山当地举行追悼仪式，悼念被强制服劳役的朝鲜人遇难者的韩国亲属。图为家属献花。2025.11.21 evan@yna.co.kr

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110311.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者吴奎真报道：国会运营委员会于3日以执政党民主党为主导通过了组建“支持地方主导增长的超广域战略产业特区特别委员会”的决议案，以支持政府的3大巨型项目。特别委员会将审议关于超广域战略产业特区指定与运营的相关事项，以及赋予监管优惠的所谓《超广域战略产业特区特别法（草案）》（超广域特区法）。产业界与劳工界意见尖锐对立，针对高收入、研究岗位劳动者适用每周52小时制例外的优惠规定等事项，预计将成为特别委员会的主要议题。特别委员会的运作期限截至明年1月30日。国会运营委员会在野党事务委员、国民力量党议员金承秀表示：“特别委员会是极为例外才会设立的机构。产业通商资源委员会、政策协调委员会、气候环境委员会这些机构，过去连认真讨论都没有过吧。”他还批评称：“对仓促提交组建决议案的做法，我在程序上感到遗憾。”执政党事务委员、民主党议员千俊浩表示：“迅速建设并打造半导体集群等产业集聚园区，比任何时候都更加重要。”他说：“希望这不会成为国民力量党反对在光州军机场建设半导体集群的意向表示。”如有线索请通过KakaoTalk联系okjebo。版权所有© 韩联社，禁止擅自转载、转发及用于AI学习和应用。2026年11月3日14:41发布。2026年11月3日14时41分于首尔发布。（首尔=韩联社）记者李东海报道：国民力量党议员金泰圭于30日在国会运营委员会对国会事务处等机构进行国政监察后，向监察委员长韩炳斗提出抗议，随后离场。2026.10.30 eastsea@yna.co.kr

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/curr.body: •Demand deposits climb 71% •Analysts highlight cash dependence, financial inclusion challenges Currency held outside the banking system by Nigerians rose by 103.8 per cent to N4.923 trillion in September 2026 from N2.416 trillion in September 2023, highlighting the persistent demand for physical cash despite the expansion of electronic payment channels in the country. Data from the Central Bank of Nigeria, CBN, Money and Credit Statistics, also showed that currency outside banks increased by 10.3 per cent year-on-year from N4.465 trillion in September 2025 to N4.923 trillion in September 2026. The figures indicate that cash held outside the banking system has more than doubled in three years, reflecting the scale of currency demand within the economy and the challenges facing efforts to deepen the use of formal banking and electronic payment systems. A breakdown of the data showed that currency outside banks increased by 66.2 per cent from N2.416 trillion in September 2023 to N4.016 trillion in September 2024. The figure subsequently rose to N4.465 trillion in September 2025, an increase of 11.2 per cent from the corresponding period in 2024, before climbing further to N4.923 trillion in September 2026. According to analysts, the latest increase indicates that the preference for cash transactions remains significant, notwithstanding the growing adoption of mobile banking, electronic transfers, point-of-sale terminals and other digital payment platforms. Meanwhile, demand deposits in the banking system increased by 70.8 per cent to N39.124 trillion in September 2026 from N22.903 trillion in September 2023. The CBN data showed that demand deposits rose to N31.842 trillion in September 2024, representing an increase of 39.0 per cent against the corresponding period in 2023. The figure climbed further to N34.642 trillion in September 2025, an increase of 8.8 per cent year-on-year, before rising to N39.124 trillion in September 2026, representing a 12.9 per cent increase over September 2025. The growth in demand deposits indicates an expansion in funds held in bank accounts that are generally accessible for payments and withdrawals on demand. Reacting to this data, Clifford Egbomeade, Economic and Communications expert, said: “The simultaneous increase in demand deposits and currency outside banks points to the coexistence of formal banking balances and substantial demand for physical cash in Nigeria’s payment system. ‘‘However, the two indicators measure different components of monetary activity. Demand deposits represent bank-account balances, while currency outside banks represents cash held outside the banking system. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/curr.title_zh: 银行外流通货币三年增长104%
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/curr.body_zh: •活期存款增长71% •分析人士指出对现金的依赖及普惠金融挑战 尼日利亚人存放在银行体系外的现金从2023年9月的2.416万亿奈拉增至2026年9月的4.923万亿奈拉，增幅为103.8%，尽管该国电子支付渠道不断扩展，实体现金需求依然旺盛。尼日利亚中央银行CBN的货币与信贷统计数据显示，银行体系外流通的货币从2025年9月的4.465万亿奈拉增至2026年9月的4.923万亿奈拉，同比增幅为10.3%。这些数字表明，银行体系外持有的现金在3年内增长了一倍以上，反映出经济体内现金需求的规模，以及深化正规银行和电子支付系统使用所面临的挑战。数据明细显示，银行体系外流通的货币从2023年9月的2.416万亿奈拉增至2024年9月的4.016万亿奈拉，增幅为66.2%。此后，这一数字在2025年9月升至4.465万亿奈拉，较2024年同期增长11.2%，随后在2026年9月进一步升至4.923万亿奈拉。分析人士称，最新增幅表明，尽管移动银行、电子转账、销售终端及其他数字支付平台的采用率不断提高，人们对现金交易的偏好仍然十分显著。与此同时，银行体系内的活期存款从2023年9月的22.903万亿奈拉增至2026年9月的39.124万亿奈拉，增幅为70.8%。CBN数据显示，活期存款在2024年9月升至31.842万亿奈拉，较2023年同期增长39.0%。这一数字在2025年9月进一步升至34.642万亿奈拉，同比增长8.8%，随后在2026年9月升至39.124万亿奈拉，较2025年9月增长12.9%。活期存款的增长表明，银行账户中的资金规模扩大，这些资金通常可按需用于支付和提取。针对这组数据，经济与传播问题专家Clifford Egbomeade表示：“活期存款与银行体系外流通的货币同步增长，表明尼日利亚支付体系中正规银行余额与对实体现金的大量需求并存。不过，这两个指标衡量的是货币活动的不同组成部分。活期存款代表银行账户余额，而银行体系外流通的货币则代表存放在银行体系外的现金。此处表达的意见并不反映Vanguard报纸或其任何员工的观点

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.body: The Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission (NUPRC) has urged investors to take advantage of Nigeria’s 2026 oil and gas licensing round, highlighting the country’s improving investment climate amid growing global energy uncertainties. The Commission Chief Executive, Oritsemeyiwa Eyesan, made the call on Monday during a roundtable discussion titled ‘Energy Sovereignty in an Interconnected World: Aligning National Priorities, Markets and Global Security’, at the 2026 ADIPEC Exhibition and Conference in Abu Dhabi. Ms Eyesan told investors that Nigeria offers a stable investment environment and announced that the licensing round portal would officially open on 20 November 2026. She urged prospective investors to explore the opportunities presented by the 2026 Licensing Round, which offers 40 oil and gas blocks. “We are expecting investors to turn to Nigeria. We are going into another licensing round, and we will launch our bid portal on November 20. We expect to see interested investors because the environment is a lot more competitive,” she said. “We have set a very attractive fiscal framework for investors. The overall environment is much more secure. We have been able to manage costs with a lot of incentives for investors, and we expect to see investors take up the offer when we open the portal.” The NUPRC chief executive said Nigeria’s investment climate had improved following the enactment of the Petroleum Industry Act (PIA) in 2021 and the executive orders signed by President Bola Tinubu. According to her, between 2021 and 2026, the commission conducted at least four successful licensing rounds, attracting additional investments into the country. She said this represented a departure from the pre-PIA era, when licensing rounds were less frequent. Ms Eyesan also highlighted Nigeria’s enormous gas potential, noting that the country holds an estimated 215 trillion cubic feet (TCF) of gas reserves but produces barely seven billion cubic feet (bcf) daily. She said the gap between available reserves and current production presented significant opportunities for investors, particularly with major gas infrastructure projects in the pipeline. “The stars are already aligned. For gas infrastructure, we just completed very major infrastructure projects that will unlock gas supply in the country and the sub-region. “We talk about two major projects on the drawing board to move gas through the Nigeria-Morocco Atlantic Gas Pipeline and Trans-Sahara Gas Pipeline. Again, this gas will go to Europe and will also meet regional demand. So, Nigeria is positioned to meet not just domestic supply,” the NUPRC chief executive said. Ms Eyesan maintained that competition for investment in the global petroleum industry had intensified as more countries discovered oil and gas resources. She said Nigeria had taken steps to position itself ahead of the competition by introducing reforms and making adjustments to attract the right category of investment. “We understand that investors will prize execution risk, cost, delays and also uncertainty, and so what we have done in Nigeria is to ensure that we guard against these risks and then attract the investment required to enable us to unlock the huge resources we sit on,” she said. On 7 October, the NUPRC announced the 2026 Licensing Round, offering 40 oil and gas blocks to prospective investors. The announcement came less than three months after the commission concluded the bidding programme for its 2025 licensing round. PREMIUM TIMES reported that 31 companies emerged as winners of 37 oil and gas blocks in the 2025 Licensing Round after the commercial bid conference held in Abuja in July. The bidding process, conducted at the Transcorp Event Centre, attracted 143 companies, which submitted about 200 bids for 37 of the 50 oil and gas blocks offered by the commission. The blocks span several terrains, including the Niger Delta onshore, shallow-water and deep-offshore areas, as well as the Benin, Anambra and Chad basins and the Benue Trough. While 37 blocks attracted bids, the remaining 13 received no offers. The NUPRC described the outcome as significant, noting that it was the first time Nigeria’s frontier basins, including the Benue Trough, Chad Basin, Anambra Basin and Benin Basin, had attracted such strong investor interest. Following the 2025 licensing round, the commission also outlined plans to increase crude oil production by restoring more than 788,000 barrels per day of shut-in production and advancing offshore projects valued at an estimated $30 billion to $50 billion towards final investment decisions

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.body_zh: 尼日利亚上游石油监管委员会（NUPRC）敦促投资者把握尼日利亚2026年油气许可轮的机遇。委员会首席执行官Oritsemeyiwa Eyesan星期一在阿布扎比举行的2026年ADIPEC展览与会议上，出席题为“互联世界中的能源主权：协调国家优先事项、市场与全球安全”的圆桌讨论时发出上述呼吁。Eyesan女士告诉投资者，尼日利亚提供稳定的投资环境，并宣布许可轮申请门户将于2026年11月20日正式开放。她敦促有意投资者探索2026年许可轮带来的机遇，该轮提供40个油气区块。“我们期待投资者转向尼日利亚。我们即将启动新一轮许可，并将于11月20日开放投标门户。鉴于这里的竞争环境更具吸引力，我们预计会吸引有意投资的经营者。”她说，“我们为投资者制定了极具吸引力的财政框架。整体环境更加安全。我们通过提供大量激励措施来帮助投资者管理成本，并期待门户开放后投资者积极认购。NUPRC首席执行官表示，自2021年《石油工业法》（PIA）颁布以及总统Bola Tinubu签署行政命令以来，尼日利亚的投资环境有所改善。她说，2021年至2026年间，该委员会至少成功举办了4轮许可，为尼日利亚吸引了更多投资。这与PIA实施前许可轮举办频率较低的时期不同。Eyesan女士还强调了尼日利亚巨大的天然气潜力，指出该国估计拥有215万亿立方英尺（TCF）的天然气储量，但日产量仅为70亿立方英尺（bcf）。她说，现有储量与当前产量之间的差距为投资者提供了重大机遇，尤其是随着多项大型天然气基础设施项目即将推进。“各项条件已经成熟。在天然气基础设施方面，我们刚刚完成了几项重大基础设施项目，将释放尼日利亚及次区域的天然气供应。我们正在规划两个重大项目，通过尼日利亚—摩洛哥大西洋天然气管道和跨撒哈拉天然气管道输送天然气。这些天然气还将输往欧洲，同时满足区域需求。因此，尼日利亚已做好满足不仅仅是国内供应需求的准备。”NUPRC首席执行官说。随着更多国家发现油气资源，全球石油行业对投资的竞争日益激烈。她表示，尼日利亚已通过推行改革和作出调整，吸引适合的投资，从而率先占据竞争位置。“我们明白，投资者会重视执行风险、成本、延误以及不确定性。因此，我们所做的是确保在尼日利亚防范这些风险，进而吸引释放我们坐拥的庞大资源所需的投资。”她说。10月7日，NUPRC宣布启动2026年许可轮，向有意投资者提供40个油气区块。公告发布时，距离该委员会结束2025年许可轮投标项目还不到3个月。PREMIUM TIMES报道称，在7月于阿布贾举行的商务投标会议后，31家公司成为2025年许可轮37个油气区块的中标者。投标程序在Transcorp Event Centre举行，共吸引143家公司提交约200份投标书，竞逐该委员会提供的50个油气区块中的37个。这些区块横跨多种地形，包括尼日尔三角洲陆上区域、浅水和深水海域，以及贝宁盆地、阿南帕盆地、乍得盆地和贝努埃 trough。37个区块吸引了投标，其余13个区块无人投标。NUPRC称这一成果意义重大，并指出这是尼日利亚边远地区盆地首次吸引如此强劲的投资兴趣，其中包括贝努埃 trough、乍得盆地、阿南帕盆地和贝宁盆地。2025年许可轮结束后，该委员会还提出增产计划，包括恢复每日超过788,000桶的停产原油产量，并推动估值估计在300亿至500亿美元之间的海上项目进入最终投资决定阶段

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110208.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 박성진 기자 = 다케다 료타 일한의원연맹 회장은 3일 국제사회의 대전환기를 맞아 한국과 일본이 에너지와 첨단기술 분야 등에서 협력하는 것이 필요하다고 강조했다. 다케다 회장은 이날 국가기간뉴스통신사 연합뉴스가 서울 중구 더그랜드롯데 서울에서 개최한 '2026 미래경제포럼' 축사에서 이같이 밝혔다. 포럼은 '분절화하는 글로벌 경제, 하나로 잇는 한일 시장'을 주제로 세계 경제의 블록화와 분절화가 가속하는 가운데 지속 가능한 성장을 위한 한일 협력 방안을 모색하기 위해 마련됐다. 일본 정계의 대표적 지한파인 다케다 회장은 총무상, 국가공안위원장 등 핵심 각료를 지낸 8선 의원이다. 지난 3월 스가 요시히데 전 총리의 뒤를 이어 초당파 의원 모임인 일한의원연맹의 회장으로 취임했다. 다케다 회장은 축사에서 "세계 경제의 불확실성이 높아지고 에너지 안전보장, 공급망 강인화(강화), 첨단 기술을 둘러싼 경쟁 등 한 국가로는 해결할 수 없는 과제가 산적해 있다"고 진단했다. 그는 "이런 시대이기에 이웃 나라인 일본과 한국은 서로의 강점을 살리고 지혜를 모으며 협력을 심화해 나가는 것이 그 어느 때보다 중요해지고 있다"고 역설했다. "에너지의 안정적 공급, 경제 안전보장, 첨단산업 분야의 기술 혁신, 차세대를 위한 인재 육성에서 양국이 협력을 강화하는 것은 일본과 한국의 경제 발전에 기여할 뿐 아니라 동아시아 전체의 안정과 번영, 나아가 국제사회의 지속적 발전과도 연결된 것이라고 확신한다"고 밝혔다. 다케다 회장은 "일한 관계는 단순히 유지하는 것만으로 충분하지 않고 다음 세대에 더 좋은 관계를 물려줘야 한다"며 "이를 위해서는 정치 대화뿐 아니라 기업과 연구자, 젊은 세대가 국경을 넘어 자유롭게 교류하고 새로운 가치를 만들어 내는 것이 필수적"이라고 말했다. 과거사 문제와 관련해서는 "일본과 한국은 각각의 역사가 있으며 입장 차이도 있다"며 "그러나 그런 차이가 있기에 대화를 거듭하고 상호 이해를 넓히며, 공통의 이익을 찾아 나가는 노력이 필요하다"고 당부했다. 다케다 회장은 "과거를 직시하면서도 미래를 향한 발걸음을 멈추지 않는 것이 중요하다"며 "정치에는 이를 위한 환경을 만들고 양국의 협력을 흔들림 없도록 만들 책임이 있다"고 덧붙였다. 그는 "일한의원연맹 회장으로서 정부 간 외교를 뒷받침하는 동시에 정치, 경제, 문화, 인적 교류 등 폭넓은 분야에서 양국 간 신뢰 관계를 한층 심화해 나가고자 한다"고 다짐했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/03 14:32 송고 2026년11월03일 14시32분 송고

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110208.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者朴成真报道称，日韩议员联盟会长武田良太3日强调，面对国际社会的重大转型，韩国和日本有必要在能源、高新技术等领域开展合作。武田会长当天在国家 기간뉴스통신社韩联社于首尔中区Grand Lot Seoul举办的“2026未来经济论坛”上发表上述讲话。论坛以“日益分裂的全球经济与连为一体的日韩市场”为主题，旨在世界经济集团化和分化加速之际，探讨日韩为实现可持续增长而合作的方案。武田良太是日本政界具有代表性的鹰派人物，也曾担任总务大臣、国家公安委员会委员长等核心职务，是一名连续任职8届的议员。今年3月，在前首相菅义伟之后，他接任由跨党派议员组成的日韩议员联盟会长。武田会长在致辞中指出：“世界经济不确定性加剧，能源安全保障、供应链强化（强化）以及围绕高新技术的竞争等课题不断涌现，单凭一个国家无法解决。”他强调：“正因身处这样的时代，作为邻国的日本和韩国发挥彼此优势、凝聚智慧并深化合作，比以往任何时候都更加重要。”他表示：“确信两国在稳定供应能源、保障经济安全、推动高新产业技术创新以及培养下一代人才等方面加强合作，不仅会促进日本和韩国经济发展，也将同整个东亚的稳定与繁荣，乃至国际社会的持续发展产生联系。”武田会长表示：“日韩关系不能仅仅停留在维持现状，还必须为下一代留下更好的关系。为此，除了政治对话，还必须让企业和研究人员、年轻一代跨越国界自由交流，创造新的价值。”谈及历史问题，他表示：“日本和韩国各自拥有自己的历史，立场也存在差异。但正因为存在这些差异，双方才需要反复对话、扩大相互理解，并努力寻找共同利益。”武田会长强调：“重要的是，在正视过去的同时，不停下迈向未来的脚步。政界有责任为此营造环境，使两国合作不受动摇。”他补充道：“作为日韩议员联盟会长，我将在支撑政府间外交的同时，致力于在政治、经济、文化和人员交流等广泛领域进一步深化两国间的信任关系。”如有侵权，请联系KakaoTalk okjebo。版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、重新发布以及用于人工智能学习和应用。2026/11/03 14:32发稿，2026年11月03日14时32分发稿。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110311.title_zh: 延川郡、楊州市入选京畿北部教育改革领先地区
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110311.body_zh: （政府=韩联社）记者卢承赫报道称，教育部门3日公布的“2027年度教育创新先导地区指定结果”中，京畿道北部的연천군和杨州市入选。入选地区每年可获得最高20亿韩元的特别教育补助金，如达到绩效评估标准，还可追加运营2年。연천군将保留小型学校定制教育等地方优势，并通过校际共同教育课程和社区联动，弥补小型学校难以提供的教育课程以及职业规划、体验机会。鉴于此次指定不以调整学校规模为目的，该郡计划通过加强校际联动、重组教育环境和设置融合型学校等多种方式，为学生提供更好的教育环境和教育机会，并提高学校竞争力。杨州市将以“超越学校、由地区共同打造的新教育——杨州”为愿景，推进教育创新先导地区的工作方向和核心事业，包括让任何人公平学习的杨州型共享教育、在地区放飞梦想的杨州型职业生涯教育，以及地区共同成长的杨州型区域教育生态系统等三大课题。杨州市还将面向小型学校开展RAS（阅读Reading、艺术文化Arts、体育Sports）共同教育，并以地区大学为据点，为普通高中提供职业教育以及就业、升学、创业衔接支持。此次指定中落选的 고양市此前曾积极与高雄教育支援厅合作，希望通过明年教育创新先导地区的指定延续面向学校现场的支持项目，但对结果表示遗憾。市政府有关人士表示：“今后计划与京畿道教育厅、高雄教育支援厅等教育部门构建更积极的协作体系，推出各种教育创新方案。”如有侵权，请联系KakaoTalk okjebo。版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、重新发布以及用于人工智能学习和应用。2026/11/03 14:36发稿，2026年11月03日14时36分发稿。

https://leadership.ng/benue-gunmen-abduc.summary_zh: 这起事件再次引发了对奥图克波—奥戈比亚—阿多卡走廊沿线安全局势的担忧。就在不到5个月前，另一支送葬队伍在运送遗体途中遭绑架。居民称，他们于星期六上午在路边发现一辆被遗弃的车辆，车内有一名女子的遗体。奥洛图解释称，死者的丈夫居住在卡诺，已与另外5人踏上长途旅程，将她的遗体送往奥克波加安葬。
https://leadership.ng/benue-gunmen-abduc.body: The victims were reportedly kidnapped on Friday night along the Adoka axis of Otukpo Local Government Area, while the attackers abandoned the deceased woman’s body inside the vehicle. The incident has raised fresh concerns over insecurity along the Otukpo–Ogobia–Adoka corridor, where another group of mourners conveying a corpse was abducted less than five months ago. According to a report by Daily Trust, the latest victims were intercepted at about 8pm while approaching their destination, with their journey reportedly cut short barely an hour before they were expected to arrive. Residents said they discovered an abandoned vehicle along the road on Saturday morning, with the corpse of a woman inside. They subsequently realised that the occupants had been taken away by the attackers. Officials of the Federal Road Safety Corps (FRSC) were said to have arrived at the scene and evacuated the corpse to a morgue in Adoka town. An Idoma community social media influencer, Meddy Olotu, who said he had spoken with members of the bereaved husband’s family, disclosed that the abductors had contacted the family and demanded N15 million for the release of the six victims. Olotu explained that the deceased woman’s husband, who is based in Kano, had embarked on the long journey with five other persons to convey her remains to Okpoga for burial. He said communication with the victims suddenly stopped as they approached Otukpo, approximately 35 kilometres from Adoka, where the abduction reportedly occurred. According to him, the kidnappers took the six occupants into the bush, leaving the woman’s corpse inside their vehicle. The incident is the second reported abduction involving mourners conveying the remains of a deceased relative along the corridor in less than five months. In July 2026, three siblings travelling from Abuja to Benue State with their late mother’s remains were reportedly kidnapped between Omutele and Ankpechi communities along the Ogobia–Adoka Road in Oglewu District of Ohimini Local Government Area. Confirming the latest incident, Chairman of Otukpo Local Government Area, Prince Maxwell Ogiri, described the abduction as unfortunate and traumatic. Ogiri, who disclosed that the driver of the vehicle was his friend, confirmed that the kidnappers were demanding N15 million ransom. He, however, said security agencies had commenced operations to secure the release of the victims. The FRSC Information Officer, Ngozi Ahula, also confirmed that officials of the command evacuated the deceased woman’s body from the scene. She said she had verified the incident through FRSC officials in the area. Similarly, the Police Public Relations Officer (PPRO) for Benue State Command, DSP Peter Aondongu, confirmed the abduction, saying it occurred on Friday. Aondongu added that security operatives were making efforts to rescue the six abducted persons. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/benue-gunmen-abduc.title_zh: 贝努埃：枪手绑架丈夫及另外5名送妻子遗体返乡者，索要1,500万奈拉
https://leadership.ng/benue-gunmen-abduc.body_zh: 据报道，受害者于周五夜间在奥图克波地方政府的阿多卡路段遭绑架，袭击者则将遇害女性的遗体弃置在车内。这起事件再次引发了对奥图克波—奥戈比亚—阿多卡走廊安全局势的关注；就在不到五个月前，另一支送葬队伍在运送遗体途中也曾遭人绑架。据《Daily Trust》报道，最新一批受害者约在晚上8点接近目的地时遭拦截，其行程据称在预计抵达前不到一小时便被迫中止。居民称，他们于周六早晨在路边发现一辆弃置车辆，车内有一具女性遗体，随后才意识到车内人员已被袭击者带走。据称，联邦道路安全委员会（FRSC）工作人员已抵达现场，并将遗体送往阿多卡镇的太平间。伊多马族社区社交媒体影响者Meddy Olotu表示，他已与死者丈夫的家人交谈，并透露绑匪曾联系该家庭，要求支付N15 million赎金才肯释放6名受害者。Olotu解释称，死者丈夫驻卡诺，他与另外5人踏上漫长旅程，准备将遗体运往奥克波加安葬。他说，当众人接近奥图克波时，与外界的联系突然中断；奥图克波距阿多卡约35公里，绑架据称就发生在那里。据他介绍，绑匪将车内6人带入丛林，把那名女性的遗体留在车内。这已是不到五个月内，该走廊第二次发生送葬队伍在运送亲属遗体时遭绑架的事件。2026年7月，3名兄弟姐妹据称在携带已故母亲遗体从阿布贾前往贝努埃州途中，于奥希米尼地方政府辖区奥格莱武区的奥戈比亚—阿多卡公路上，在奥穆特莱与安克佩奇社区之间遭绑架。奥图克波地方政府主席Prince Maxwell Ogiri证实了最新事件，并将这起绑架形容为不幸且令人创伤。Ogiri透露，涉事车辆司机是他的朋友，并确认绑匪索要N15 million赎金。不过他说，安全机构已启动行动，以争取确保受害者获释。FRSC新闻官Ngozi Ahula也证实，指挥部工作人员已从现场转移遇害女性的遗体。她表示，已通过该地区FRSC工作人员核实此事。同样，贝努埃州警察局公共关系官（PPRO）DSP Peter Aondongu也证实了绑架事件，称事件发生于周五。Aondongu补充说，安全人员正 efforts 努力营救6名被绑架者。我们掌握独家优势。实时报道、独家内幕和深度视角直接送达你的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS，在WhatsApp上获取全天候更新 →

https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/del.summary_zh: 瓦什什塔先生周一（2026年11月2日）上午加入约100名警员，聚集在德里警察总部1号门外，要求会见图拉普尔警监阿努拉格·库马尔，讨论沙赫达拉警察站近期与律师发生的冲突事件。由于全市律师为处理一宗涉及律师拉利特·班萨尔的袭击案而发起无限期罢工，瓦什什塔副警监和沙赫达拉警察站站长阿伦·库马尔随后被调职。
https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/del.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) Manasvi Vashishta, who led a protest by Delhi Police personnel outside the force’s headquarters on Monday (November 2, 2026) following a clash with lawyers, has been placed under suspension for “violation of discipline”, Delhi Police sources told The Hindu on Tuesday (November 3., 2026). Mr. Vashishta joined around 100 police personnel who gathered outside Gate No. 1 of the Delhi Police headquarters on Monday (November 2, 2026) morning, demanding a meeting with the Police Commissioner Anurag Kumar over the recent fiasco with lawyers at the Shahdara police station. ACP Vashishta and Arun Kumar, the Station House Officer of the Shahdara police station, were transferred following an indefinite strike called by city lawyers over the handling of an assault case involving advocate Lalit Bansal. The protest began around 8 a.m., with personnel holding placards and posters and demanding a meeting with Police Commissioner Anurag Kumar and reinstatement of the two officials. After nearly three hours, Mr. Anurag Kumar and other senior officers met the protesters and heard their demands. According to a police officer, the personnel raised five demands, including a standard operating procedure for handling confrontations involving lawyers, restricting the number of lawyers entering a police station to five at a time, and registering FIRs against lawyers allegedly involved in misconduct towards police personnel. They also sought a dedicated cell at police headquarters to address complaints against lawyers, including recommending action against their Bar Council licences, and the deployment of police personnel in courts, depending on their size, to deal with incidents of violence and misbehaviour. “We have placed our demands before the Commissioner. He provided us with the meeting that we had requested. Not many people got the opportunity to speak openly. Nevertheless, we have conveyed our demands to him, and they are being discussed,” Mr. Vashishta had said during the protest. The transfers followed an October 23 altercation at Shahdara police station in which an advocate allegedly sustained a head injury. District court lawyers subsequently launched an indefinite strike, alleging that Mr. Vashishta and Mr. Arun Kumar had threatened advocates who went to the police station over the handling of the assault case. They demanded action against the officers concerned. Mr. Vashishta, who was serving as Sub-Divisional Police Officer (SDPO), Gandhi Nagar, was transferred to the Special Police Unit for Women and Children, while Mr. Arun Kumar was moved to the Security Branch. https://www.myjoyonline.com/nia-develops.body: The National Identification Authority (NIA) is preparing to introduce a mobile application that will allow individuals and small businesses to verify identities through the Ghana Card biometric system without having to access its main verification platform. The application is intended to widen access to identity verification services, particularly for users who may find it difficult to meet the certification and administrative requirements for institutional access to the Authority’s main platform. Its development follows the NIA’s enforcement of the National Identity Register (Amendment) Regulations, 2026 (L.I. 2523), which prohibit the photocopying, scanning and visual inspection of Ghana Cards as methods of identity verification. Speaking at a press briefing in Accra on Monday, November 2, 2026, the NIA’s Director of Corporate Affairs, Williams Ampomah Emmanuel Darlas, said the application would provide a straightforward “yes or no” response to confirm whether a person’s biometric identity matches the information presented. He explained that institutions seeking access to the main verification platform must first obtain certification from the Data Protection Commission, a requirement that could pose challenges for individuals and smaller businesses. “Those who will have the certification, we have a platform we get them on-boarded onto. Those who would not have it, we have developed an app, a mobile app for them, where you can get a yes or no,” he said. Mr Darlas said access to the main platform was not necessarily expensive, with charges varying according to the verification needs and operational processes of individual institutions. “The cost for getting on-boarded onto the verification platform, some institutions are paying as low as 10 pesewas for verification services to the National Identification Authority. So it is not much, depending on the workflow of your institution,” he added. He said the mobile application was designed to bridge the access gap and make biometric verification available to a broader range of users. He also assured the public that safeguards had been incorporated to protect personal information and prevent unauthorised disclosure through the application

https://www.myjoyonline.com/nia-develops.body_zh: 国家身份管理局（NIA）正准备推出一款移动应用程序，让个人和小企业无需访问其主要身份核验平台，即可通过加纳卡生物识别系统核验身份。该应用旨在扩大身份核验服务的可及性，尤其是方便那些可能难以满足机构接入该管理局主要平台所需的认证和行政要求的用户。此项开发是在NIA执行《2026年国家身份登记册（修正）条例》（L.I. 2523）之后开展的，该条例禁止以复印、扫描和目视检查加纳卡作为身份核验方式。NIA企业事务主任Williams Ampomah Emmanuel Darlas于2026年11月2日星期一在阿克拉举行的新闻发布会上表示，该应用将提供简单直接的“是或否”结果，以确认个人的生物识别身份是否与所提交的信息一致。他解释道，希望接入主要核验平台的机构必须先获得数据保护委员会的认证，而这一要求可能给个人和较小企业带来障碍。他说：“对于能够获得认证的机构，我们有一个平台，可以帮助他们接入。对于无法获得认证的机构，我们开发了一款应用，一款移动应用，用户可以通过它获得‘是或否’的结果。”Darlas先生表示，接入主要平台的费用并不一定昂贵，收费标准因各机构的核验需求和运营流程而异。他补充说：“有些机构接入核验平台时，向国家身份管理局支付的费用低至10塞西，用于身份核验服务。因此，费用并不高，具体取决于你所在机构的工作流程。”他说，这款移动应用旨在弥合接入差距，让更广泛的用户都能使用生物识别核验服务。他还向公众保证，已采取相应保障措施保护个人信息，并防止通过该应用发生未经授权的信息披露……

Unlock these with Subscription Days after Maldives President Mohamed Muizzu visited Pakistan for a bilateral visit that yielded many agreements, the former Foreign Minister of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid, accused him of moving in an “anti- India ” direction. Also read | Defence pacts with India being amended, says Maldives Mr. Shahid, who is running for the leadership of the opposition Maldivian Democratic Party (MDP) ahead of the Presidential elections in 2028, alleged that Mr. Muizzu, who has had a cordial relationship with New Delhi for most of his tenure, would revive the “India Out” campaign of 2023. “The President [Mr. Muizzu] is trying to make India the issue again, because for him, he hasn’t been able to perform. He hasn’t been able to provide any development or deliver on any of the promises, and therefore, come next election again, he will try to create some narrative on hate,” Mr. Shahid, who was Foreign Minister during the tenure of the previous President Ibrahim Solih (2018-2023) and won a term as the President of the UN General Assembly with India’s support in 2021, told The Hindu in an interview here. The Maldives government spokesperson did not reply to a request for a response to Mr. Shahid’s comments. Mr. Shahid called for more transparency about 20 MoUs signed between the Maldives and Pakistan when President Muizzu went on a three-day visit to Islamabad from October 20 to 22, the first such visit by a Maldives President since 2015. After talks between Mr. Muizzu and Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, the two sides announced agreements in a number of areas, including defence and maritime security, combating illicit trafficking and narcotics, information technology, cybersecurity and AI. They agreed to start direct flights between Male and Islamabad. In particular, Mr. Muizzu’s meeting with Pakistan’s Field Marshal and Army chief General Asim Munir had raised eyebrows in Delhi. Mr. Muizzu also called for the revival of SAARC, on hold since 2016 when India pulled out of the summit in Islamabad over cross-border terrorism. “We do not want Maldives to be drawn into disputes within our neighbours,” said Mr. Shahid, demanding that the Muizzu government make a statement in Parliament about the nature of the agreements signed with Pakistan. “We must aim for expanding our relationship with everyone who has goodwill to the Maldives, but it should not come at the cost of our own friends, our established relationships,” he added. When asked about Mr. Muizzu’s Pakistan visit on Friday, Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said that the government kept a “close watch” on such developments and would “take whatever appropriate steps may be necessary”. In response to the comments on SAARC, Mr. Jaiswal said that it was “one country”, indicating Pakistan, that had “stalled” the functioning of SAARC, and India was keen to strengthen regional cooperation. Mr. Shahid’s comments to The Hindu indicate that ties with India may once again become an issue in the Maldivian elections. Mr. Solih lost the elections in 2023 due to the “India Out” campaign of the People’s National Congress (PNC), led by Mr. Muizzu, against what he alleged was undue Indian influence in the island chain, especially accusing the Solih government of allowing India to build military bases in infrastructure projects that India had constructed. Mr. Muizzu had also demanded that Indian Air Force personnel stationed at three locations in the Maldives, including Gan Island and Hanimadhoo Atoll, who operated aircraft that India had provided to the Maldives, be removed. While the beginning of Mr. Muizzu’s tenure saw tensions with the Modi government, and he chose to travel to Turkiye, the UAE, and China before visiting India, relations improved after India agreed to withdraw military personnel and replace them with civilian personnel instead. In June 2024, a month after the final batch of 89 Indian personnel had been withdrawn, Mr. Muizzu visited India to attend Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s swearing-in ceremony, and then returned in October 2024 for a bilateral visit, when India offered the Maldives several economic support measures, including a currency swap agreement to help Maldives avoid a debt failure. Mr. Shahid, who is standing for the primary elections in the MDP next year, is expected to face some tough competition from his other former colleagues in the cabinet as well, including former Economic Minister Fayyaz Ismail, who has the backing of the current MDP chief and former Maldivian President Mohamed Nasheed. Mr. Shahid and Mr. Solih were rivals of Mr. Nasheed during the previous government, but the opposition has come together within the MDP in order to fight against the ruling PNC. The run-up to the 2028 elections has heated up after the PNC confirmed Mr. Muizzu for the 2028 ticket, and the MDP held its party congress, endorsing the “Big Change” ticket for constitutional reform proposed by Mr. Ismail. Mr. Shahid is in India to attend the Words Beyond Borders International Literature Festival and is expected to affirm a campaign more friendly to India. When asked whether he would back an “India-first” campaign like Mr. Solih did, Mr. Shahid said his outreach would always be “first to India” on foreign policy, but not on domestic issues, which were sovereign. “India has always been our first responder. India has always been a generous partner in development. India is our immediate neighbour, who has been consistent in its relationship with the Maldives. So, our history proves the relationship right,” he said, referring to close ties between India and the Maldives since 1965, when the Maldives won its independence from British rule. 支持伊斯梅尔提出的宪法改革方案及“大变革”竞选主张。沙希德先生目前身在印度，参加Words Beyond Borders国际文学节，预计将公开支持一项对印度更友好的竞选活动。当被问及是否会像索利赫先生那样支持“印度优先”运动时，沙希德先生说，在外交政策上，他的对外联络将始终“首先面向印度”，但在国内问题上不会如此，因为国内事务属于主权范畴。他说：“印度始终是我们的第一响应者。印度始终是发展领域慷慨的伙伴。印度是我们的近邻，与马尔代夫保持着一贯的关系。因此，我们的历史证明双方的关系是正确的。”他指的是，自1965年马尔代夫摆脱英国统治获得独立以来，印度与马尔代夫一直保持密切关系。评论必须以英文提交，并且使用完整句子。评论不得含有辱骂性内容或针对个人的攻击。请遵守我们的社区评论准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已经是《The https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-must-.summary_zh: 新爱国党（NPP）第三届全国副主席纳纳·阿科梅亚敦促加纳总统约翰·德拉马尼·马哈马，就过去批评向在任总统授予荣誉学位的言论向前总统纳纳·阿库福-阿多道歉。阿科梅亚先生周四在Facebook上发帖称，阿库福-阿多先生任内获得荣誉奖项时，马哈马先生曾质疑一个人在任期间接受此类表彰是否恰当。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-must-.body: The Third National Vice Chairman of the New Patriotic Party (NPP), Nana Akomea, has asked President John Dramani Mahama to apologise to former President Nana Akufo-Addo for his past comments criticising the conferment of honorary degrees on serving presidents. Mr Akomea says the President’s acceptance of another honorary doctorate from a university in Russia exposes what he considers an inconsistency in the position Mr Mahama previously held on the matter. In a Facebook post on Thursday, Mr Akomea recalled that when Mr Akufo-Addo received honorary awards during his presidency, Mr Mahama questioned the appropriateness of such recognition while a person was still in office. He said the then-opposition leader had argued that Mr Akufo-Addo should have waited until after his presidency to allow for a proper assessment of his record before receiving honorary doctorates. Mr Akomea also recalled Mr Mahama’s suggestion that the former president was using the influence of his office to secure such honours from universities. However, Mr Akomea noted that President Mahama, who has been in office for less than two years, had himself received three or four honorary doctorates, including the latest recognition in Russia. Expressing mixed feelings about the latest award, he said he was happy for President Mahama but considered his acceptance of the honour inconsistent with the criticism he had directed at his predecessor. “For the sake of his Integrity, President Mahama owes President Akufo-Addo an unqualified apology on this matter of honorary awards,” he wrote
https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-must-.title_zh: Mahama必须就授予荣誉博士学位一事向Akufo-Addo道歉
https://www.myjoyonline.com/mahama-must-.body_zh: 新爱国党（NPP）第三全国副主席 Nana Akomea 要求总统 John Dramani Mahama 就其过去批评向在任总统授予荣誉学位的言论，向前总统 Nana Akufo-Addo 道歉。Akomea 先生表示，总统接受俄罗斯一所大学授予的另一项荣誉博士头衔，暴露了他认为 Mahama 先生此前在这一问题上的立场前后矛盾。周四，Akomea 先生在 Facebook 的一则帖子中回忆称，Akufo-Addo 先生在任总统期间获得荣誉奖项时，Mahama 先生质疑在任者接受此类荣誉是否恰当。他说，这位当时的反对党领袖认为，Akufo-Addo 先生应等到卸任后再接受荣誉博士学位，以便对其任内政绩作出适当评价。Akomea 先生还提到，Mahama 先生曾暗示前总统正利用职位影响力从各大学获取此类荣誉。然而，Akomea 先生指出，任职不足两年的 Mahama 总统自己也获得了三到四个荣誉博士学位，其中包括俄罗斯授予的最近一项荣誉。他对最新奖项表达了复杂感受，称自己为 Mahama 总统感到高兴，但认为他接受这一荣誉与此前对前任的批评不一致。他写道：“为了维护他的诚信，Mahama 总统在荣誉奖项一事上，应当无条件地向 Akufo-Addo 总统道歉。”

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/31/t.body: President Bola Ahmed Tinubu has approved the appointment of Professor Murtala Muhammad Ahmad as the seventh substantive Chief Medical Director (CMD) of the Usmanu Danfodiyo University Teaching Hospital (UDUTH), Sokoto. In a statement by the Head, Public Affairs, UDUTH, Mansur Wadata, the appointment is for an initial term of four years with effect from October 20, 2026, and was conveyed in a letter signed by the Coordinating Minister of Health and Social Welfare, Professor Muhammad Ali Pate. Professor Ahmad succeeds Professor Anas Ahmad Sabir, who successfully completed his two-term tenure in May this year. The statement further stated that while congratulating him on the appointment, Professor Pate reminded him of the heavy responsibilities of his new office and the yearnings of Nigerians for an effective and responsive healthcare delivery system. He urged the new CMD to justify the confidence reposed in him by Mr. President by working collaboratively with all stakeholders to ensure that the hospital continues to deliver quality healthcare services to Nigerians. Professor Ahmad becomes the second alumnus of the Usmanu Danfodiyo University to lead the Teaching Hospital as Chief Medical Director, marking a historic milestone for the institution. With over two decades of experience in Paediatrics and Child Health, Professor Ahmad brings a robust blend of clinical expertise, university teaching, and hospital administration to his new role. He earned his Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) degree from the Usmanu Danfodiyo University, followed by a Fellowship of the West African College of Physicians (FWACP) in Paediatrics and a Professional Diploma in Education from Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria. He also holds specialized certifications in paediatric electroencephalography, health leadership, management, and public administration from the University of Cape Town, University of Washington and Administrative Staff College of Nigeria (ASCON) respectively. Before his elevation, Professor Ahmad built an impressive administrative track record within both the university and the teaching hospital, steadily climbing the academic ladder from Lecturer I to Senior Lecturer, Reader, and ultimately Professor of Paediatrics. He previously served as Deputy Chairman of the Medical Advisory Committee (Training) at UDUTH for four years, where he brought impactful transformation to the administration of residency and training in the hospital. He also held key roles as Deputy Director of the Institute of Child Health and Faculty Examinations Officer in the Faculty of Clinical Sciences, alongside representing the faculty on the University Senate, and stepped in as Acting Chairman of the Medical Advisory Committee and Acting Chief Medical Director on multiple occasions. Beyond institutional management, Professor Ahmad has been at the forefront of public health service and specialised medical research in Sokoto State and across Nigeria, with active involvement in maternal and perinatal death surveillance and response, and as a national trainer on the management of severe acute malnutrition. As a prolific researcher, he has published widely in peer-reviewed journals focusing on child health, child neurology, epilepsy, and broader paediatric health concerns, while actively mentoring the next generation of medical professionals and postgraduate students. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/31/t.body_zh: 总统Bola Ahmed Tinubu已批准任命Murtala Muhammad Ahmad教授为位于Sokoto的Usmanu Danfodiyo University Teaching Hospital（UDUTH）第七任正式首席医务主任（CMD）。UDUTH公共事务负责人Mansur Wadata在一份声明中表示，此次任命的首个任期为4年，自2026年10月20日起生效，任命通知由卫生与社会保障协调部长Muhammad Ali Pate教授签署的函件传达。Pate教授在声明中进一步表示，他祝贺Ahmad教授获得任命，同时提醒他将承担新职位赋予的重任，以及尼日利亚人民对高效且能及时回应的医疗服务体系的期待。他敦促新任CMD通过与所有利益相关方协作，不辜负总统先生对他的信任，确保医院继续为尼日利亚人民提供优质医疗服务。Ahmad教授成为第二位以首席医务主任身份领导该教学医院的Usmanu Danfodiyo University校友，标志该校迎来历史性里程碑。Ahmad教授拥有20多年的儿科和儿童健康经验，将丰富的临床专业能力、大学教学经验和医院管理经验融入新职位。他从Usmanu Danfodiyo University取得医学学士与外科学士（MBBS）学位，随后取得西非内科医师学院（FWACP）儿科专业进修资格，并从Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria取得教育专业文凭。他还从University of Cape Town取得儿科脑电图和健康领导力认证，从University of Washington取得管理认证，并从Administrative Staff College of Nigeria（ASCON）取得公共行政认证。在此次晋升之前，Ahmad教授在大学和教学医院都取得了出色的行政管理成绩，并逐步晋升学术职级，先后担任一级讲师、高级讲师、Reader，最终成为儿科教授。他此前在UDUTH担任医学咨询委员会（培训）副主席4年，期间推动医院住院医师培训及培训管理工作的 impactful 转型。他还曾担任儿童健康研究所副所长、临床科学学院考试事务官等重要职务，代表学院参加大学评议会，并多次代理医学咨询委员会主席和首席医务主任职务。除机构管理外，Ahmad教授还一直处于Sokoto州及尼日利亚各地公共卫生服务和专业医疗研究的前沿，积极参与孕产妇和围产期死亡监测与应对工作，并担任重度急性营养不良管理领域的全国培训师。作为成果丰硕的研究者，他在同行评审期刊上广泛发表研究论文，重点关注儿童健康、儿童神经病学、癫痫以及更广泛的儿科健康问题，同时积极指导下一代医疗专业人员和研究生。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为35 Creek Road Apapa, Lagos, Nigeria，并在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区及世界各地设有办公室。该报是面向政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛中产阶层的尼日利亚最具权威性的全平台新闻媒体，同时为有抱负者和千禧一代提供汇聚新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。该报秉持公共信托精神，致力于追求真相与理性，报道范围从突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区延伸至人与社会的交汇点。您可以发送电子邮件至hello@thisdaylive.com或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://leadership.ng/2027-sokoto-govt-s.body: In Sokoto, the state government ordered the indefinite closure of the ADC campaign office less than 48 hours before the party’s presidential campaign flag-off scheduled for November 4. The Commissioner for Lands and Housing, Barrister Nasir Aliyu Dantsoho, announced the sealing during an official visit to the premises on Monday, November 2, 2026, according to an update posted by Comr. Abdulazeez Adamu. The development is the latest in a face-off between the ADC and the Sokoto State Government that has dominated the state’s political space over the past week. The dispute began when the ADC notified the state government of its decision to hold its presidential campaign flag-off in Sokoto, the seat of the Caliphate. The event was initially scheduled for October 31. In its response, the state government expressed disagreement with the proposed event, a position the ADC described as troubling and a threat to political pluralism. The party subsequently rescheduled the flag-off to Wednesday, November 4. At a press conference at the party’s headquarters in Sokoto on Sunday, November 1, the Director-General of the ADC Governorship Campaign and state chairman, Alhaji Bello Muhammad Goronyo, alleged a pattern of attacks and intimidation against the party and its supporters. Goronyo said ADC women supporters were attacked during a peaceful solidarity march on Wednesday, October 28, with their phones allegedly snatched, clothes torn and vehicles vandalised. He also alleged that the party’s state campaign office was attacked the same day, with windows and doors smashed, property looted and three motorcycles destroyed. He added that the party’s billboards, posters and other campaign materials were destroyed across the state. According to him, the ADC governorship candidate was attacked on Friday, October 30, while gunshots were fired at the airport as party leaders arrived. Goronyo further alleged that hotels which had confirmed reservations for ADC delegates cancelled their bookings under pressure from the state government, while government-owned hotels claimed they were fully booked. He linked the alleged attacks to the release from prison of two men associated with political thuggery, reportedly by the state government. He identified one Aliyu K.C. and his associates as being connected with the incidents. The ADC chairman also alleged that personnel of the Sokoto Community Guard Corps and Sokoto Marshals had been directed to prevent the party’s supporters from entering the state ahead of the flag-off. The closure of the campaign office marked another escalation in the dispute. The facility, a green-and-orange building in Sokoto metropolis, houses the party’s state campaign council. As of press time, the state government had not issued an official explanation for the sealing. However, sources in the Ministry of Lands said it might be connected to alleged violations involving land title and building permits. Despite the closure, the ADC has vowed to proceed with its November 4 presidential campaign flag-off. “No threat, intimidation or unlawful obstruction will deprive us of our constitutional right to organise political activities,” Goronyo said. He called on the Nigeria Police Force, the Department of State Services (DSS) and the Federal Government to investigate the alleged attacks and provide protection for the party’s candidates and supporters. In neighbouring Zamfara State, pandemonium broke out on Monday during the APC primary for the Zamfara North Senatorial District in Kaura Namoda, as the local government chairman, Hon. Mannir Haidara, narrowly escaped an attack by angry youths. LEADERSHIP gathered that the incident occurred at the primary election venue while Haidara was addressing delegates and urging them to vote for the incumbent senator representing the district, Senator Sahabi Ya’u Kaura. The youths, reportedly supporters of his challenger, Senator Tijjani Yahaya Kaura, rejected the appeal and insisted on backing their preferred candidate. Eyewitnesses said the situation degenerated as the youths shouted at the council chairman and attempted to attack him over alleged bias and imposition. Police officers and other security operatives at the venue intervened and rescued Haidara from the crowd. The primary is a contest between Senator Sahabi Ya’u and Senator Tijjani Yahaya Kaura for the APC ticket to represent Zamfara North, which comprises Kaura Namoda, Birnin Magaji, Shinkafi and Zurmi local government areas. Calm had been restored at the venue as of the time of filing this report, although security operatives maintained a heavy presence. Abdulazeez Adamu发布的消息，土地与住房事务专员Nasir Aliyu Dantsoho律师于2026年11月2日星期一正式视察该处场所期间宣布查封办公室。这是过去一周主导该州政治局势的ADC与索科托州政府对峙事件中的最新进展。争端始于ADC通知州政府，其决定在哈里发国教发源地索科托举行总统竞选启动仪式。该活动最初定于10月31日举行。州政府回应称不同意举办这项活动，ADC则称这一立场令人不安，并威胁政治多元。随后，该党将启动仪式改至11月4日星期三。11月1日星期日，在位于索科托的党总部举行的新闻发布会上，ADC州长竞选主任兼州主席Alhaji Bello Muhammad Goronyo指控该党及其支持者持续遭到袭击和恐吓。Goronyo称，10月28日星期三，ADC女性支持者在一场和平声援游行中遭到袭击，据称她们的手机被抢、衣服被撕毁，车辆也遭到破坏。他还称，同一天，该党州竞选办公室遭到袭击，窗户和门被砸，财物被抢，3辆摩托车被毁。他补充说，该党在各地的广告牌、海报和其他竞选 materials均被毁。据他介绍，10月30日星期五，ADC州长候选人遭到袭击；该党领导人抵达机场时，现场还响起了枪声。Goronyo进一步指控，已确认接待ADC代表入住的酒店在州政府施压下取消了预订，而政府所属酒店则声称已客满。他将这些所谓的袭击与据称由州政府释放的两名政治打手有关，并指出其中一人为Aliyu K.C.及其同伙与这些事件有关。ADC主席还称，索科托社区卫队和索科托法警人员已奉命阻止该党支持者在启动仪式前进入该州。竞选办公室关闭标志着争端进一步升级。该设施是一栋位于索科托市区、涂有绿色和橙色的大楼，内设该党州竞选委员会。截至发稿时，州政府尚未就查封一事发布正式解释。不过，土地部消息人士称，此事可能与土地所有权和建筑许可方面的违规行为有关。尽管办公室已被关闭，ADC仍誓言继续举行11月4日的总统竞选启动仪式。Goronyo说：“任何威胁、恐吓或非法阻碍，都不能剥夺我们组织政治活动的宪法权利。”他呼吁尼日利亚警察部队、国家安全局（DSS）和联邦政府调查这些所谓的袭击，并为该党候选人和支持者提供保护。在邻近的赞法拉州，星期一在考拉纳莫达举行的全非人民大会党（APC）赞法拉北区参议员初选中发生混乱。当时，地方政府主席Hon. Mannir Haidara在向代表发表讲话、敦促他们投票支持代表该区的现任参议员Sahabi Ya’u Kaura时，险些遭到愤怒青年的袭击。据《LEADERSHIP》获得的报道，事发时Haidara正在初选投票点讲话。报道称，这些青年是其所挑战的参议员Tijjani Yahaya Kaura的支持者。他们拒绝了Haidara的呼吁，坚持支持自己属意的候选人。目击者称，局势不断恶化，这些青年对地方政府主席大喊大叫，并因所谓偏袒和强行施压而试图袭击他。现场的警察和其他安全人员介入，将Haidara从人群中救出。此次初选是Sahabi Ya’u与Tijjani Yahaya Kaura争夺APC代表赞法拉北区的党内候选人资格。该区包括考拉纳莫达、比尔宁马加吉、欣卡菲和祖尔米4个地方政府。截至本报道提交时，现场局势已恢复平静，但安全人员仍大量驻守。由于Haidara的电话已关机，未能联系其本人置评。掌握第一手动态，实时获取突发新闻和独家报道，直接发送到你的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，享全天候更新 →

The case was launched in July following a complaint from Netlist, which alleged that certain memory products infringed its patents. Other companies named as respondents in the case included Google, Nvidia Corp., Broadcom Inc. and Super Micro Computer Inc. The notice said Netlist and Samsung, including its two U.S. subsidiaries, jointly requested the termination of the investigation on Aug. 18 based on a settlement agreement between the companies. In 2021, Netlist sued Samsung, alleging that the Korean tech giant's memory products used in cloud computing servers, along with other data technologies, infringed its patents. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 西雅图——随着特朗普政府加强周二中期选举前对非公民投票的打击，一些持有韩国绿卡的人士担心，收到自己从未申请过的选举选票可能会给他们带来移民方面的麻烦。在网络论坛和社交媒体讨论中，包括韩裔美国人社区在内，绿卡持有人讲述了自己尽管不是美国公民，却收到选票或选民登记材料的经历。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: SEATTLE — With the Trump administration stepping up its crackdown on noncitizen voting ahead of Tuesday's midterm elections, some Korean green card holders are worried that receiving election ballots they never requested could land them in immigration trouble. Across online forums and social media discussions, including Korean-American communities, green card holders have shared accounts of receiving ballots or voter-registration materials despite not being U.S. citizens. "I'm a green card holder, but ballots come to my house every time," one user wrote. Another said she and her husband, both green card holders, had received jury summonses, and that her husband had also received election-related mail. The accounts have prompted discussions about how noncitizens end up receiving election materials and whether mistakes involving voter registration could jeopardize their green cards or future citizenship applications. Some users expressed concern that they may have been registered without realizing it, while others questioned how permanent residents could be unaware that only U.S. citizens are allowed to vote. The concerns come as federal authorities pursue criminal cases against green card holders accused of voting illegally. On Oct. 19, the Justice Department announced charges against 28 permanent residents in California for offenses including fraudulent voter registration, unlawful voting and false statements during naturalization proceedings. Among them was Jennifer Jung, a 31-year-old Korean woman with Canadian citizenship living in San Diego, according to Korean-language broadcaster Radio Korea. Federal prosecutors allege that Jung falsely claimed to be a U.S. citizen when registering to vote, cast a ballot in the November 2024 election and later made false statements about her voting history during a naturalization interview. The cases have also raised questions about California's voter registration system, which automatically registers eligible applicants during Department of Motor Vehicles transactions unless they opt out. State officials say applicants who indicate they are ineligible are not registered through the system. However, California has previously acknowledged cases of people being registered erroneously. Receiving election-related mail does not necessarily mean someone is registered to vote, and simply receiving a ballot is not a voting offense. But knowingly making a false claim of U.S. citizenship or voting illegally can have serious immigration consequences. The consequences depend on the circumstances, including how the person became registered, whether a ballot was cast and whether any false claim of citizenship was made. California allows people who were registered by mistake to cancel their registration through their county elections office, although cancellation does not necessarily eliminate potential immigration consequences from past violations
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 美国严打投票问题令持有韩国绿卡的选民担心收到非预期选票
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 西雅图——随着特朗普政府加强打击非公民投票，并赶在周二中期选举前展开行动，一些持有韩国绿卡的人士担心，收到自己从未申请过的选票可能会给他们带来移民方面的麻烦。在包括韩裔美国人社群在内的网络论坛和社交媒体讨论中，持有绿卡的人士讲述了自己尽管并非美国公民，却收到选票或选民登记材料的经历。一名用户写道：“我是绿卡持有者，但每次都有选票寄到我家。”另一名用户表示，她和丈夫都持有绿卡，却收到了陪审团传票，她丈夫还收到了与选举有关的邮件。这些经历引发了讨论：非公民为何会收到选举材料，以及选民登记方面的失误是否可能危及他们的绿卡或未来的公民身份申请。一些用户担心自己可能在不知情的情况下被登记为选民，另一些人则质疑，永久居民怎么会不知道只有美国公民才有权投票。联邦当局目前正对被控非法投票的绿卡持有者追究刑事责任。10月19日，美国司法部宣布对加利福尼亚州的28名永久 residents 提出指控，罪名包括欺诈性选民登记、非法投票以及在入籍程序中作虚假陈述。据韩语广播机构Korea Radio报道，被指控者中包括31岁的韩国裔女性Jennifer Jung，她拥有加拿大国籍，居住在圣迭戈。联邦检察官称，Jung在登记投票时虚假声称自己是美国公民，在2024年11月选举中投了票，并在之后的入籍面谈中就自己的投票记录作出虚假陈述。这些案件还引发了人们对加利福尼亚州选民登记系统的疑问。该系统在机动车管理局办理业务时会自动登记符合条件的申请人，除非申请人选择退出。州官员表示，在系统中表明自己不符合资格的申请人不会被登记。不过，加利福尼亚州此前曾承认发生过一些人被错误登记的个案。收到与选举有关的邮件并不一定意味着某人已登记为选民，而仅仅收到选票也不构成投票违法行为。但明知而虚假声称拥有美国国籍或非法投票，可能造成严重的移民后果。具体后果取决于多种情况，包括此人如何被登记、是否实际投票，以及是否曾虚假声称拥有美国国籍。加利福尼亚州允许被错误登记的人通过所在县的选举办公室取消登记，但取消登记并不一定能消除过去违法行为可能产生的移民后果……

The group insisted that what INEC did on October 29 was selective enforcement. It stated, “For governorship: INEC enforced strictly – Isa Pantami (PDP Gombe) – cleared conditionally, Abdulsalam Gwarzo (NDC Kano), cleared conditionally, and Ladi Adebutu (PDP Ogun Gov), rejected. “INEC said ‘The Ogun PDP candidate did not succeed. 该组织表示，INEC执行了最高法院关于州长候选人所属政党党员名册提交期限的裁决，却拒绝在奥贡州国民议会候选人案中采取同样措施。它补充道：“最高法院于2026年9月24日在INEC诉ZLP一案（SC/CV/495/2026）中裁定，《2026年选举法》第77(5)(6)(7)条具有强制性。”

该组织坚持认为，INEC在10月29日采取了选择性执法。它表示：“对于州长候选人：INEC严格执行规定——Isa Pantami（贡贝州PDP）——有条件获准参选；Abdulsalam Gwarzo（卡诺州NDC）——有条件获准参选；Ladi Adebutu（奥贡州PDP州长候选人）——被拒。

“INEC称‘奥贡州PDP候选人未能通过审核。’对于国民议会候选人，INEC拒绝执行相同规定。PDP在奥贡州提交的名册存在缺陷，并因此导致Adebutu被取消资格，但该名册却被用来保留Iyabo Obasanjo参议员（奥贡州中部PDP）及其他国民议会候选人的资格。这属于非法歧视。

“第77条并未区分州长和参议员。名册只有一份。如果该名册对州长候选人无效，那么对参议员候选人同样无效。”

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/b.body: • Says proposal allocates 37 seats each to Senate, House of Representatives •Three additional seats proposed for women in each state assembly The National Assembly has proposed the creation of 74 additional seats exclusively reserved for women in Senate and House of Representatives as part of ongoing efforts to address gender imbalance in Nigeria’s political representation. The proposal, which also provides for three additional seats for women in each of the 36 state Houses of Assembly, is designed to expand women’s participation in legislative decision-making without displacing existing constituencies or elected lawmakers. Senate Leader, Senator Opeyemi Bamidele, disclosed the proposal on Monday while speaking at the 2026 Law Week organised by the International Federation of Women Lawyers (FIDA), Ekiti State Chapter. Bamidele, who is also Vice Chairman of Senate Committee on the Review of the 1999 Constitution, said the proposal formed part of the ongoing constitution amendment exercise being undertaken by the 10th National Assembly. He explained that the proposed arrangement would provide 37 additional seats in Senate and another 37 in House of Representatives, ensuring that every state of the federation and the Federal Capital Territory would have one additional representative in each chamber. According to him, the proposed special seats are intended to provide women with greater access to elective positions and decision-making platforms, particularly against the background of their historically low representation in Nigeria’s legislative institutions. Bamidele disclosed that the Constitution Review Committee had also recommended three additional seats for women in each State House of Assembly. He stressed that the proposed seats would be exclusively reserved for women and would not affect existing electoral constituencies or displace any serving lawmaker. The arrangement, he added, would operate for 16 years, covering four electoral cycles, after which it would undergo a comprehensive review. Bamidele explained, “This arrangement is proposed to run for a period of 16 years, four electoral cycles, before a comprehensive review. This is a sunset clause designed to ensure sustainability and to allow for the organic development of a more inclusive political culture.” The senate leader expressed confidence that the proposal would secure the necessary legislative backing, particularly from the state Houses of Assembly, whose approval is constitutionally required to complete the amendment process. “We are actively and strategically engaging with the State Houses of Assembly, as their concurrence is a constitutional sine qua non for bringing this reform to fruition,” he said. Bamidele described the proposed special seats as a fundamental democratic reform rather than a partisan political initiative, stating that a representative democracy cannot function effectively while excluding a substantial proportion of the population from legislative decision-making. He said the initiative followed extensive consultations and consensus-building, adding that the National Assembly deliberately commenced the constitutional review process early to allow sufficient time for scrutiny and wider stakeholder participation. He said the 10th National Assembly’s commitment to the initiative had also been strengthened by advocacy from prominent figures, including the First Lady, Senator Oluremi Tinubu. Bamidele stated that the under-representation of women in political institutions required deliberate legislative intervention. He said the proposed reform was intended to strengthen democratic inclusion and ensure that women’s interests received adequate attention in the formulation of public policies. He stated, “The special seat initiative is not a partisan endeavour. It is a historic imperative. “The rationale is anchored on a simple, yet profound, principle of constitutional law: the foundational precept of representative democracy. The senate leader also highlighted the need for legislative interventions to protect women, children, and other vulnerable groups, particularly in the areas of healthcare, education, and social protection. He maintained that government had a responsibility to provide adequate safeguards where prevailing market conditions, cultural practices, and institutional weaknesses failed to protect vulnerable citizens. On access to justice, Bamidele insisted that the country’s legal framework must respond effectively to emerging threats against women and children, stressing that justice should not remain a constitutional promise or a provision in the statute books. “Rather, it must be accessible, affordable, timely, and effective,” he said. Bamidele added, “A woman who suffers domestic violence must be able to seek protection without intimidation or social condemnation. A child who experiences abuse must be heard, protected from further harm, and provided with appropriate support. FIDA, Ekiti State Chapter, chaired by Mrs. Ayobami Olowoyo-Richards, organised the Law Week with the theme, “Justice in a Changing World: Responding to New Challenges Affecting Women and Children.” The event was attended by Chairman of House of Representatives Committee on Information and National Orientation, Hon. Steve Fatoba; Speaker of Ekiti State House of Assembly, Rt. Hon. Adeoye Aribasoye; and other dignitaries. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/b.title_zh: 巴米德莱：国民议会提议为女性设立74个特别议席
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/b.body_zh:
• 提议在参议院和众议院各增设37个席位 • 提议在每个州议会为女性增设3个席位

尼日利亚国民议会提议在参议院和众议院增设74个专门保留给女性的席位，以作为解决尼日利亚政治代表中性别失衡问题持续努力的一部分。该提案还规定在尼日利亚36个州议会各为女性增设3个席位，旨在扩大女性对立法决策的参与，同时不取消现有选区，也不取代现任议员。

参议院领袖奥佩耶米·巴米德莱参议员周一在由国际女律师联合会（FIDA）埃基蒂州分会组织的2026年法律周活动上公布了这项提案。巴米德莱同时担任参议院1999年宪法审查委员会副主席。他说，这项提案是第十届国民议会正在进行的宪法修订工作的一部分。他解释说，拟议安排将在参议院增加37个席位，在众议院再增加37个席位，确保联邦每个州及联邦首都领地在两院中各增加一名代表。

据他介绍，拟议中的专门席位旨在让女性有更多机会担任民选职位和参与决策平台，尤其是考虑到女性在尼日利亚立法机构中的代表比例历来较低。巴米德莱透露，宪法审查委员会还建议在每个州议会为女性增加3个席位。他强调，拟议席位将专门保留给女性，不会影响现有选区，也不会取代任何在任议员。

他还说，该安排将实施16年，涵盖4个选举周期，之后将进行全面审查。巴米德莱解释道：“这项安排拟实施16年，即4个选举周期，之后再进行全面审查。这是一项日落条款，旨在确保制度的可持续性，并为更具包容性的政治文化实现自然发展留出空间。”

这位参议院领袖表示有信心，该提案将获得必要的立法支持，尤其是各州议会的支持，因为根据宪法，完成修宪程序必须取得州议会的同意。他说：“我们正在积极且有策略地与各州议会沟通，因为取得它们的同意是推动这项改革实现的宪法必要条件。”

巴米德莱将拟议的专门席位描述为一项根本性的民主改革，而非党派政治行动。他表示，如果将相当大比例的人口排除在立法决策之外，代表制民主就无法有效运作。他说，这项倡议是在广泛征询意见和凝聚共识后提出的；第十届国民议会特意提前启动宪法审查程序，以便留出充足时间进行审查并扩大利益相关方的参与。他还表示，第一夫人奥卢雷米·蒂努布参议员等知名人士的倡导，也加强了第十届国民议会对这项倡议的投入。

巴米德莱指出，女性在政治机构中代表不足，需要立法机关有意采取干预措施。他说，拟议改革旨在加强民主包容性，确保女性利益在公共政策制定中得到充分关注。他表示：“专门席位倡议不是党派行为，而是历史的必然要求。其依据植根于宪法-law的一项简单却深刻的原则：代表制民主的基本原则。”

这位参议院领袖还强调，需要通过立法干预保护女性、儿童及其他弱势群体，尤其是在医疗保健、教育和社会保护等领域。他坚持认为，当 prevailing 市场状况、文化习俗和制度缺陷未能保护弱势公民时，政府有责任提供充分保障。

在司法可及性方面，巴米德莱坚称，该国法律框架必须有效应对针对女性和儿童的新兴威胁，强调司法不应仅仅停留在宪法承诺或法条之中。他说：“相反，司法必须易于获得、价格可负担、及时且有效。”巴米德莱补充道：“遭受家庭暴力的女性必须能够寻求保护，而不受恐吓或社会谴责。遭受虐待的儿童必须有机会表达意见，受到保护以免进一步受到伤害，并获得适当支持。”

由阿约巴米·奥洛约-理查兹夫人担任主席的FIDA埃基蒂州分会组织了本届法律周活动，主题为“变化世界中的司法：应对影响女性和儿童的新挑战”。众议院信息与国家导向委员会主席史蒂夫·法托巴阁下、埃基蒂州议会议长阿德奥耶·阿里巴索耶阁下及其他贵宾出席了活动。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 埃博尼州州长弗朗西斯·恩维富鲁表示，其政府已向州议会提交一项行政法案，将绑架定为可判处死刑且不得选择替代刑罚的罪行。埃博尼州前副州长凯莱奇·伊格威的父亲伊格威先生于3月1日前往教堂途中遭绑架。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: Governor Francis Nwifuru of Ebonyi State says his administration has forwarded an executive bill to the state House of Assembly to make kidnapping a capital offence punishable by death without an option of alternative punishment. Mr Nwifuru said this on Friday during the funeral of the slain traditional ruler of Ndufu-Alike Community in Ikwo Local Government Area, Francis Igwe, Vanguard reported . “This should serve as a deterrent to those planning a kidnapping, whether for political reasons or otherwise,” the governor said. Mr Igwe, father of the immediate past Deputy Governor of Ebonyi State, Kelechi Igwe, was abducted on 1 March 1 while on his way to church. Mr Nwifuru, while speaking at the traditional ruler’s funeral, decried the moral deterioration among Nigerian youths. “I am worried about our present-day youths taking up leadership positions tomorrow. Some of our youths are not well informed, and they act so irrationally. “I am concerned because, with some of their attitudinal dispositions, there seems to be no future for our youths. “The youths need to have a rethink concerning certain actions of theirs, especially as concerns their attitudes towards community leaders,” he said. “They should desist from treating their leaders as holders of their destinies.” Mr Nwifuru vowed to implement any court decision against those arrested over the traditional ruler’s murder, stressing that the proposed legislation was intended to deter kidnapping in the state. He maintained that the traditional ruler’s murder should be the last of such incidents in Ikwo and other parts of the state. The governor described the late traditional ruler as “a forthright, vocal and astute parliamentarian” who represented his people effectively in the old Anambra State. He said the traditional ruler attracted development projects to his community, including the popular Folk Technical College, which has produced prominent Nigerians. In their tributes, former governors of the state, Sam Egwu and Martin Elechi, as well as former Senate President, Pius Anyim, described the deceased as a statesman, peacemaker, renowned educationist, administrator and passionate leader who left enduring legacies. They urged the family and the Ikwo people to take solace in his contributions to society. Speaking in his tribute, the slain traditional ruler’s first son and former deputy governor, Kelechi, described his father as a devoted family man and role model who guided him on family life, religion, politics and culture. He said the circumstances surrounding his father’s death remained difficult for the family to comprehend. The former deputy governor said the family was confident that the legacy of the slain traditional ruler would endure for generations to come. The offence attracts severe penalties, including life imprisonment and, in certain circumstances, the death penalty. Criminal Code Act and the Terrorism (Prevention and Prohibition) Act 2022 are the two principal laws that outlaw kidnapping and hostage taking. While the Criminal Code Act prescribes imprisonment of up to 10 years, the Terrorism (Prevention and Prohibition) Act 2022, which addresses the offence in the context of terrorism, prescribes severe punishment, including death, where the offence resulted in the death of a victim. However, the punishment for kidnappings varies across the states in the country. PREMIUM TIMES reports that the applicable legislation on kidnapping is the Ebonyi State Internal Security Enforcement and Other Related Matters Law, 2009 (Cap. 55, Vol. 2)
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 州长要求对绑架者判处死刑，并将法案提交州议会
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 埃博尼州州长弗朗西斯·恩维富鲁表示，其政府已向该州众议院提交一项行政法案，拟将绑架定为可判处死刑且不得以其他刑罚替代的资本罪行。恩维富鲁先生于周五在伊克沃地方政府辖区恩杜富-阿利克社区遇害传统酋长弗朗西斯·伊格韦的葬礼上说了这番话，《Vanguard》报道称。州长说：“无论出于政治目的还是其他原因，这都应当对那些策划绑架的人形成威慑。”伊格韦先生是埃博尼州前副州长凯莱奇·伊格韦的父亲，他于3月1日前往教堂途中遭绑架。恩维富鲁州长在传统酋长葬礼上发言时，谴责了尼日利亚年轻人之间的道德滑坡。他说：“我担心我们当代的年轻人明天担任领导职务时，会出现一些问题。我们的一些年轻人见识不足，行事又十分不理性。令我担忧的是，从他们某些态度倾向来看，我们年轻人似乎没有未来。年轻人需要重新思考自己的某些行为，尤其是对社区领袖的态度，”他说，“他们不应再把领袖视决定自己命运的人。”恩维富鲁先生誓言执行法院针对因谋杀传统酋长而被捕者的任何裁决，并强调拟议立法的目的在于遏制该州的绑架行为。他坚持认为，传统酋长遇害应当成为伊克沃及该州其他地区此类事件中的最后一例。州长称已故传统酋长是“一位正直、敢于发声且精明的议员”，曾在旧阿南布拉州有效代表民众。他还 said，传统酋长为所在社区吸引了发展项目，其中包括颇受欢迎的民间技术学院，该学院培养出了多位尼日利亚杰出人物。在悼词中，该州前州长萨姆·埃格沃、马丁·埃莱奇以及前参议院议长皮乌斯·阿尼姆称逝者是一位政治家、和平缔造者、知名教育家、行政管理者和充满热情的领袖，留下了 enduring legacies。他们敦促其家人和伊克沃民众从他为社会作出的贡献中寻求慰藉。在悼词中，遇害传统酋长的长子、前副州长凯莱奇称父亲是一位忠于家庭的楷模，在家庭生活、宗教、政治和文化方面都给予他指导。他说，围绕父亲死亡的具体情况，家人至今仍难以理解。这位前副州长表示，家人相信，遇害传统酋长留下的精神遗产将世代延续。该罪行的刑罚严厉，包括无期徒刑，在某些情况下还可判处死刑。《刑法典》和《2022年恐怖主义预防与禁止法》是禁止绑架和劫持人质的两部主要法律。《刑法典》规定最高可判处10年监禁，而从恐怖主义背景下处理该罪行的《2022年恐怖主义预防与禁止法》则规定严厉处罚，如果犯罪行为导致受害者死亡，可判处死刑。不过，全国各州对绑架罪的处罚规定有所不同。《PREMIUM TIMES》报道称，适用于绑架案的立法是《2009年埃博尼州内部安全执法及其他相关事项法》（Cap. 55, Vol. 2）

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.title: NASS committed to increasing women’s participation
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.summary: ADO-EKITI — Senate Leader, Senator Opeyemi Bamidele, has said the 10th National Assembly is committed to removing barriers limiting women’s participation in governance through a proposed constitutional amendment seeking special seats for women in the National and State Houses of Assembly.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.summary_zh: ADO-EKITI——参议院领袖奥佩耶米·巴米德莱参议员表示，第10届全国大会致力于通过拟议的宪法修正案清除阻碍女性参与治理的障碍，寻求在全国议会和州议会为女性设置专门席位。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.body: ADO-EKITI — Senate Leader, Senator Opeyemi Bamidele, has said the 10th National Assembly is committed to removing barriers limiting women’s participation in governance through a proposed constitutional amendment seeking special seats for women in the National and State Houses of Assembly. Bamidele, who represents Ekiti Central Senatorial District, said the proposed legislation was designed to address the persistent under-representation of women in Nigeria’s political institutions and ensure their participation in decisions affecting the country. He spoke as a guest speaker at the 2026 Law Week of the International Federation of Women Lawyers (FIDA), Ekiti State Chapter, held in Ado-Ekiti, with the theme, “Justice in a Changing World: Responding to New Challenges Affecting Women and Children”. The Senate Leader said the proposed constitutional alteration would create 37 additional seats in the Senate and 37 in the House of Representatives, with one seat reserved for women in each state and the Federal Capital Territory. He added that the proposal also provided for three additional seats in each State House of Assembly, without displacing existing legislative seats. According to him, the arrangement is proposed to run for 16 years, covering four electoral cycles, after which its impact would be reviewed. Describing the initiative as a historic intervention rather than a partisan project, Bamidele said a democracy that excluded a significant proportion of its population from decision-making could not claim to be fully representative. He disclosed that the National Assembly had commenced engagements with State Houses of Assembly to secure the constitutionally required concurrence for the proposed amendment. He said the process was being pursued through extensive consultations and consensus-building. Bamidele, who commended the advocacy of the First Lady, Senator Oluremi Tinubu, said the 10th Assembly was determined to address historical gaps in women’s political representation. The lawmaker also identified globalisation, artificial intelligence, digitalisation, insecurity, economic instability and climate change as factors creating new challenges for women and children. He said women continued to face gender-based violence, economic exclusion, discrimination and inadequate healthcare, while children remained vulnerable to sexual abuse, trafficking, child labour, early marriage, malnutrition, educational deprivation and digital exploitation. He noted that poverty, unemployment, inadequate social protection, educational inequalities, social stigma and weak enforcement of existing laws had further compounded the challenges. Bamidele maintained that protecting women and children was not merely a humanitarian responsibility but a constitutional obligation and a critical investment in national development, economic productivity and social stability. He also highlighted legislative interventions of the 10th Assembly, including the four Tax Reform Acts of 2025, which he said exempted sanitary products, baby diapers and other essential products for women and children from Value Added Tax. He described the measure as a social justice intervention aimed at reducing the financial burden on low-income women and families. The Senate Leader urged FIDA to deepen its engagement with the National Assembly and other relevant institutions by identifying gaps in existing laws, proposing reforms and ensuring that government policies and budgetary provisions translated into tangible benefits for vulnerable Nigerians. He also challenged the organisation to hold the legislature accountable for implementing its commitments, particularly the proposed special seats for women and adequate funding for child protection, women’s healthcare and gender empowerment programmes. “A democracy that systematically excludes over half of its population from the decision-making tables that determine their future is, at best, a flawed democracy and, at worst, a veiled oligarchy. “The law is only as good as its implementation. Hold us accountable. Demand that the Special Seats Bill becomes law. Demand that appropriations for child protection and women’s health are not just passed, but released and utilised,” he said. In her keynote address, the Vice-Chancellor of Afe Babalola University, Ado-Ekiti, Professor Smaranda Olarinde, called for stronger legal and institutional frameworks to protect women and children against emerging forms of abuse, particularly those enabled by technology and economic vulnerabilities. Olarinde said the growing use of artificial intelligence and digital platforms had created new threats, including cyberstalking, online harassment, deepfake images, impersonation and the exploitation of children. She called for stronger collaboration among government, the judiciary, law enforcement agencies, universities, religious and traditional leaders, the media and civil society organisations to tackle gender-based violence and child abuse. The vice-chancellor also urged FIDA to move beyond advocacy to measurable outcomes, proposing a collaborative Women and Children Access to Justice Action Framework to improve legal protection, digital safety and support for survivors. In his remarks, the Chief Judge of Ekiti State, Justice Ogunmoye, commended FIDA for selecting Bamidele to deliver the lecture, describing him as well placed to address emerging issues requiring legislative and policy reforms to protect women and children. Earlier, the Chairperson of FIDA, Ekiti State chapter, Ayobami Olowoyo-Richards, said the organisation would remain committed to promoting, protecting and preserving the rights of women and children. She said changing realities continued to present new challenges to their safety, dignity and fundamental rights, requiring stronger laws, institutions and collective responses to ensure access to justice. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.title_zh: 尼日利亚国民议会承诺提高女性参与度
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.body_zh: 阿多埃基蒂——参议院领袖、参议员奥佩耶米·巴米德莱表示，第10届全国大会致力于通过拟议的宪法修正案消除阻碍女性参与治理的障碍，寻求在国民议会和州议会为女性设立专属议席。巴米德莱代表埃基蒂中央选区参议员区，他说，拟议立法旨在解决女性在尼日利亚政治机构中长期代表不足的问题，并确保女性参与影响国家的各项决策。他是在阿多埃基蒂举行的2026年国际女律师联合会（FIDA）埃基蒂州分会法律周活动上作为嘉宾发言的，主题为“变化中的世界中的正义：应对影响妇女和儿童的新挑战”。参议院领袖表示，拟议的宪法修订将在参议院增设37个议席，在众议院增设37个议席，每个州和联邦首都直辖区各保留1个女性席位。他补充说，该提案还将为每个州议会增加3个席位，而不会挤占现有立法席位。据他介绍，这项安排拟实施16年，涵盖4个选举周期，之后将对其影响进行评估。巴米德莱称，这项倡议是一项历史性干预，而非党派项目；如果一个民主制度将相当大比例的人口排除在决策之外，就不能声称自己具有充分的代表性。他透露，全国大会已开始与各州议会接洽，以取得宪法要求的修正案同意。他说，这一进程正通过广泛磋商和凝聚共识推进。巴米德莱赞扬了第一夫人、参议员奥卢雷米·蒂努布的倡导工作，并表示第10届大会决心弥合女性政治代表方面的历史差距。这位议员还指出，全球化、人工智能、数字化、不安全局势、经济不稳定和气候变化正在给妇女和儿童带来新的挑战。他说，妇女仍面临基于性别的暴力、经济排斥、歧视和医疗保障不足，而儿童仍易遭受性虐待、人口贩运、童工、早婚、营养不良、教育匮乏和数字剥削。他指出，贫困、失业、社会保障不足、教育不平等、社会污名和现有法律执行不力进一步加剧了这些挑战。巴米德莱坚持认为，保护妇女和儿童不仅是人道主义责任，也是宪法义务，更是促进国家发展、经济生产力和社会稳定的关键投资。他还强调了第10届大会采取的立法措施，包括2025年的4部《税制改革法》，据他说，这些法律免除了卫生用品、婴儿纸尿裤和其他妇女及儿童必需品的产品增值税。他称，这项措施是一项社会公正干预，旨在减轻低收入妇女和家庭的经济负担。参议院领袖敦促FIDA加强与全国大会及其他相关机构的合作，找出现有法律中的缺口、提出改革建议，并确保政府政策和预算安排转化为弱势尼日利亚人切实可享的益处。他还要求该组织监督立法机关履行承诺，特别是落实拟议的女性专属议席，以及为儿童保护、妇女医疗保健和性别赋权项目提供充足资金。他说：“一个将超过一半人口系统性排除在决定其未来的决策机制之外的民主制度，充其量是一个有缺陷的民主制度，最坏的情况下，则是披着外衣的寡头政治。‘法律的好坏取决于执行。请监督我们。要求《专属议席法案》成为法律。要求儿童保护和妇女健康方面的拨款不仅获得批准，而且得到拨付和使用。’”阿多埃基蒂Afe Babalola大学校长斯马兰达·奥拉林德教授发表主旨演讲时，呼吁加强法律和制度框架，保护妇女和儿童免受新型虐待，尤其是借助技术以及经济脆弱性而滋生的虐待。奥拉林德说，人工智能和数字平台的日益使用带来了新的威胁，包括网络跟踪、网络骚扰、深度伪造图像、冒名身份以及对儿童的剥削。她呼吁政府、司法机关、执法机构、高校、宗教和传统领袖、媒体及公民社会组织加强合作，共同打击基于性别的暴力和儿童虐待。校长还敦促FIDA超越倡导工作，着眼可衡量的成果，并提议建立协作性质的“妇女与儿童司法获取行动框架”，以改善法律保护、数字安全和幸存者支持。埃基蒂州首席法官奥贡莫耶法官在发言中赞扬FIDA选择巴米德莱发表讲座，称他非常适合探讨需要通过立法和政策改革加以应对的新兴问题，以保护妇女和儿童。FIDA埃基蒂州分会主席阿约巴米·奥洛约-理查兹早些时候表示，该组织将继续致力于促进、保护和保障妇女及儿童的权利。她说，不断变化的现实持续给他们的安全、尊严和基本权利带来新挑战，需要更完善的法律、制度和集体应对措施，以确保每个人都能获得司法救济。本文所表达的意见不代表Vanguard报及其任何员工的观点

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.body: ABUJA — The National Assembly Committee on the Review of the 1999 Constitution has proposed the creation of 74 additional seats for women in the Senate and House of Representatives, Senate Leader, Senator Opeyemi Bamidele, has said. The proposal also provides for three additional seats reserved for women in each State House of Assembly, without displacing any existing seats. Bamidele, who represents Ekiti Central Senatorial District, disclosed this on Monday at the 2026 Law Week organised by the International Federation of Women Lawyers (FIDA), Ekiti State Chapter. He said the proposals were aimed at deepening women’s participation and representation in Nigeria’s political and governance processes. In a statement issued by his Media Directorate, Bamidele, who is also Vice Chairman of the Senate Committee on the Review of the 1999 Constitution, said the proposed special seats were part of the ongoing constitutional amendment process. Explaining the proposal, the Senate Leader said it would create 37 additional seats in the Senate and another 37 in the House of Representatives. According to him, if approved, each state of the federation and the Federal Capital Territory will have one additional seat in each chamber of the National Assembly. He said the committee had also proposed three additional seats for women in each State House of Assembly. Bamidele said the arrangement was designed to operate for 16 years, covering four electoral cycles, after which it would be subjected to a comprehensive review. He described the proposed duration as a sunset clause intended to allow the development of a more inclusive political culture. He said the committee was engaging with state Houses of Assembly, whose concurrence was constitutionally required for the proposed amendment to take effect. Bamidele said the initiative was not partisan but aimed at addressing the under-representation of women in decision-making. He added that the 10th National Assembly’s commitment to the proposal had been strengthened by advocacy from key government figures, including the First Lady, Senator Oluremi Tinubu. On the broader protection of women and children, Bamidele said laws must respond to emerging threats and ensure that victims of abuse had access to protection and justice. He said justice should be accessible, affordable, timely and effective, adding that women experiencing domestic violence and children subjected to abuse must be protected from intimidation and further harm. He also called for access to legal assistance, medical care and psychosocial support for victims, while perpetrators should be held accountable in accordance with due process and the rule of law. The event was attended by the Chairman of the House of Representatives Committee on Information and National Orientation, Hon. Steve Fatoba, and the Speaker of the Ekiti State House of Assembly, Rt. Hon. Adeoye Aribasoye, among others. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.title_zh: 尼日利亚国民议会提议为女性增加74个议席
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nass.body_zh: 阿布贾——参议院领袖奥佩耶米·巴米德莱表示，审查1999年宪法的国民议会委员会提议在参议院和众议院为女性增设74个议席。该提案还规定，每个州议会为女性保留3个额外议席，且不占用任何现有议席。代表埃基蒂中央选区的巴米德莱于星期一在国际女律师联合会埃基蒂州分会组织的2026年法律周活动上披露了上述信息。他说，这些提案旨在深化女性对尼日利亚政治和治理进程的参与和代表权。巴米德莱也是参议院1999年宪法审查委员会副主席，他在媒体指导部门发表的声明中表示，拟议的专门议席是正在进行的宪法修订程序的一部分。巴米德莱解释说，该提案将在参议院增设37个议席，并在众议院增设37个议席。他表示，如果获得批准，联邦的每个州和联邦首都特区将在国民议会两院中各增设1个议席。他说，委员会还提议每个州议会为女性增设3个议席。巴米德莱表示，这一安排拟实施16年，涵盖4个选举周期，之后将接受全面审查。他称，拟定期限属于日落条款，旨在促进形成更具包容性的政治文化。他说，委员会正在与各州议会沟通；根据宪法，修正案生效必须获得这些议会的同意。巴米德莱表示，此项倡议不具有党派倾向，而是旨在解决女性在决策过程中代表不足的问题。他补充称，在第一夫人奥卢雷米·蒂努布等重要政府人士的倡议和推动下，第10届国民议会对该提案的支持得到加强。在保护妇女和儿童这一更广泛的议题上，巴米德莱表示，法律必须回应新出现的威胁，确保遭受虐待的受害者能够获得保护和司法救济。他说，司法救济应当易于获得、价格可负担、及时且有效，并补充指出，遭受家庭暴力的妇女和遭受虐待的儿童必须得到保护，免受恐吓和进一步伤害。他还呼吁为受害者提供法律援助、医疗照护和社会心理支持，同时应按照正当程序和法治原则追究施害者的责任。出席活动的还有众议院信息与国家_orientation委员会主席史蒂夫·法托巴阁下，以及埃基蒂州议会议长阿德奥耶·阿里巴索耶阁下等。此处发表的意见不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点

Unlock these with Subscription Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri will pay a two-day visit to Kathmandu on November 4 and 5, the Ministry of External Affairs announced on Monday (November 2, 2026). This will be the first visit by Mr. Misri to Nepal since Prime Minister Balendra Shah took charge in March this year following the election that was conducted under an interim government. A visit to India by Mr. Shah is understandably part of the agenda that will be discussed when Mr. Misri meets officials in Kathmandu. “Foreign Secretary’s upcoming visit continues the tradition of regular high-level exchanges between the two countries and will help further enhance the comprehensive bilateral partnership,” said the Ministry in an announcement. The visit by Mr. Misri to Kathmandu will be keenly watched as it comes amid a slew of reforms that Nepal’s post-Gen-Z uprising government is in the process of rolling out. Apart from Mr. Shah’s visit to India, Mr. Misri’s conversations in Kathmandu are likely to feature the appointment of a new Ambassador of Nepal to New Delhi. Nepali Embassy has been without an Ambassador for several months since the previous Ambassador, Shankar Prasad Sharma, returned home. Nepali diplomatic sources told The Hindu earlier that Kathmandu was waiting for the agrément (diplomatic approval) for new envoy Nischal Nath Pandey to take charge in the embassy here. India’s continued assistance to the disaster in Bhote Koshi river is also expected to be on the agenda. Even as Mr. Misri's visit was being announced by the Ministry, a welfare association of former Indian Army soldiers took out a protest in Kathmandu on Monday (November 2) demanding that Gurkha recruitment into the Indian Army be resumed. Recruitment of Gurkha soldiers remains suspended since the Agnipath scheme was introduced by the Government of India. The Hindu had earlier reported that Mr. Misri was expected to visit Nepal in May, but the visit was postponed ostensibly because Mr. Shah had prioritised domestic challenges. The India visit by Mr. Shah, if it materialises, will be the first bilateral visit abroad by the leader who came into prominence during the September 2025 Gen-Z uprising that overthrew the government of Prime Minister K.P. Sharma Oli. Mr. Misri had visited Kathmandu previously for two days in August 2025 and had met Mr. Oli. In the past few months, India has hosted Nepal’s Foreign Minister Sisir Khanal, Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle, and Home Minister Sudan Gurung, who visited Delhi to participate in the first BIMSTEC (Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation) meet held on October 13, 2026. India has also hosted the head of the ruling Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP) Rabi Lamichhane in the first week of June when he met Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Mr. Lamichhane paid a personal visit to India last week to pray at the pilgrimage centres in Kainchi Dham in Uttarakhand and the Kamakhya temple in Guwahati. Mr. Lamichhane had described this visit as “personal and not political”. “There are no political meetings planned. 印度外交部长兼常秘vikram Misri将于11月4日至5日对加德满都进行为期两天的访问。印度外交部于11月2日（星期一）宣布了这一消息。这将是Misri先生自总理Balendra Shah今年3月在临时政府主持的选举后就任以来首次访问尼泊尔。

可以理解，Misri先生在加德满都会见官员时，Shah先生访印将是讨论议程的一部分。印度外交部在公告中表示：“外交部长即将进行的访问延续了两国定期开展高层互动的传统，将有助于进一步提升两国全面双边伙伴关系。”

Misri先生此次访问加德满都将受到密切关注，因为尼泊尔“Gen-Z”起义后的政府正在推行一系列改革。除了Shah先生访印外，Misri先生在加德满都的会谈预计将涉及任命尼泊尔新任驻新德里大使。自上一任大使Shankar Prasad Sharma回国后，尼泊尔大使馆已数月没有大使。尼泊尔外交消息人士此前告诉《The Hindu》，加德满都正在等待新任特使Nischal Nath Pandey获准（外交批准）赴任这里。印度继续援助Bhote Koshi河流灾后重建，预计也将列入议程。

在印度外交部宣布Misri先生访尼行程之际，一名前印度陆军士兵福利协会于11月2日（星期一）在加德满都举行抗议，要求恢复为印度陆军招募廓尔喀士兵。自印度政府推出Agnipath计划以来，廓尔喀士兵招募一直处于暂停状态。

《The Hindu》此前报道称，Misri先生原定于5月访问尼泊尔，但此次访问表面上是因Shah先生优先处理国内挑战而推迟。

如果Shah先生访印成行，这将是这位领导人在2025年9月推翻总理K.P. Sharma Oli政府的“Gen-Z”起义中崭露头角后首次出访外国进行双边访问。Misri先生此前曾于2025年8月访问加德满都两天，并会见了Oli先生。

过去几个月，印度接待了尼泊尔外长Sisir Khanal、财政部长Swarnim Wagle和内政部长Sudan Gurung，他们赴德里参加了10月13日举行的首届BIMSTEC（孟加拉湾多部门技术经济合作倡议）会议。

印度还在6月第一周接待了执政的Rastriya Swatantra Party（RSP）领导人Rabi Lamichhane，期间他会见了总理Narendra Modi。Lamichhane先生上周还对印度进行私人访问，前往北阿坎德邦Kainchi Dham的朝圣中心和古瓦哈提的Kamakhya寺祈祷。Lamichhane先生将此次访问描述为“私人访问，并非政治访问”。

Lamichhane先生在出发前表示：“目前没有安排任何政治会谈。由于这是一次私人访问，我呼吁人们不要对此作政治解读。”
