https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary_zh: 联邦执行委员会批准后，联邦政府于2026年5月宣布计划设立国家研究与创新发展基金（NRIDF），年度资金目标最高为5亿美元，按当前官方汇率约合₦6730亿。然而，政府所承诺的事项与政府实际承诺拨付的资金之间仍有差距。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body: In March, I visited the University of Michigan in Ann Arbor, where my daughter is currently a pre-med student. The university, often described as one of America’s Public Ivies because of its academic reputation and standing among leading public universities, has Professor Omolade Adunbi, a Nigerian on its faculty as its Director of the African Studies Center. I have maintained a relationship with Professor Adunbi for nearly two decades, and he joined my daughter in welcoming me to campus. During our conversation, I asked him about innovative ways American universities finance their programmes and what Nigeria and other African economies could learn. He introduced me to what I would call the Michigan template. One of the things he drew my attention to include the commercial value of university research as a source of funding. The University of Michigan has an extensive research-commercialisation ecosystem, connecting faculty research with corporations, foundations, investors and entrepreneurs through its innovation partnerships office. At Michigan, research output creates opportunities for corporations to sponsor research, enter partnerships with academics, license intellectual property and commercialise discoveries. Professor Adunbi mentioned Google co-founder Larry Page as an illustration of the relationship between university education, research and entrepreneurship. Page graduated from Michigan before proceeding to Stanford, where he and Sergey Brin developed PageRank, the technology that became foundational to Google. The research that produced Google was conducted at Stanford, but the example illustrates the wider value of university education and innovation. As Nigeria continues to approve licences for more universities, the value of these institutions must extend beyond the degrees they award. It should also be measured by their capacity to produce people, ideas and discoveries that create economic value. In fiscal year 2025, Michigan recorded $2.16 billion in research expenditures, attracted $170.6 million in corporate-sponsored research awards and supported the creation of 31 startups. Its experience demonstrates what becomes possible when academic research, government investment and private-sector participation reinforce one another. For Nigeria, this raises a fundamental policy question, which is my burning question for this edition. Why should Nigerian universities remain so heavily dependent on government allocations and tuition when their research capabilities could also attract corporate investment, generate intellectual property and support new businesses? This requires more than asking companies to fund universities. It requires institutions capable of producing credible research, protecting intellectual property and negotiating commercial partnerships. In connection, On 10 October, the London-based global charity, Wellcome, published a report that draws on interviews with more than 140,000 people across 140 countries. Its findings show that public trust in science has declined globally since the COVID-19 pandemic and fallen below its 2018 level. Nigeria’s experience reflects this worrying trend. In 2018, 26 per cent of Nigerians said they trusted science a lot. By 2020, that figure had fallen to 13 per cent. It recovered modestly to 15 per cent in 2025. Although the recovery is welcome, Nigeria remains 11 percentage points below its pre-pandemic level. Overall, 57 per cent of Nigerians reported at least some trust in science. The survey’s findings on vaccination make the challenge more concrete. Asked whether they would take a vaccine recommended by a doctor or nurse, 35 per cent of Nigerian respondents said they would take it immediately. Another 36 per cent preferred time to think about it, while 24 per cent said they did not take vaccines at all. Someone who wants time to consider a vaccine is not necessarily opposed to vaccination. Such concerns should not automatically be dismissed as ignorance. The more important question is whether people can obtain clear, credible answers that allow them to make informed decisions. The pandemic provides an important context. Scientific recommendations sometimes change because the evidence has changed. That is not a weakness of science; it is how science works. But when authorities communicate uncertainty poorly, subsequent changes can be interpreted as evidence of incompetence or dishonesty. Nigeria must nevertheless resist the temptation to explain its figures entirely through COVID-19. For many Nigerians, the most immediate encounter with science is not a laboratory or research institution, but a hospital, clinic, pharmacy or conversation with a health professional. As it is, the Wellcome report identifies an important relationship between confidence in healthcare institutions and trust in science. Globally, 43 per cent of people expressing a lot of confidence in their country’s hospitals and clinics also reported a lot of trust in science, compared with 26 per cent across the survey population. Economic insecurity adds another dimension. Globally, 39 per cent of people living comfortably reported a lot of trust in science in 2025, compared with 20 per cent of those finding it difficult to get by financially. Families preoccupied with food, rent, school fees and medical bills may have fewer resources to seek reliable information or act on professional advice. When institutions appear disconnected from those struggles, their pronouncements may carry less weight. To be fair, the Nigerian government has announced an initiative that could address some of these challenges. Following Federal Executive Council approval, the Federal Government announced in May 2026 plans to establish the National Research and Innovation Development Fund (NRIDF), with an annual funding target of up to $500 million, approximately ₦673 billion at the current official exchange rate. The fund is intended to support competitive research grants, strengthen innovation infrastructure and commercialise research findings. However, there is a difference between what a government promises and what it commits to funding. The $500 million figure was announced as an estimated annual target. On October 8, the Minister of Innovation, Science and Technology, Kingsley Udeh, clarified that the exact amount could not yet be determined because the proposed funding mechanism would draw on different sources calculated as percentages on a year-by-year basis. He also confirmed that the enabling bill had been forwarded to the National Assembly. In other words, the government has secured executive approval for the initiative, but the legislative and funding arrangements are not yet fully established. An announcement is not an appropriation, and an appropriation is not necessarily a disbursement. The government must therefore demonstrate that the fund will be backed by a sustainable revenue framework, independently governed, transparently administered and accessible to credible researchers. I have not found a specific public response from the Nigerian government to the Wellcome report since its 10 October publication. But to turn discoveries into commercially viable solutions, Nigeria needs research that addresses local priorities and stronger university-industry partnerships
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title_zh: 政府资金为何无法独自解决尼日利亚的教育危机，作者：Adeola Akinremi
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body_zh: 3月，我到访了位于安娜堡的密歇根大学，我的女儿目前在那里攻读医学预科。该大学凭借其学术声誉以及在顶尖公立大学中的地位，常常被称为美国“公立常春藤”之一；尼日利亚人教授Omolade Adunbi在该校任教，担任非洲研究中心主任。我与Adunbi教授保持联系已近20年，这次他与我的女儿一同欢迎我来到校园。交谈中，我询问他美国大学为各项计划提供资金的方式有哪些创新，以及尼日利亚和其他非洲经济体可以从中汲取哪些经验。他向我介绍了我会称之为“密歇根模式”的做法。他提请我关注的事项之一，是大学研究的商业价值可作为资金来源。密歇根大学拥有完善的研究成果商业化生态系统，通过其创新合作办公室将教师研究与企业、基金会、投资者和创业者连接起来。在密歇根大学，研究成果为企业赞助研究、与学术界建立合作、获得知识产权许可以及将研究发现商业化创造了机会。Adunbi教授以Google联合创始人Larry Page为例，说明大学教育、研究与创业之间的关系。Page从密歇根大学毕业后前往Stanford，在那里他与Sergey Brin开发了PageRank，这项技术后来成为Google的基础。催生Google的研究是在Stanford开展的，但这个例子说明了大学教育与创新的更广泛价值。随着尼日利亚继续批准增设大学，这些机构的价值不能仅限于它们颁发的学位，还应当衡量它们能否培养人才、产生思想并作出能够创造经济价值的发现。2025财年，密歇根大学录得$2.16 billion研究支出，吸引了$170.6 million企业赞助研究奖励，并支持成立了31家初创企业。其经验表明，当学术研究、政府投资和私营部门参与彼此促进时，便能产生更大的可能性。对尼日利亚而言，这提出了一个根本性的政策问题，也是本期我最迫切想要探讨的问题。尼日利亚大学的研究能力既可以吸引企业投资、产生知识产权并支持新业务，为何还要如此严重地依赖政府拨款和学费？这不能仅仅停留在要求企业资助大学的层面，而需要大学具备开展可信研究、保护知识产权以及谈判商业合作的能力。与此同时，总部设在伦敦的全球慈善机构Wellcome于10月10日发布了一份报告，报告借鉴了对140个国家逾140,000人的访谈。其调查结果显示，自COVID-19疫情爆发以来，全球公众对科学的信任有所下降，并已低于2018年的水平。尼日利亚的情况印证了这一令人担忧的趋势。2018年，26%的尼日利亚人表示非常信任科学；到2020年，这一比例降至13%，2025年小幅回升至15%。尽管这一回升值得欢迎，但尼日利亚仍比疫情前低11个百分点。总体而言，57%的尼日利亚人表示至少在一定程度上信任科学。调查关于疫苗接种的发现，使这一挑战更加具体。被问及是否愿意接种医生或护士推荐的疫苗时，35%的尼日利亚受访者表示会立即接种；另有36%希望有 time考虑，24%则表示自己完全不接种疫苗。希望有时间考虑疫苗接种的人，并不一定反对疫苗接种，不应自动将这类顾虑斥为无知。更为重要的问题是，人们能否获得清晰、可信的答案，从而作出知情决定。疫情为此提供了重要背景。当证据发生变化时，科学建议有时也会随之改变。这不是科学的弱点，而是科学运行的方式。然而，如果当局沟通不确定性时处理不当，后续变化可能会被解读为无能或不诚实的证据。尽管如此，尼日利亚仍须抵制将所有数据变化完全归因于COVID-19的诱惑。对许多尼日利亚人而言，他们接触科学最直接的场所并非实验室或研究机构，而是医院、诊所、药房，或与卫生专业人员进行交流的谈话。Wellcome报告由此发现，对医疗机构的信心与对科学的信任之间存在重要关系。在全球范围内，对本国医院和诊所非常有信心的受访者中，43%也表示非常信任科学，而全体受访者中的这一比例为26%。经济不security又增加了另一个维度。2025年，全球生活宽裕的人群中有39%表示非常信任科学，而经济拮据、难以维持生活的人中，这一比例为20%。那些忙于应对食物、房租、学费和医疗账单的家庭，可能没有更多资源去寻求可靠信息或依照专业建议采取行动。当各类机构显得与这些困境脱节时，它们的声明也就可能缺乏分量。公平地说，尼日利亚政府已经宣布了一项可能缓解部分 challenges 的倡议。经联邦执行委员会批准，联邦政府于2026年5月宣布计划设立国家研究与创新发展基金（NRIDF），年度资金目标最高为$500 million，按当前官方汇率约为₦673 billion。该基金拟用于支持竞争性研究补助、加强创新基础设施以及推动研究成果商业化。然而，政府作出的承诺与政府实际承诺拨款之间仍有差别。$500 million这一数字公布时只是预估的年度目标。10月8日，创新、科技部部长Kingsley Udeh澄清说，由于拟议资金机制将按年度从不同来源、以不同百分比计算出资，确切金额目前尚无法确定。他还确认，相关的授权法案已提交国民议会。换言之，政府已经为这项倡议取得行政批准，但立法和资金安排尚未完全确立。宣布资金并不等于拨付预算，而拨付预算也不等于实际支付。因此，政府必须证明，该基金将建立在可持续的财政框架基础上，由独立机构治理、透明管理，并向可信研究人员开放。自Wellcome报告于10月10日发布以来，我尚未发现尼日利亚政府针对该报告作出的具体公开回应。但是，若要将研究发现转化为具有商业可行性的解决方案，尼日利亚需要开展关注本地优先事项的研究，并加强大学与产业之间的合作伙伴关系

https://leadership.ng/2027-n50000-cash-r.summary: The African Democratic Congress (ADC) has criticised the Federal Government’s announcement of a N50,000 monthly cash relief payment, describing it as an election gimmick allegedly driven by President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s desperation ahead of the 2027 general election. https://leadership.ng/2027-n50000-cash-r.summary_zh: 非洲民主大会（ADC）批评联邦政府宣布每月向民众发放50,000奈拉现金救济，称此举是选举噱头，据称源于博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努巴总统在2027年大选前的绝望。该反对党指控蒂努巴政府通过政策让尼日利亚民众遭受严重经济困难后，又企图用现金补贴重新赢得好感。
https://leadership.ng/2027-n50000-cash-r.body: The African Democratic Congress (ADC) has criticised the Federal Government’s announcement of a N50,000 monthly cash relief payment, describing it as an election gimmick allegedly driven by President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s desperation ahead of the 2027 general election. The opposition party accused the Tinubu administration of attempting to regain public goodwill through cash handouts after subjecting Nigerians to severe economic hardship through its policies. In a statement signed by its National Publicity Secretary, Mallam Bolaji Abdullahi, the ADC questioned the timing of the announcement, alleging that the intervention was a reaction to the party’s promise to reduce the cost of living and make life more affordable if elected into power in 2027. According to the party, the government has recently announced several intervention programmes without delivering meaningful relief to Nigerians. “President Tinubu is in full panic mode now. Since the ADC and our Presidential Candidate, Atiku Abubakar, have made affordability and reducing the cost of living the cardinal focus of our campaign, the government has been announcing one desperate intervention or another,” Abdullahi said. The party recalled the August announcement of a $1 billion Renewed Hope Social Intervention Fund, a proposed 30-day fuel discount, cheaper transportation across states from October 1, and a N70,000 transportation allowance for workers. It alleged that these announcements had failed to translate into meaningful improvements in the living conditions of Nigerians. The ADC also questioned the purchasing power of the proposed N50,000 payment, asking what meaningful assistance the amount could provide to households struggling with rising food, transportation, fuel and healthcare costs. “What exactly is N50,000 supposed to buy in Tinubu’s Nigeria today? How much food can a family purchase with that amount? How much transport can it cover? And for how long?” the statement queried. The party argued that petrol prices had increased significantly, with food and transportation costs also rising, making the proposed intervention inadequate to address the financial difficulties facing ordinary Nigerians. It further accused the Federal Government of failing to anticipate the hardship associated with its economic reforms, insisting that vulnerable citizens should not have to wait until an election season to receive financial assistance. According to the ADC, the government should have incorporated adequate social protection measures into its economic reform plans from the beginning rather than introducing cash relief programmes after years of economic difficulties. The party also raised concerns about transparency and accountability in the implementation of government intervention programmes, warning that the latest initiative could create another avenue for the diversion of public funds. It referenced findings attributed to the Auditor-General concerning previous cash transfer programmes, questioning whether billions of naira allocated to earlier interventions had been properly accounted for. “What has happened to the findings of the Auditor-General concerning the billions of naira in previous cash transfers that could not be properly accounted for? Have those responsible been held accountable?” the party asked. The ADC further questioned how Nigerians could be expected to trust another intervention programme when concerns surrounding previous government-funded initiatives had allegedly not been adequately addressed. It warned that the N50,000 payment could either be an election-season publicity exercise intended to influence public perception or another programme vulnerable to financial mismanagement. “At best, this is an election gimmick designed to deceive Nigerians into believing that a government which has neglected them for more than three years suddenly cares about their welfare. At worst, it could become another scheme to siphon public funds under the convenient cover of poverty alleviation,” the statement added. The opposition party maintained that sustainable solutions to Nigeria’s cost-of-living crisis must go beyond temporary cash transfers. It called for policies aimed at restoring citizens’ purchasing power and reducing the cost of essential commodities, particularly food, energy and transportation. The ADC insisted that meaningful economic relief would require addressing the underlying causes of rising living costs rather than relying on periodic financial interventions. The statement was signed by Mallam Bolaji Abdullahi, National Publicity Secretary of the African Democratic Congress. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/2027-n50000-cash-r.title_zh: 2027年：5万奈拉现金救济反映Tinubu在选举前的绝望心态
https://leadership.ng/2027-n50000-cash-r.body_zh: 非洲民主大会（ADC）批评联邦政府宣布每月向民众发放₦50,000现金救济金，称此举是选举把戏，并指其源于总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布在2027年大选前的急切心理。这个反对党指责蒂努布政府通过政策使尼日利亚人遭受严重经济困境后，又企图借助发放现金争取公众好感。在由全国宣传秘书马利姆·博拉吉·阿卜杜拉希签署的一份声明中，ADC对宣布救济金的时间提出质疑，称政府的干预是因为该党承诺若在2027年赢得执政权，将降低生活成本、让生活更加负担得起。该党表示，政府近期宣布了多项干预计划，但并未给尼日利亚人带来实质性救济。阿卜杜拉希说：“蒂努布总统现在已陷入彻底恐慌。自ADC及我们的总统候选人阿蒂库·阿布巴卡尔将生活可负担性和降低生活成本作为竞选活动的核心重点以来，政府便不断推出一个又一个急迫的干预措施。”该党回顾了政府8月宣布的10亿美元“重燃希望社会干预基金”、拟议的30天燃油折扣、10月1日起实施的各州交通降价措施，以及向工作者提供₦70,000交通津贴。该党声称，这些措施并未切实改善尼日利亚人的生活状况。ADC还质疑拟议中的₦50,000补助金所能产生的购买力，询问这笔钱能为面临食品、交通、燃油和医疗费用上涨的家庭提供何种实际帮助。声明质问道：“在今天的蒂努布治下尼日利亚，₦50,000究竟能买到什么？一个家庭能用这笔钱购买多少食品？能够支付多少交通费？又能够维持多久？”该党认为，汽油价格已大幅上涨，食品和交通成本也在攀升，因此拟议中的干预措施不足以解决普通尼日利亚人面临的经济困难。该党进一步指责联邦政府未能预先估计经济改革带来的困难，坚持认为弱势公民不应非要等到选举季才获得经济援助。ADC表示，政府本应从一开始就将军充分的社会保障措施纳入经济改革计划，而不是在经历多年经济困难后才推出现金救济计划。该党还对政府干预计划执行过程中的透明度和问责提出担忧，警告最新举措可能为挪用公共资金提供新的渠道。声明援引了审计长对以往现金转移计划的调查结果，质问此前用于干预措施的数十亿奈拉是否已得到妥善核算。阿卜杜拉希所在的ADC问道：“审计长对以往数十亿奈拉现金转移无法妥善核算的调查结论如今如何？相关责任人是否已被追究？”ADC还进一步质疑，在围绕以往政府资助举措的疑虑据称尚未得到充分解决的情况下，尼日利亚人如何被期望信任另一项干预计划。该党警告称，₦50,000补助金要么是一场意在影响公众观感的选举季宣传活动，要么又是一个容易发生财务管理的计划。声明补充道：“往好里说，这是一场选举把戏，目的是欺骗尼日利亚人，让他们相信一个忽视他们三年多的政府突然关心起他们的福祉。往坏里说，它可能成为又一个打着扶贫便利旗号侵吞公共资金的阴谋。”这个反对党坚持认为，解决尼日利亚生活成本危机的可持续方案必须超越临时现金转移。该党呼吁制定旨在恢复公民购买力、降低基本商品成本的政策，尤其应降低食品、能源和交通成本。ADC坚持认为，真正有意义的经济救济需要解决生活成本上涨的根本原因，而不能依赖间歇性的经济干预。声明由非洲民主大会全国宣传秘书马利姆·博拉吉·阿卜杜拉希签署。我们掌握独家优势。实时报道、独家内幕和独家视角将直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时获取全天候最新消息 →

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.body: OPay, a Nigeria-focused digital financial services company, has withdrawn its planned $304 million US initial public offering on Friday over a regulatory inquiry by a foreign jurisdiction it did not identify. The SoftBank-backed digital-payments company described the inquiry as relating to a jurisdiction immaterial to its core operations, Reuters reported. The company had earlier disclosed that it was raising $304 million in its initial public offering (IPO) and aimed to secure a market capitalisation of more than $4 billion. The company had planned to list on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “OPay.” OPay withdrew its planned US initial public offering later on Friday, but it did not identify the regulator or the nature of the inquiry. OPay said it expected the matter to be resolved satisfactorily in the near future and that the probe should not be misconstrued as a reflection of the company’s business performance, financial condition, operational integrity or regulatory standing. It explained that the inquiry would not affect its operations, regulatory standing or customer service in Nigeria or its other markets. Founded in 2018, OPay provides digital financial services across emerging markets, including Nigeria and Indonesia. Its app offers payments, money transfers, savings and loans in economies where limited access to traditional banking can make everyday transactions difficult. The company had reached a $1 billion revenue run rate in the second quarter of 2026, recording 137 per cent year-on-year growth and a 19 per cent net margin in the first six months of the year. The fintech company raised $400 million in 2021 at a valuation of $2 billion. It had about 50 million monthly active users as of 31 July, according to its IPO prospectus. Citigroup, Deutsche Bank, Standard Bank, and CICC were among the underwriters
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.title_zh: OPay因海外监管调查撤回原计划进行的3.04亿美元美国IPO
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.body_zh: OPay是一家专注于尼日利亚市场的数字金融 services 公司。由于一个未指明名称的外国司法管辖区发起监管调查，该公司于周五撤回了原计划规模为3.04亿美元的美国首次公开发行。路透社报道，这家获得软银支持的数字支付公司称，相关调查涉及一个与其核心业务无关紧要司法管辖区。该公司此前披露，计划通过首次公开发行募集3.04亿美元，并争取实现超过40亿美元的市值。公司原计划以股票代码“OPay”在纽约证券交易所上市。OPay于周五晚些时候撤回了原计划进行的美国首次公开发行，但没有透露监管机构身份或调查的具体性质。OPay表示，预计此事将在近期得到令人满意的解决，并称不应将调查误解为公司经营业绩、财务状况、运营完整性或监管地位的反映。公司解释道，此次调查不会影响其在尼日利亚及其他市场的业务运营、监管地位或客户服务。OPay成立于2018年，在包括尼日利亚和印度尼西亚在内的新兴市场提供数字金融服务。其应用提供支付、转账、储蓄和贷款服务；在传统银行服务覆盖有限、日常交易可能面临困难的经济体中，这些服务尤为重要。根据该公司的首次公开发行招股说明书，截至2026年7月31日，公司约有5000万月活跃用户。该金融科技公司在2026年第二季度实现了10亿美元的年化收入，较上年同期增长137%，今年前六个月净利润率为19%。这家金融科技公司于2021年融资4亿美元，估值达到20亿美元。花旗集团、德意志银行、标准银行和中金公司是承销商之一。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/otti.summary_zh: 阿比亚州州长Alex Otti表示，地方政府之所以选择电动汽车（EV），而不是使用压缩天然气（CNG）作为燃料的公交车，是因为电动汽车代表交通技术的升级。Otti解释说，正因如此，政府决定在公共交通系统中采用电动公交车。他说，尽管倾向于电动汽车，州政府仍鼓励在该州增设压缩天然气加气站。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/otti.body: Gov. Alex Otti of Abia has said his administration chose Electric Vehicles (EVs) over Compressed Natural Gas (CNG)-powered buses because EVs represent an upgrade in transportation technology. Otti explained that it was for that reason that the government opted for electric buses for its public transportation system. He offered the explanation during the October edition of his monthly media chat held at the Michael Okpara Auditorium, Umuahia, on Friday night. He said that despite the preference for EVs, the State Government still encouraged the establishment of additional CNG stations in the state. “We are not opposed to CNG, but we chose electric vehicles for our public transportation system,” the governor said. He said that both petrol and CNG vehicles operate on internal combustion engines, while EVs require a different propulsion system. He further said that some companies had expressed interest in establishing additional CNG stations in the state, adding that agreements had been reached with them. He explained that the proposed stations would cater to privately owned vehicles and other consumers, rather than the state’s public transportation system. Otti said that CNG was cheaper to use than petrol and expressed optimism that the conversion of petrol and diesel vehicles to CNG would gain more traction in the country. He also said that there are Nigerian companies that specialised in converting internal combustion engine vehicles to CNG. Otti also responded to the purported complaints about the continued existence of street trading at the Umuahia city centre, popularly called Isi-Gate. According to him, street trading cannot be totally eliminated; hence, it still operates in other developed parts of the world, including London. He promised that traders that might suffer displacement by the state’s urban renewal efforts would be compensated. Otti said that the state government was working to restore order in the capital city, particularly tackling the challenges associated with street trading. He said the relocation of traders from Isi-Gate would be gradual, considering that many petty traders on the street depended on the income for their livelihoods. He said that the government was still exploring alternative locations for traders that would be affected to avoid pushing them into activities that could further undermine public order. “We are a government that is compassionate. So, if we move you out of your shop, we will pay you compensation. We will ensure that,” he said. Otti argued that displacing traders without considering their economic circumstances would defeat the purpose of the government’s urban renewal programme. “It doesn’t make sense to drive everybody away. Who are you even sanitising the place for? “So, it is a balancing act. We are handling it step by step,” he said. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/otti.title_zh: Otti解释阿比亚州为何偏爱电动巴士而非压缩天然气巴士
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/otti.body_zh: Abia州长Alex Otti表示，他的政府选择电动汽车（EVs），而不是压缩天然气（CNG）驱动巴士，是因为电动汽车代表着交通技术的升级。Otti解释说，正因如此，政府才为公共公交系统选择电动巴士。他在10月举行的月度媒体交流活动上作出上述解释。活动于周五晚上在Umuahia的Michael Okpara Auditorium举行。他说，尽管州政府优先选择EVs，但仍在鼓励该州增设更多CNG加气站。Otti说：“我们并不反对CNG，但我们的公共公交系统选择了电动汽车。”他说，汽油车和CNG车辆都采用内燃机，而EVs需要另一套推进系统。他还表示，一些公司有意在该州增设更多CNG加气站，目前已与这些公司达成协议。他解释说，计划增设的加气站将服务私人拥有的车辆和其他消费者，而不是州政府的公共公交系统。Otti表示，CNG的使用成本低于汽油，并乐观预计，将汽油车和柴油车改装为使用CNG将在全国得到更广泛推广。他还说，尼日利亚有一些公司专门从事将内燃机汽车改装为CNG车辆。Otti还回应了有关Umuahia市中心俗称Isi-Gate的区域仍然存在街头摆卖活动的所谓投诉。据他所说，街头摆卖无法彻底消除，因此世界上其他发达地区，包括London，也依然存在这种活动。他承诺，可能因州政府推进城市更新而被迫迁离的商贩将获得补偿。Otti表示，州政府正努力恢复这座首府城市的秩序，尤其着力解决街头摆卖带来的问题。他说，考虑到许多街头小贩依靠这项收入维持生计，将商贩迁出Isi-Gate的工作将逐步推进。他还表示，政府仍在为受影响的商贩寻找其他安置地点，以免迫使他们从事可能进一步破坏公共秩序的活动。他说：“我们是一个富有同情心的政府。因此，如果我们将你们从店铺迁出，就会向你们支付补偿。我们会确保这一点。”Otti认为，不考虑商贩的经济状况就迫使他们迁离，将使政府的城市更新计划适得其反。他说：“把所有人都赶走是说不通的。你们究竟是为了谁才整治这个地方？所以，这需要权衡取舍。我们正逐步处理此事。”（ NAN ）此处发表的意见不代表《Vanguard》报社及其任何员工的观点。

https://leadership.ng/lagos-intensifies-.body: The state government, during the exercise led by the wife of Lagos State Governor, Dr Ibijoke Sanwo-Olu, in the Ajina area of Ikorodu Local Government, and the Head of Service, Mr Bode Agoro, in the Ikeja area of the state, warned that the practice undermines sanitation efforts and increases the risk of flooding. The wife of the Lagos State Governor, Dr Ibijoke Sanwo-Olu, disclosed this while monitoring the monthly environmental sanitation exercise in Ikorodu. The governor’s wife urged residents of Ikorodu to sustain the exercise beyond the last Saturday of every month and work towards emerging as the cleanest Local Government Area in the state. She emphasised that continuous public sensitisation remains essential for promoting environmental cleanliness, despite the challenges of behavioural change. Mrs Sanwo-Olu encouraged residents to embrace proper sanitation practices in their homes, schools, markets and communities, stressing that keeping Lagos clean is a collective responsibility. She commended the active participation of residents, particularly children, youths, market traders and environmental sanitation workers, who turned out early to clean their surroundings. In the same vein, Agoro said the exercise was the seventh since March, calling on local government chairpersons and their executives to mobilise residents to improve environmental cleanliness. He stressed that sanitation must be a continuous responsibility, noting that government officials observed residents dumping refuse into canals during the exercise. According to him, the Ministry of the Environment has been notified to clear affected canals, while plans are also underway to reconstruct a canal in the area in consultation with the relevant drainage authorities. https://leadership.ng/cbn-appoints-8-pre.summary_zh: 这份通告依据《1996年第10号进口装运前检验法》印发，发给获授权的经销商银行、尼日利亚海关总署、尼日利亚上游石油监管委员会（NUPRC）、尼日利亚国家石油有限公司、尼日利亚中游和下游石油监管局、码头运营商、石油天然气公司及公众。
https://leadership.ng/cbn-appoints-8-pre.body: The appointments take effect from October 2, 2026, under the Nigerian Export Supervision Scheme. They were contained in a circular dated October 29, 2026 (ref: TED/FEM/FPC/PUB/001/005), signed by Aderinola Shonekan, Director of the Trade and Exchange Department. The circular, issued in line with the Pre-shipment Inspection of Imports Act No. 10 of 1996, is addressed to authorised dealer banks, the Nigeria Customs Service, the Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission (NUPRC), the Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited, the Nigerian Midstream and Downstream Petroleum Regulatory Authority, terminal operators, oil and gas companies and the public. It directs all of them to ensure compliance. Arlington Securitas Nigeria Ltd will monitor Dakee Engineering and Construction Ltd, Trobell International Nigeria Ltd, Robinson International Energy Ltd and Integrated Shipping Services Nigeria Ltd. The latest move follows several adjustments to the scheme. In May 2024, the CBN appointed 11 agents: nine pre-shipment inspection agents and two monitoring and evaluation agents. Dakee Engineering and Construction and Arlington Securitas were on that list. The allocation of terminals was reviewed in March 2025. In July 2026, the bank named Candid Oil Services Ltd as inspection agent for the Taurus Oil and Gas Depot. The new circular changes the companies responsible for inspecting export cargoes and the terminals each one covers. The appointments come as gas export earnings grow. According to CBN data, Nigeria earned $2.53 billion from gas exports in the first quarter of 2026. We’ve got the edge. https://punchng.com/aiyedatiwa-plans-cal.body: The Ondo State Government plans to establish a youth call centre, to be known as the Ondo State Youth Call Centre, as a channel of communication between the government and young people. The initiative is designed to provide a direct and accessible communication channel between the government and youths across the state’s 18 Local Government Areas. This was contained in a statement issued on Saturday by the Special Assistant to Governor Lucky Aiyedatiwa on Youth and Social Inclusion, Comrade Henry Okunomo. According to the statement, the centre will serve as a central platform where young people can “make enquiries, seek information about employment and empowerment opportunities, report challenges, submit complaints, access relevant government interventions and communicate their concerns directly to the appropriate authorities.” The statement read, “The initiative will also promote youth participation in governance, strengthen social inclusion, facilitate access to educational and entrepreneurial opportunities and ensure that the voices of young people, particularly those in underserved and riverine communities, are heard and appropriately addressed. Ondo bizman commits suicide, family cries foul play N70,000 allowance: Labour turns heat on govs My sister fears losing Air Force home after husband’s death — Sister-in-law “Through this platform, the Office of the Special Assistant to the Governor on Youth and Social Inclusion seeks to bridge the communication gap between government and young people while establishing a more structured mechanism for identifying, documenting and responding to youth-related concerns. “The centre will also facilitate referrals to relevant Ministries, Departments and Agencies, ensuring that enquiries and complaints receive appropriate attention.” The statement added that the initiative reflected an approach to youth engagement that recognised young people not merely as beneficiaries of government policies but as important stakeholders in governance, development and social transformation. “The youth call centre meets the 21st century rapid response and synergy required for youth and social inclusion. The official launch, operational arrangements and communication channels will be made public in due course,” the statement concluded. Peter Dada
https://punchng.com/aiyedatiwa-plans-cal.title_zh: Aiyedatiwa计划设立呼叫中心，与奥多州青年沟通
https://punchng.com/aiyedatiwa-plans-cal.body_zh: 奥多州政府计划设立一个青年呼叫中心，名为“奥多州青年呼叫中心”，作为政府与年轻人沟通的渠道。该举措旨在为政府与全州18个地方政府辖区的青年建立直接且便捷的沟通渠道。州长Lucky Aiyedatiwa青年与社会包容事务特别助理Henry Okunomo同志于星期六发布的声明中提到了这一点。声明称，该中心将作为统一平台，让年轻人可以“查询情况、了解就业和赋权机会、报告难题、提交投诉、获取相关政府援助，并直接向主管机关反映诉求”。声明写道：“该举措还将促进青年参与治理，加强社会包容，便利青年获取教育与创业机会，并确保年轻人的声音，尤其是服务不足地区和河流社区青年的声音得到倾听和妥善处理。奥多州商人自杀，家人质疑存在他杀N70,000津贴：劳工加强对政府的施压 我的姐姐担心丈夫去世后失去空军家属住宅——嫂子‘通过这一平台，州长青年与社会包容事务特别助理办公室力求弥合政府与年轻人之间的沟通鸿沟，同时建立一套更有条理的机制，用于识别、记录和回应与青年有关的问题。‘该中心还将协助向相关部委、部门和机构转介事项，确保咨询和投诉得到妥善处理。’声明补充称，该举措体现了一种青年参与方针，即承认年轻人不仅是政府政策的受益者，也是治理、发展和社会转型的重要利益相关者。‘青年呼叫中心满足了青年与社会包容工作对21世纪快速响应和协同配合的要求。正式启动、运营安排和沟通渠道将在适当时候公布。’声明最后说道。Peter Dada

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.summary_zh: 总统博拉·蒂努布欢迎Airtel Nigeria启动“开放网络”计划，称这是迈向提高透明度、保护消费者权益和改善尼日利亚电信服务的一项积极举措。蒂努布总统表示，该计划契合其政府鼓励私营部门投资、扩大数字基础设施，并确保尼日利亚民众享受到更加可靠和便捷电信服务的承诺。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body: President Bola Tinubu has welcomed the launch of Airtel Nigeria’s Open Network initiative, describing it as a positive step towards greater transparency, consumer protection and improved telecommunications services in Nigeria. President Tinubu said the initiative aligns with his administration’s commitment to encouraging private-sector investment, expanding digital infrastructure, and ensuring Nigerians benefit from more reliable and accessible telecommunications services. He welcomed the growing emphasis on transparency in the sector, including the NCC’s public network coverage maps, performance information and consumer satisfaction surveys, which help Nigerians better understand the services available to them and hold operators accountable. The president also highlighted the federal government’s recent Zero-Rated Access to Educational Platforms and Content Initiative, implemented through the NCC in collaboration with the Federal Ministry of Education and telecommunications operators. The programme, designed to provide eligible students with up to 100MB of free daily data to access approved educational websites and learning resources, reflects his administration’s determination to make digital opportunities more accessible, particularly to young Nigerians. He welcomed Airtel Nigeria’s continued investment in network expansion, which has seen its infrastructure grow from approximately 15,000 sites two years ago to more than 17,000 nationwide. The expansion includes more than 1,050 network sites added during the company’s 2025/26 financial year, including 657 5G sites. President Tinubu said sustained investment in telecommunications infrastructure is essential to expanding broadband access, improving network capacity, and supporting businesses, education, and economic opportunities across Nigeria. He commended the NCC, under the leadership of Dr Maida, for its continued efforts to strengthen regulatory oversight, promote transparency and protect telecommunications consumers. The president urged operators to sustain investment in network expansion, particularly in underserved communities, and ensure that customer complaints receive timely attention. He emphasised that the success of telecommunications investment and innovation must ultimately be measured by the experience of Nigerians who depend on these services for their livelihoods, businesses and everyday communication. President Tinubu reaffirmed his administration’s commitment to maintaining a business environment that encourages responsible investment and innovation while ensuring that consumer interests remain central to telecommunications development. He called on operators to translate their investments into better network coverage, fewer service disruptions and more responsive customer service for Nigerians
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body_zh: 总统博拉·蒂努布对Airtel Nigeria启动开放网络倡议表示欢迎，称这是迈向加强尼日利亚网络透明度、消费者保护和改善电信服务的一步积极举措。蒂努布总统表示，该倡议契合其政府鼓励私营部门投资、扩大数字基础设施并确保尼日利亚民众受益于更可靠、更易获取的电信服务的承诺。他欢迎电信行业日益重视透明度，包括NCC发布的公共网络覆盖地图、绩效信息和消费者满意度调查，这些举措有助于尼日利亚民众更好地了解可获得的各项服务，并督促运营商履行职责。总统还强调，联邦政府近期推出了“教育平台与内容零费率接入倡议”，由NCC与联邦教育部及电信运营商协作实施。该计划旨在向符合条件的用户提供每天最多100MB的免费流量，以便访问获批的教育网站和学习资源，体现了其政府决心让数字机会更加普及，尤其是惠及尼日利亚年轻人。他欢迎Airtel Nigeria持续投资扩大网络覆盖，其基础设施已从两年前的约15,000个站点增至全国超过17,000个站点。公司在2025/26财年新增了超过1,050个网络站点，其中包括657个5G站点。蒂努布总统表示，持续投资电信基础设施对于扩大宽带接入、提升网络容量以及支持尼日利亚各地的企业、教育和经济机会至关重要。他赞扬NCC在Maida博士领导下持续努力加强监管、促进透明度并保护电信消费者。总统敦促运营商持续投资扩大网络覆盖，尤其是服务不足的社区，并确保客户投诉得到及时处理。他强调，电信投资与创新的成效最终必须以尼日利亚民众的实际体验来衡量，因为民众依靠这些服务维持生计、经营业务和日常通信。蒂努布总统重申，其政府致力于维护鼓励负责任投资与创新的营商环境，同时确保消费者利益始终是电信发展的核心。他呼吁运营商将投资转化为更好的网络覆盖、更少的服务中断以及为尼日利亚民众提供更迅速响应的客户服务。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/poli.body: Layer 1 The Zamfara Commissioner of Police, CP Muhammad Bello, has confirmed the rescue of three of the six Islamic Clerics (Imam) kidnapped on September 12, while travelling to Talata Mafara, Zamfara. Bello gave the confirmation in an interview with some select reporters on Friday in Gusau. He said the rescue followed a multi-agency collaboration and seamless synergy between the Office of the National Security Adviser (ONSA), the Department of State Services (DSS) and police operatives. The CP said security tactical operations remained ongoing in full force, leveraging real-time intelligence supplied by local community members to track down the remaining armed bandits and ensure the safe rescue of the three clerics still in captivity. The News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) reports that the ONSA, in a high-stakes intelligence-driven collaboration with the DSS and the Nigeria Police Force (NPF), rescued the three Islamic clerics kidnapped while en route to a special prayer session for President Bola Tinubu in Talata Mafara, Zamfara. NAN also reports that the victims were part of a group of six Islamic clerics abducted on Sept. 12, when heavily armed bandits intercepted them around 11:30 a.m. on the Dakko-Damri feeder road near Sububu Forest in Bakura Local Government Area. The clerics, identified as Imam Yahuza, Magawata Abdullahi, Malam Shehu Dakko, Imam Bala Fagon and Na’ibi Tasi’u, were travelling to Talata Mafara to attend a special prayer gathering to seek divine favour for Tinubu’s administration. Their abductors had reportedly demanded N30 million ransom for their release. A senior security operative involved in the extraction also confirmed that the three clerics were rescued unhurt following meticulous, intelligence-led manoeuvres. NAN learnt that the clerics are said to be in stable condition after receiving medical evaluation and expert debriefing. The security operatives confirmed that the three clerics were slated for formal handover to the Zamfara Government to reunite them with their families. The Police command assured that operational leads would continue, urging the public to maintain a vigilant flow of timely, actionable information to help flush out terrorist elements across the region. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/poli.title_zh: 警方确认已营救3名在赞法拉遭绑架的伊斯兰教clerics
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/poli.body_zh: 第1层 扎姆法拉州警察局长穆罕默德·贝洛确认，6名于9月12日在前往扎姆法拉州塔拉塔马法拉途中遭绑架的伊斯兰教clerics（伊玛目）中，已有3人获救。贝洛周五在古绍接受部分记者采访时证实了這一消息。他说，此次营救行动由国家安全顾问办公室（ONSA）、国家情报局（DSS）和警察人员多方协作、密切配合完成。警察局长表示，安全部门仍在全力开展战术行动，利用当地社区居民提供的实时情报追查其余武装劫匪，并确保仍被拘押的3名clerics安全获救。尼日利亚通讯社（NAN）报道，ONSA与DSS及尼日利亚警察部队（NPF）在情报主导的高风险协作行动中，救出了3名在前往扎姆法拉州塔拉塔马法拉参加总统博拉·蒂努布特别祈祷会途中遭绑架的伊斯兰教clerics。NAN还报道，遇害者属于9月12日一起绑架案的6名伊斯兰教clerics。当天上午11时30分左右，重武装劫匪在巴库拉地方政府辖区苏布武森林附近的达克奥—达姆里支线公路上拦截了他们。这些clerics被确认为伊玛目亚胡扎、马加瓦塔·阿卜杜拉希、马拉姆谢胡·达克奥、伊玛目巴拉·法贡和奈比·塔西乌，他们当时正前往塔拉塔马法拉，参加一场特别祈祷集会，为蒂努布政府祈求神的眷顾。据报道，绑架者要求支付3000万奈拉赎金后才肯放人。参与营救行动的一名高级安全官员也证实，经过周密筹划、以情报为导向的行动，3名clerics已安全获救，毫发无损。NAN获悉，这些clerics在接受医学检查和专家询问后状况稳定。安全行动人员证实，这3名clerics将正式移交给扎姆法拉州政府，以便与家人团聚。警方指挥部保证将继续追查行动线索，并敦促公众保持警惕，及时提供切实可行的情报，协助清除该地区各地的恐怖分子。此处发表的意见不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点

https://www.lesahel.org/cnpcnp-arret-du-.source: Le Sahel（尼日尔官方报·法语）
https://www.lesahel.org/cnpcnp-arret-du-.summary: Selon des sources proches des opérations d’intervention sur le terrain, le déversement au niveau du puits GW-8 du champ pétrolier d’Agadem, qui suscitait une préoccupation constante des équipes d’intervention d’urgence, a cessé le 20 octobre. Le sable contaminé a fait l’objet d’une prise en charge appropriée et la situation est entièrement maîtrisée.
https://www.lesahel.org/cnpcnp-arret-du-.summary_zh: 据与实地干预行动有关的消息人士称，Agadem油田GW-8油井的井口喷流已停止，这股喷流此前一直令应急干预团队担忧。喷流已于10月20日停止。受污染的沙子已得到妥善处置，局势已得到全面控制。
https://www.lesahel.org/cnpcnp-arret-du-.body: Selon des sources proches des opérations d’intervention sur le terrain, le déversement au niveau du puits GW-8 du champ pétrolier d’Agadem, qui suscitait une préoccupation constante des équipes d’intervention d’urgence, a cessé le 20 octobre. L’état du puits s’est stabilisé. À ce jour, aucun décès ni blessé n’est à déplorer. Le sable contaminé a fait l’objet d’une prise en charge appropriée et la situation est entièrement maîtrisée. Les travaux visant à consolider la sécurité du site et à réhabiliter l’environnement se poursuivent. Le mélange de pétrole brut et d’eau ne s’écoule plus de la tête du puits GW-8. Pour les équipes mobilisées dans les opérations d’urgence depuis le début du déversement, le 25 septembre, cet arrêt signifie que les premières mesures de neutralisation du puits ont produit leurs effets. Il marque une avancée majeure dans les opérations d’urgence et crée des conditions plus favorables à la poursuite des travaux. Situé au cœur du désert du Sahara, dans le département de N’Gourti, ce puits se trouve loin des villes et des zones habitées. Aucun habitant ne réside dans un rayon de cinq (5) kilomètres du site. Cet événement a été provoqué par une détérioration du tubage au niveau de la tête du puits, entraînant un déversement de pétrole brut. Malgré l’éloignement des zones habitées, la CNPCNP, opérateur du champ pétrolier dans le cadre des opérations conjointes, a veillé, tout au long des opérations d’intervention, au respect des exigences de sécurité sur le site et de protection de l’environnement. Dès la survenue de cette situation d’urgence, la CNPCNP a immédiatement informé les autorités compétentes et déclenché rapidement les procédures d’intervention d’urgence. Elle a arrêté le fonctionnement des pompes, coupé l’alimentation électrique, établi des périmètres de sécurité, interdit l’introduction de toute source d’ignition sur site et assuré une surveillance continue des gaz présents sur le site. Les deux autres puits voisins du GW-8 ont également été successivement mis à l’arrêt et soumis à des mesures de sécurisation, afin d’éviter qu’ils ne soient affectés par cet événement. Ces dispositions traduisent une responsabilité claire : tout en faisant face à la situation d’urgence existante, éviter autant que possible l’apparition de nouveaux risques. Après plusieurs phases d’intervention, la majeure partie des souillures pétrolières présentes sur le site du puits a déjà été récupérée et nettoyée. Les couches sols sableux superficiellement affectées par l’écoulement du pétrole brut ont également été décapées. La concrétisation des responsabilités à chaque étape constitue une démarche commune des parties chinoise et nigérienne. Cette intervention d’urgence a mis à l’épreuve non seulement les compétences techniques nécessaires aux interventions au niveau de la tête du puits, mais aussi la mobilisation des équipements, le transport des matériels, l’organisation du personnel et la coordination entre les différentes équipes. L’acheminement de chaque équipement et de chaque lot de matériel jusqu’au site nécessitait un travail d’organisation et de transport. Le Ministère du Pétrole a dépêché un groupe de travail pour soutenir et orienter les opérations d’intervention d’urgence. Les autorités de suivi et du contrôle environnemental et les représentants des autorités locales ont également assuré le suivi des opérations sur le terrain. Le 14 octobre, le Ministre du Pétrole et le Ministre chargé de l’Environnement ont conduit une délégation gouvernementale de haut niveau sur le site pour une visite de terrain. Tout au long de cet événement, les autorités compétentes ont été tenues informées de la situation et ont assuré le suivi et la supervision des opérations. De son côté, la partie chinoise a fourni un soutien technique spécialisé ainsi que des ressources destinées aux interventions d’urgence. Des experts et des spécialistes d’intervention d’urgence ont été dépêchés de la Chine en plusieurs équipes pour rejoindre celles déjà présentes sur le champ pétrolier et participer ensemble aux opérations. La partie nigérienne n’a, quant à elle, ménagé aucun effort pour l’entrée du personnel sur le territoire, les formalités douanières relatives aux matériels et les dispositifs de sécurité. Les entreprises contractantes venues de différents pays ont chacune assumé leurs tâches respectives, contribuant tous ensemble à la sécurité du site et à la maîtrise de la situation d’urgence. L’expérience accumulée et les mécanismes de coordination établis au fil de nombreuses années de coopération pétrolière entre la Chine et le Niger ont également joué un rôle dans cette intervention. La situation au niveau de la tête du puits est maîtrisée, mais les travaux de réhabilitation environnementale se poursuivent. À ce jour, le Bureau National d’Évaluation Environnementale (BNEE) a engagé un examen de conformité environnementale. Les équipes présentes sur le terrain travaillent en coordination avec les autorités gouvernementales compétentes et les communautés locales afin d’accélérer l’évaluation des impacts environnementaux et les opérations de réhabilitation écologique, en mettant tout en œuvre pour réduire au minimum les conséquences de cet événement. Les causes font toujours l’objet d’une enquête. Pour ceux qui suivent l’évolution de cet événement, ce sont les progrès concrets des opérations et les résultats visibles des travaux de nettoyage qui permettent de renforcer la confiance. Les travaux concernant le puits GW-8 se poursuivent. Grâce à l’organisation des interventions d’urgence, à la mise en œuvre des mesures techniques et à la mobilisation des ressources, la CNPCNP a fait preuve d’un professionnalisme technique remarquable, d’une discipline rigoureuse et d’une excellente capacité à faire face aux situations d’urgence. Cette approche transparente et professionnelle dans la gestion de cet événement contribue également à consolider la confiance mutuelle entre les deux parties dans les domaines de la gouvernance environnementale et de la gestion de la sécurité
https://www.lesahel.org/cnpcnp-arret-du-.title_zh: CNPCNP——阿加德姆GW-8号油井停止泄漏：紧急情况已得到全面控制
https://www.lesahel.org/cnpcnp-arret-du-.body_zh: 据与现场干预行动有关的消息，Agadem油田GW-8井的泄漏已停止。该泄漏此前一直令应急干预人员担忧，停止时间为10月20日。井口状况已稳定。截至目前，未造成人员死亡或受伤。受污染的沙土已得到妥善处置，局势已完全得到控制。为加强现场安全并修复环境而开展的工作仍在继续。原油和水的混合物已不再从GW-8井井口流出。自9月25日泄漏发生以来一直参与应急行动的队伍表示，此次停流意味着井口初步中和措施已取得成效。这标志着应急行动取得重大进展，并为后续工作的继续开展创造了更有利的条件。该井位于撒哈拉沙漠腹地，处在N’Gourti县，远离城镇和居民区。现场周边五（5）公里范围内没有居民居住。此次事件由井口套管劣化引发，造成原油泄漏。尽管居民区距离现场较远，作为联合运营框架下该油田运营商的CNPCNP，在整个干预行动期间始终确保遵守现场安全及环境保护要求。紧急情况发生后，CNPCNP立即通知主管机关，并迅速启动应急干预程序。公司停止泵机运行，切断电源，划定安全警戒区，禁止将任何火源带入现场，并持续监测现场气体。GW-8附近的其他两口井也已先后停运并采取安全防护措施，以防受到此次事件影响。这些措施体现了明确的责任意识：在应对现有紧急情况的同时，尽可能避免产生新的风险。经过多个阶段的干预，现场井口区域的大部分石油污染物已得到回收和清理。受到原油流浅层影响的沙土地层也已剥除。各阶段落实责任，是中尼双方共同推动的工作。此次应急行动不仅考验了井口干预所需的技术能力，也考验了设备调集、物资运输、人员组织和不同队伍之间的协调。将每件设备和每批物资运至现场，都需要周密组织和运输。石油部已派出工作组，为应急干预行动提供支持和指导。环境跟踪与监管机构以及地方当局代表也对现场行动进行跟踪。10月14日，石油部长和主管环境事务的部长率领政府高级代表团赴现场视察。整个事件期间，主管机关始终了解情况，并对行动进行跟踪和监督。中方则提供了专业技术支持以及用于应急干预的resources。中国以多个小组为单位派出应急干预专家和技术人员，与已在油田现场的人员会合，共同参与行动。尼日利亚方面为人员入境、物资海关手续和安全措施提供全力支持。来自不同国家的承包企业各自履行职责，共同为现场安全和紧急局势的控制作出贡献。中尼多年来在石油领域合作中积累的经验和建立的协调机制，也在此次干预中发挥了作用。目前，井口局势已得到控制，但环境修复工作仍在继续。截至目前，国家环境评估局（BNEE）已启动环境合规审查。现场队伍正与政府主管机关和当地社区协调工作，加快环境影响评估和生态修复行动，并竭尽全力将此次事件造成的后果降至最低。事件原因仍在调查之中。对于关注此次事态进展的人士而言，行动取得的切实进展和清理工作呈现的成果，正不断增强各方的信心。GW-8井相关工作仍在继续。凭借应急行动的组织、技术措施的实施和资源调集，CNPCNP展现了出色的技术专业能力、严格的纪律和卓越的应急处置能力。在此次事件管理中采取透明、专业的做法，也有助于加强双方在环境治理和安全管理领域的互信

https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.body: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) has arrested 15 suspects, comprising 14 Chinese and one Nigerian, at four illegal lithium processing plants in the Ogere area of Ogun State. The commission disclosed this in a post on its official X account, stating that operatives of its Lagos Zonal Directorate 2 carried out the arrests on Friday, October 23, 2026, following credible intelligence and surveillance. Items recovered during the operation included bags of lithium rocks, 18 mobile devices, four computer laptops, two decoders, a television remote control and a trailer truck. The EFCC said the recovered items had been taken as part of its investigation into the activities of the facilities, adding that the suspects would be charged to court upon the conclusion of investigations. However, the agency did not disclose the specific offences the suspects were alleged to have committed or the ownership of the processing plants. Lithium has become a highly sought-after mineral globally because of its critical role in manufacturing rechargeable batteries used in electric vehicles, smartphones, laptops and renewable energy storage systems. Growing demand for electric vehicles and clean energy technologies has intensified the race to secure lithium supplies, making the mineral increasingly valuable and creating incentives for illegal mining and processing. Nigeria is emerging as a new source of lithium in Africa as the world’s largest producers, like Australia and Chile, are unable to fulfil the growing demand worldwide. However, illegal activities thrive in Nigeria’s extractive sector, denying the government due revenues of up to $9 billion, according to the Nigeria Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (NEITI). The country’s lithium deposits have attracted growing interest from local and foreign operators, while concerns over unregulated extraction, revenue losses, environmental degradation, and the potential circumvention of mining regulations have heightened calls for stricter enforcement. https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.title_zh: 非法锂矿开采：经济和金融犯罪委员会在奥贡州拘捕14名中国人和1名尼日利亚人
https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.body_zh: 经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）在奥贡州奥盖雷地区的4家非法锂加工厂逮捕了15名嫌疑人，其中14名为中国人、1名为尼日利亚人。该委员会在其官方X账号发布的一则消息中披露，拉各斯第2区分局行动人员于2026年10月23日星期五根据可靠情报和监视行动实施了逮捕。行动中缴获的物品包括装在袋中的锂矿石、18部移动设备、4台笔记本电脑、2个解码器、1个电视遥控器和1辆拖挂卡车。EFCC表示，缴获的物品已作为调查这些工厂经营活动的一部分被查扣，并称调查结束后将把嫌疑人移交法院起诉。然而，该机构没有披露嫌疑人被指控实施的具体罪行，也没有披露这些加工厂的归属。锂已成为全球备受追捧的矿产，因为它在制造用于电动汽车、智能手机、笔记本电脑和可再生能源储存系统的可充电电池方面发挥着关键作用。电动汽车和清洁能源技术需求不断增长，加剧了各国争夺锂供应的竞争，使这种矿产的价值日益提高，也刺激了非法采矿和加工活动。随着澳大利亚和智利等全球最大生产国无法满足全球不断增长的需求，尼日利亚正成为非洲新的锂来源。然而，尼日利亚采掘业的非法活动十分猖獗，使政府损失最高达90亿美元的收入，据尼日利亚采掘业透明度倡议（NEITI）称。该国的锂矿藏吸引了越来越多的本地和外国运营商关注，同时，对不受监管的开采、收入流失、环境破坏以及规避采矿法规的担忧，也强化了要求加强执法的呼声。Adedapo Adesanya是一名记者、多才多艺的学者，也是艺术各个领域的行家。不写作时，他不是埋首阅读自己收藏夹中的众多书籍或文章之一，就是拿着一瓶啤酒或葡萄酒聆听好音乐。他支持世界上最伟大的俱乐部——Manchester United F.C.

https://leadership.ng/niger-republic-tig.body: The new policy says marketers would not sell fuel between nine at night and six in the morning to enable suppliers, including the Nigerien Petroleum Company (Sonidep), to restock them. It said this temporary measure aimed to improve the smooth running of operations while guaranteeing deliveries and the availability of petrol, following a countrywide shortage. But the measure is impacting taxis drivers, like Moussa Idé Boubacar, who said he has not been able to make his payments for two days. “Normally, we generate revenue of around 20,000 a day, of which 8,000 is for payments and 12,000 is for fuel. With this shortage, we’ve had some management issues,” he said. As the fuel shortage spread, motorists have been facing increasingly long queues at stations. Residents in the capital, Niamey, and elsewhere said this was disrupting daily life, making it difficult to get to work and carry out their daily activities. The taxi union, Synctaxi, has called for the new curfew to be relaxed for operators who are struggling to make ends meet. “To obtain fuel, you need authorisation. The petrol station must be open around the clock,” said it secretary-general, Ganda Sanda. “We are appealing to the governorate and the governor as well to reconsider because it does not suit us,” he said. Sanda added that the union wanted to draw the authorities’ attention to the fact that the transport sector “makes a significant contribution to the country’s development”. https://x.com/sun_jun69301/status/211746.title: Tarriela, you seem obsessed with blaming China for every problem the Philippines faces, using legal jargon to disguise your government’s fai
https://x.com/sun_jun69301/status/211746.snippet:
Tarriela, you seem obsessed with blaming China for every problem the Philippines faces, using legal jargon to disguise your government’s failures and justify its anti-China agenda.

Let’s be clear: China is not responsible for the Philippine government’s repeated policy failures.

The 2005 JMSU was declared unconstitutional by the Philippine Supreme Court because of problems within the Philippines’ own constitutional and decision-making framework. China did not write your Constitution.

The 2018 oil and gas cooperation MOU preserved both sides’ legal positions and created no binding obligation for joint development. After years of negotiations, the Philippine side terminated the talks. You cannot rewrite that history simply to make China the villain.

And stop waving the 2016 arbitration ruling as though it gave the Philippines sovereignty over the South China Sea. It did not settle territorial sovereignty or maritime boundaries. You cannot turn a limited arbitration ruling into a political weapon to justify your country’s ambitions.

What is even more revealing is that the Philippines continues to pursue confrontation with China while failing to secure broad support among ASEAN members for its hardline anti-China agenda.

ASEAN does not belong to Manila, and the South China Sea is not your personal political stage.

China has every right to defend its sovereignty, territorial integrity, maritime rights and national interests. No amount of political grandstanding by Philippine officials will change that.

The Filipino people deserve affordable energy, investment, jobs and economic development. They do not need politicians manufacturing hostility toward their largest neighbors to cover up domestic failures.

Tarriela, stop exploiting the South China Sea issue for political attention and personal advancement.

China is not the enemy of the Filipino people. The real disservice to the Philippines is a political establishment that would rather manufacture an enemy than pursue genuine development and regional cooperation.

China will not surrender its legitimate rights and interests simply to satisfy the political ambitions of anti-China politicians.

And stop waving the 2016 arbitration ruling as though it gave the Philippines sovereignty over the South China Sea. It did not settle territorial sovereignty or maritime boundaries. You cannot turn a limited arbitration ruling into a political weapon to justify your country’s ambitions.

What is even more revealing is that the Philippines continues to pursue confrontation with China while failing to secure broad support among ASEAN members for its hardline anti-China agenda.

ASEAN does not belong to Manila, and the South China Sea is not your personal political stage.

China has every right to defend its sovereignty, territorial integrity, maritime rights and national interests. No amount of political grandstanding by Philippine officials will change that.

The Filipino people deserve affordable energy, investment, jobs and economic development. They do not need politicians manufacturing hostility toward their largest neighbors to cover up domestic failures.

Tarriela, stop exploiting the South China Sea issue for political attention and personal advancement.

China is not the enemy of the Filipino people. The real disservice to the Philippines is a political establishment that would rather manufacture an enemy than pursue genuine development and regional cooperation.

China will not surrender its legitimate rights and interests simply to satisfy the political ambitions of anti-China politicians.

https://x.com/jaytaryela/status/21173835.snippet:
Mr. Senator, tama po kayo, dalawang administrasyon ang nagtulak ng joint exploration. Pero hindi po ang ating Constitution ang may sala, kundi ang China. As a matter of fact, ang Constitution pa nga ang pumigil para hindi unfairly ma-exploit ang ating likas na yaman!

Itama lang po natin ang sharing arrangements na binanggit ninyo:

1. JMSU, 2005 (President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo)

Hindi po ang Pangulo ang pumirma kundi ang PNOC, kasama ang CNOOC ng China at PetroVietnam. Pantay ang karapatan ng tatlong partido, kaya one-third lang ang boses ng Pilipinas sa 142,886 sq km na Agreement Area, na karamihan ay nasa loob ng ating EEZ at continental shelf. Pati ang seismic data ay jointly owned, at kailangan pa ng written consent ng CNOOC at PetroVietnam bago ito ma-disclose ng ating gobyerno. 

Kaya sa botong 12-2-1, idineklara ng Supreme Court na unconstitutional at void ang JMSU (Bayan Muna v. Macapagal-Arroyo, G.R. No. 182734, 10 Enero 2023). Ibinasura nang may finality ang Motion for Reconsideration noong 27 Hunyo 2023. Sabi pa ng Korte, dahil nasa loob ng ating EEZ at continental shelf ang lugar, ang anumang likas na yaman doon ay pag-aari ng Republika.

2. MOU on Oil and Gas Development, 2018 (President Duterte)

Walang 60-40 na nakasulat sa MOU. Framework lang ito para magbukas ng negosasyon. Ang "60-40" ay hango sa Constitution at sa Oil Exploration and Development Act ng Pilipinas, na siyang nagtatakda ng Service Contract system.
Bakit natigil ang usapan noong Hunyo 2022? Dahil ayaw ng China na pumasok sa ilalim ng ating Service Contract system, na kumikilalang atin ang langis at gas sa ating EEZ at continental shelf. Si dating Pangulong Duterte mismo ang nagsabing hindi ito puwedeng kapalit ng soberanya, kahit katiting.

Kaya hindi po Constitution ang humaharang. Pwede po tayong mag-enter into joint development sa foreign corporations, private man o state-owned, pero subject sa requirements ng Constitution at ng ating Service Contract system. Ang tunay na humaharang ay ang pagtanggi ng China na kilalanin na atin ang langis, gas at mineral sa ating EEZ at continental shelf.

Hindi rin Constitution ang humarang sa survey ng M/V Veritas Voyager sa Recto Bank noong Marso 2011. Mga barko ng China Marine Surveillance iyon, at ayon sa 2016 Arbitral Award, nilabag ng China ang ating sovereign rights sa non-living resources ng ating continental shelf sa Recto Bank (UNCLOS Art. 77; Award ¶716, ¶1203.B(8)).

Kung may dapat sisihin kung bakit hindi natin mapakinabangan ang sarili nating langis at gas, hindi ang ating Constitution kundi ang China. 

Agree din po ako sa sinabi ninyo maging bulldog tayo para sa mamamayang Pilipino at hindi maging tuta para sa iisang pamilya!

https://x.com/jaytaryela/status/21173835.title_zh: 参议员先生，您错了，是两个政府启动了联合勘探。但有错的不是我们的宪法，而是……
https://x.com/jaytaryela/status/21173835.snippet_zh:
参议员先生，是你们错了：有两个政府推动联合勘探。但有过错的不是我们的《宪法》，而是中国。事实上，还是《宪法》阻止了我们的自然资源遭到不公平的开发！

我们只纠正一下您提到的分享安排：

1. JMSU，2005年（总统格洛丽亚·马卡帕加尔·阿罗约）

签字的不是总统，而是菲律宾国家石油公司（PNOC），中国海洋石油有限公司（CNOOC）和越南石油（PetroVietnam）也参与其中。三方权利平等，因此菲律宾在面积142,886平方公里的协议区内只有三分之一的话语权，而该区域大部分位于我们的专属经济区和大陆架内。地震数据也由三方共同所有，在我国政府披露之前，还须取得CNOOC和越南石油的书面同意。

因此，在12比2比1的裁决中，最高法院宣布JMSU违宪且无效（Bayan Muna诉Macapagal-Arroyo案，G.R. No. 182734，2023年1月10日）。复议动议于2023年6月27日被最终驳回。法院还指出，由于该地区位于我们的专属经济区和大陆架内，那里的任何自然资源均归共和国所有。

2. 《石油和天然气开发谅解备忘录》，2018年（总统杜特尔特）

谅解备忘录中并未写入60比40的安排。这只是一份为开启谈判而制定的框架。“60比40”的规定来自菲律宾《宪法》和《石油勘探与开发法》，后者确立了服务合同制度。

为什么谈判在2022年6月陷入停滞？因为中国不愿进入我们的服务合同制度，而该制度在我们专属经济区和大陆架内勘探、开采石油和天然气方面切实保护我们权益。前总统杜特尔特本人也表示，这一安排无论如何都不能替代主权。

因此，阻碍谈判的不是《宪法》。我们确实可以与外国公司开展联合开发，无论是私营公司还是国有公司，但必须遵守《宪法》和我国服务合同制度的要求。真正的阻碍是中国拒绝承认我国专属经济区和大陆架内的石油、天然气及矿产资源属于我们。

https://x.com/ys_pritam_avhad/status/211.snippet:
India does need to strengthen its manufacturing base. That part of your argument is valid. But attributing the trade imbalance almost entirely to India's structural weaknesses is an incomplete analysis.

In FY26, India exported $19.47 billion to China while importing $131.63 billion. This is not just a manufacturing issue. It is also a question of reciprocal market access.

If Chinese companies enjoy access to India's vast market, Indian businesses should have comparable opportunities in China. Indian exporters continue to face regulatory and non tariff barriers.

India also has legitimate reasons to reduce excessive dependence on a country with which it has unresolved strategic and border tensions. Supply chain diversification is risk management, not necessarily protectionism.

India must become more competitive, but China must also make its market more accessible. Trade cannot be judged only by how efficiently one country sells. Reciprocity, transparency and mutual trust matter too.

A balanced trade relationship requires responsibility from both sides, not a lecture directed at India alone.

https://x.com/ys_pritam_avhad/status/211.snippet_zh:
印度确实需要夯实制造业基础。您论证中的这一点是成立的。但将贸易失衡几乎完全归因于印度的结构性弱点，分析并不完整。

2025—2026财年，印度向中国出口194.7亿美元，而从中国进口1316.3亿美元。这不仅仅是制造业问题，也涉及市场准入的对等性。

如果中国企业能够进入印度庞大的市场，印度企业也应当在中国获得同等机会。印度出口商仍面临监管和非关税壁垒。

印度也有充分理由降低对一个与其存在未解决的战略和边界紧张局势国家的过度依赖。供应链多元化属于风险管理，未必意味着保护主义。

印度必须提高竞争力，但中国也必须让本国市场更易进入。评价贸易不能只看一个国家销售商品的能力。互惠、透明和相互信任同样重要。

平衡的贸易关系需要双方共同承担责任，而不是只对印度进行说教。

https://x.com/asthana_shashi/status/2116.title: Decoding the LAC: Why Headline Sensationalism Misses the Ground Reality of India-China Border Dynamics?
https://x.com/asthana_shashi/status/2116.snippet:
Decoding the LAC: Why Headline Sensationalism Misses the Ground Reality of India-China Border Dynamics? Already viewed by > 450,000

Media headlines thrive on sensationalism and panic, but national security is governed by cold terrain friction, historical legalities, and strategic calculus and military prowess.

In a recent deep-dive discussion on Ankit Inspires India I, alongside my fellow veteran Maj Gen Sanjay Meston, dismantled prevailing ambiguities and viral social media narratives surrounding India’s northern borders—revealing what routine media reporting misses by anchoring our analysis strictly in professional military experience and verifiable open-source research.

Key Insights from the Discussion

1. Deconstructing "Face-Offs" vs. Incursions: The Line of Actual Control is not a mutually demarcated international border; it is an alignment marked by differing perceptions and overlapping patrol limits. Stand-offs occur when simultaneous patrols encounter each other along disputed pockets—managed strictly through structured protocols and Confidence Building Measures (CBMs), not spontaneous tactical collapse.

2. The Arunachal Reality & Historical Context: From the legal framework of the 1914 Simla Convention and the McMahon Line to the 1962 conflict dynamics and Major Bob Khathing’s consolidation of Tawang, Indian sovereignty over Arunachal Pradesh is unassailable. Viral maps and satellite imagery often mistake border village infrastructure on China’s side for incursions, missing the substantial multi-tier defense and infrastructure India has operationalized along the watershed.

3. Operational Command and Synergy: The frontlines are anchored by the Indian Army holds primary operational command and dominates key tactical heights, integrating paramilitary forces like ITBP seamlessly.

4. The Strategic Dilemma: Why hasn't the border been resolved? Both nations face insurmountable domestic political costs regarding territorial trade-offs. Furthermore, at the macro-strategic level, Beijing is acutely aware that a kinetic conflict with India offers zero strategic dividends—it risks disrupting critical sea lines of communication across the Indian Ocean and disproportionately benefits other global powers.

"At the macro-strategic level, a full-scale kinetic conflict offers no strategic victory for Beijing. The terrain friction of Himalayas serve as India’s defensive asset, and any major misadventure by China risks its maritime lifelines across Indian Ocean while serving third-party geopolitical interests." Shashi Asthana

解码实际控制线：为什么头条耸人听闻的报道忽略了印度-中国边境动态的地面现实？浏览量已超过45万

媒体头条靠耸人听闻和制造恐慌而兴盛，但国家安全由严酷的地形摩擦、历史法律依据、战略考量和军事能力所主导。

在最近一次安基特启发印度频道的深度讨论中，我与退役少将桑杰·梅斯顿一同拆解了围绕印度北部边境的普遍模糊认识和病毒式社交媒体叙事——通过严格锚定在专业军事经验和可验证开源研究上的分析，揭示了常规媒体报道所忽略的内容。

讨论要点

1. 解构“对峙”与“入侵”：实际控制线并非双方共同划定的国际边界；而是由不同认知和重叠巡逻范围所标示的一条线。当双方巡逻队在有争议的地段同时相遇时就会发生对峙——这些对峙通过结构化的协议和建立信任措施（CBMs）严格管理，而非战术突然崩溃。

2. 阿鲁纳恰尔邦的现实与历史背景：从1914年西姆拉会议和麦克马洪线的法律框架，到1962年冲突动态以及鲍勃·卡廷少校对达旺的巩固，印度对阿鲁纳恰尔邦的主权不可动摇。病毒式传播的地图和卫星图像常常将中方一侧的边境村庄基础设施误认为是入侵，忽略了印度沿分水岭已投入使用的多层次防御和基础设施。

3. 作战指挥与协同：前线由印度陆军掌握主要作战指挥权并主导关键战术高地，同时无缝整合印度边防部队等准军事力量。

4. 战略困境：为什么边界问题尚未解决？两国在领土让步方面都面临难以逾越的国内政治代价。此外，在宏观战略层面，北京清楚地意识到与印度发生动能冲突不会带来任何战略红利——这会危及印度洋关键海上交通线，并不成比例地使其他全球大国受益。

“在宏观战略层面，全面动能冲突不会给北京带来任何战略胜利。喜马拉雅山脉的地形摩擦是印度的防御资产，中国任何重大冒险都可能危及其穿越印度洋的海上生命线，同时服务于第三方地缘政治利益。”沙希·阿斯塔纳

In October, shipments of Russian oil from Baltic and Arctic seas ports to China via Northern Sea Route continued

Launch of Vostok‑Oil became a key factor in the growth of shipments along the eastern route of Northern Sea Route this year.

Using the Arctic route for supplies from the Baltic reduces the voyage time to China by half (from 51 days from Ust‑Luga to Qingdao around the Cape of Good Hope to 27 days via the Northern Sea Route). 

Even seasonal use of NSR helps to improve economy of Russian crude oil exports. At the same time, navigation through the Bering Strait will be closed in November and flows will be reset.

10月，经北方海路由波罗的海和北极海港口运往中国的俄罗斯石油运输仍在持续。

东方石油（Vostok-Oil）项目启用成为今年北方海路东部航线运输量增长的关键因素。

利用北极航线从波罗的海向中国运输物资，可将航行时间缩短一半（经好望角从乌斯季卢加到青岛需51天，经北方海路则需27天）。

即使只是季节性地使用北方海路，也有助于提高俄罗斯原油出口的效益。与此同时，白令海峡将于11月关闭，运输流向将重新调整。

https://x.com/grok/status/21169638347284.snippet:
Trade volume with China has increased overall, driven by rising imports.

Nepal imported Rs 425 bn from China in FY 2025/26, up 24.7% from Rs 341 bn the prior year. Exports stayed tiny at ~Rs 1.9 bn (often declining). 

Current FY 2026/27 shows continued growth; Mustang alone cleared Rs 26 bn in imports (incl. 6501 EVs) in 3.5 months—already far above its full prior-year total—amid border shifts.

https://x.com/byron_wan/status/211695484.title: 🚨 Chinese vessels suspected of surveying undersea cables have been spotted near Japan, Taiwan and the Philippines, all situated along the Fi
https://x.com/byron_wan/status/211695484.snippet:
🚨 Chinese vessels suspected of surveying undersea cables have been spotted near Japan, Taiwan and the Philippines, all situated along the First Island Chain.

Starting in late Sep, the Chinese research vessel Jia Hai Ke 7 engaged in survey activities for several days without Manila’s permission inside the exclusive economic zone around the Batanes Islands, the Philippine’s northernmost territory, which also faces Taiwan. Manila expressed deep concern, noting that vital undersea cables run through the area.

Although the vessel is reportedly owned by a private Chinese firm, two China Coast Guard ships moved in to escort it when Philippine patrol vessels and aircraft approached. The survey was clearly not an independent operation.

Surveillance data suggests similar activity near Japan. Analysis of tracking data from AIS found Chinese research vessels suspected of mapping undersea cables off Japan.

Since 2024, research vessels affiliated with a Chinese university have repeatedly slowed, stopped and executed sharp turns in international waters east of Hokkaido and within Japan’s EEZ off Nagoya. These abnormal maneuvers directly overlapped with identified undersea cables.

https://x.com/byron_wan/status/211695484.title_zh: 🚨 涉嫌勘测海底电缆的中国船只在日本、台湾和菲律宾附近被发现，这些地方均位于斐济群岛沿线的……
https://x.com/byron_wan/status/211695484.snippet_zh:
🚨 疑似为海底电缆勘测的中国船只近日出现在日本、台湾和菲律宾附近，这些地方均位于第一岛链沿线。

9月下旬起，中国科考船“嘉禾科7”号未经马尼拉许可，连续数日位于菲律宾最北部领土巴丹群岛周围的专属经济区内开展勘测活动；该群岛毗邻台湾。马尼拉对此深表担忧，并指出重要海底电缆途经该区域。

据报道，该船属于一家中国企业，但当菲律宾巡逻船和飞机接近时，中国海警船派出两艘舰艇为其护航。此次勘测显然不是独立行动。

监控数据显示，日本附近也出现了类似活动。对AIS跟踪数据的分析发现，有疑似中国科考船在日本近海绘制海底电缆分布图。

自2024年以来，隶属于一所中国大学的科考船多次在北海道以东国际水域以及名古屋外海日本专属经济区内减速、停船并急转弯。这些异常航行与已确认的海底电缆位置直接重合。

https://x.com/sprex64/status/21168738075.title: 1er Novembre 2026 Les livraisons d'armements chinoises au continent africain connaissent une évolution qualitative.
https://x.com/sprex64/status/21168738075.snippet:
1er Novembre 2026 

Les livraisons d'armements chinoises au continent africain connaissent une évolution qualitative. 

Délaissant les armes légères qui ont dominé pendant des décennies – véhicules blindés de transport de troupes et artillerie – , Pékin propose de plus en plus de systèmes spécialisés aux armées des États africains : drones de combat , systèmes de défense aérienne et équipements de guerre électronique .

Selon la presse chinoise, ce changement est particulièrement visible au Sahel, région où le Mali et le Burkina Faso, suite à la fin de leur coopération en matière de défense avec la France et aux restrictions imposées à l'aide américaine à la sécurité, recherchent de nouveaux fournisseurs d'armements. 
La Russie est l'un des principaux. La Chine s'y joint désormais.

La Russie a récemment livré à l'Éthiopie un lot d'avions de chasse Su-35SE à haute manœuvrabilité, permettant ainsi à ce pays de devenir l'une des forces aériennes les plus performantes d'Afrique.

En avril, quatre véhicules ont été repérés dans un convoi militaire au Mali. Le groupe de recherche Janes les a identifiés comme étant des systèmes de défense aérienne chinois Yitian-L. Cinq mois plus tard, l'administration présidentielle du Burkina Faso a diffusé des images de ces équipements en phase de test, identifiant le radar mobile et son lanceur comme une variante du système chinois Sky Dragon, produit par l'entreprise publique Norinco.

Outre ces fonds , le Burkina Faso a reçu de Chine, entre 2024 et 2025, des véhicules blindés et de l'artillerie, notamment des véhicules d'appui-feu VN22B et WMA301, des véhicules blindés de transport de troupes WZ-551, des lance-roquettes multiples SR5 et des mortiers automoteurs PLL-05.

L'exemple le plus frappant de l'évolution qualitative des livraisons concerne les drones d'attaque. En août, la Côte d'Ivoire a fait la démonstration de ceux reçus de Chine. Le drone Wing Loong II a été livré dans le cadre d'un contrat signé en juin 2024 avec l'exportateur aéronautique public CATIC. Le Nigéria est ainsi devenu le premier pays d'Afrique de l'Ouest à recevoir ces drones : un premier lot de quatre appareils (sur huit commandés) a été livré à l'armée de l'air nigériane.

Le Wing Loong II (WL-2), fabriqué par Chengdu Aircraft Industry Group, est un drone de moyenne altitude et longue endurance conçu pour des missions de reconnaissance, de surveillance et de frappe de précision. Long de 11 mètres et haut de 4,1 mètres, son envergure est de 20,5 mètres. Il peut voler à une altitude maximale de 9 000 mètres, atteindre une vitesse de pointe de 370 km/h et dispose d'une autonomie de plus de 20 heures (certaines sources évoquent jusqu'à 32 heures). Il peut emporter une charge utile de 480 kg, répartie sur six points d'emport externes.

Son équipement standard comprend des capteurs électro-optiques et infrarouges, un radar à synthèse d'ouverture et des systèmes de transmission de données en temps réel. Il peut également être armé de missiles guidés. Les missiles AR-1, les missiles antichars Blue Arrow 7, les bombes de précision de la série FT, ainsi que les bombes FT Luoyang et les missiles air-sol CASIC XM-50KG sont autant d'atouts dont bénéficient les États africains.

Selon les analystes, l'attrait des drones chinois pour les États africains ne se limite pas à leur prix : 
nombre de pays du continent peinent à se procurer des systèmes équivalents auprès des États-Unis ou de l'Europe, tandis que les fabricants chinois proposent une offre complète incluant la formation, la maintenance, le financement et une technologie toujours plus sophistiquée.

Outre le Mali, le Burkina Faso, la Côte d'Ivoire et le Nigéria, des drones chinois Wing Loong et CH-4 sont en service ou ont été acquis par l'Algérie (24 Wing Loong II et 10 CH-4), le Maroc, l'Égypte, la République démocratique du Congo et l'Éthiopie. 

Selon le portail sud-africain Defenceweb, plus de 400 drones chinois de différents types sont déployés sur le continent. L'Égypte aurait signé un contrat pour dix drones d'attaque à réaction WJ-700, d'une valeur d'environ 400 millions de dollars, ce qui en ferait le deuxième opérateur de ce système après l'Algérie.

Afin d'accompagner son expansion, Norinco a ouvert un bureau régional à Dakar, au Sénégal, et établi un centre de services conjoint dans l'État de Bauchi, au Nigéria, pour les réparations, les pièces détachées et le support technique.

https://x.com/sprex64/status/21168738075.title_zh: 2026年11月1日 中国向非洲大陆交付的武器装备呈现质的飞跃。
https://x.com/sprex64/status/21168738075.snippet_zh:
2026年11月1日

中国对非洲大陆的军备交付正在发生质的变化。

在数十年来占据主导地位的轻武器——装甲运兵车和火炮——之外，北京正越来越多地向非洲各国军队提供专业化装备：作战无人机、防空系统和电子战设备。

据中国媒体报道，这一变化在萨赫勒地区尤为明显。在马里和布基纳法索结束与法国的防务合作，并受到美国安全援助限制后，两国正在寻求新的军备供应商。
俄罗斯是主要供应商之一。中国如今也加入其中。

俄罗斯最近向埃塞俄比亚交付了一批具备高机动性能的苏-35SE战斗机，使该国得以成为非洲最强大的空中力量之一。

4月，马里一支军用车队中出现了4辆相关车辆。Janes研究机构将它们认定为中国-produced Yitian-L防空系统。5个月后，布基纳法索总统府发布了这些装备的测试照片，并确认该移动雷达及其发射车是国有Norinco企业生产的中国天龙系统的一个变型。

除了这些资金，布基纳法索还在2024年至2025年间从中国获得了装甲车辆和火炮，包括VN22B和WMA301火力支援车、WZ-551装甲运兵车、SR5多管火箭发射车以及PLL-05车载迫击炮。

军备交付质变最鲜明的例子是攻击无人机。8月，科特迪瓦展示了从中国接收的无人机。翼龙II是在2024年6月与国有航空出口商CATIC签署的合同框架下交付的。尼日利亚由此成为西非首个接收这类无人机的国家：首批4架无人机（共订购8架）已交付尼日利亚空军。

翼龙II（WL-2）由成都飞机工业集团制造，是一款中空长航时无人机，专为侦察、监视和精确打击任务设计。该机长11米、高4.1米，翼展20.5米，最大飞行高度可达9 000米，最高速度为370公里/小时，航程超过20小时（部分资料称最长可达32小时）。它可携带480千克有效载荷，配备6个外部挂点。

其标准设备包括光电和红外传感器、合成孔径雷达以及实时数据传输系统。它还可以挂载制导导弹。AR-1导弹、蓝箭7反坦克导弹、FT系列精确制导炸弹，以及FT洛阳炸弹和CASIC XM-50KG空对空导弹，都是非洲国家能够使用的优势装备。

分析人士认为，中国无人机吸引非洲国家的原因并不仅限于价格：
非洲大陆许多国家难以从美国或欧洲采购同等系统，而中国制造商提供的是一套完整方案，涵盖培训、维护、融资以及日益先进的技术。

除马里、布基纳法索、科特迪瓦和尼日利亚外，翼龙和CH-4中国无人机也已在阿尔及利亚（24架翼龙II和10架CH-4）、摩洛哥、埃及、刚果民主共和国和埃塞俄比亚服役或被采购。

据南非门户Defenceweb报道，已有400多架不同类型的中国无人机部署在非洲大陆。埃及据称已签署合同，采购10架喷气式WJ-700攻击无人机，合同金额约4亿美元，这将使其成为继阿尔及利亚之后该系统的第二个使用国。

为配合业务扩张，Norinco在塞内加尔达喀尔开设了区域办事处，并在尼日利亚包奇州设立了一个联合服务中心，提供维修、零部件和技术支持。

🚨 TRENDING TODAY: NPF 48HR OPERATIONAL SUCCESSES 🚨

Kindly find below the Top 15 State-by-State Executive Summary of @policeNG Operational Successes for the last 48 hours:

1. ZAMFARA STATE: POLICE ENGAGEMENT FORCES BANDITS TO ABANDON FIVE ABDUCTED WOMEN
✅ On 29/10/2026 at about 1230HRS, armed bandits attacked a farm in Dansadau, Maru LGA, shot dead a 35-year-old farmer, and abducted five elderly women harvesting beans.
✅ Police tactical teams and local vigilantes pursued the assailants and engaged them in a gun duel, forcing the bandits to abandon all five captives and flee.
✅ All five abducted women were rescued unhurt, while sustained bush-combing and tracking operations continue to apprehend the perpetrators.
🔹 Status: SCID Gusau Investigating.

2. NIGER STATE: JOINT RESCUE OPERATION FREES SIX ABDUCTED FARMERS
✅ On 29/10/2026, police, military, DSS, special hunters and local vigilantes traced armed bandits to their hideout in Rafi LGA.
✅ The coordinated operation successfully rescued six victims abducted while working on their farms at Mahangi Village via Pandogari.
✅ The rescued victims were received at the Division for profiling ahead of reunion with their relatives.
🔹 Status: SCID Minna Investigating.

3. KEBBI STATE: JOINT SECURITY FORCES THWART LAKURAWA ATTACK ON RIBAH
✅ On 30/10/2026 at about 2015HRS, armed men suspected to be bandits attacked Ribah Town, Danko Wasagu LGA, after an earlier attempt to block Rambo Junction was thwarted by joint security forces.
✅ The attackers regrouped and opened fire from different directions, prompting joint forces to engage them and repel the attack.
🔹 Status: SCID Birnin Kebbi Investigating.

4. KANO STATE: POLICE ARREST FIVE SUSPECTS, RECOVER 48 COWS, 43 SHEEP AND TWO MOTORCYCLES
✅ Police Anti-Kidnapping Squad operatives stormed the residence of suspects linked to the kidnapping of Alh. Abdu Fanka, APC Chairman of Rogo LGA.
✅ Although the primary suspects escaped after raising an alarm, operatives arrested five persons suspected of harbouring criminals.
✅ Police recovered 48 cows, 43 sheep and two Bajaj Boxer motorcycles during the operation.
🔹 Status: SCID Bompai Investigating.

5. KATSINA STATE: POLICE FOIL ARMED BANDITS' ATTACK ON KAROFI VILLAGE
✅ On 29/10/2026 at about 2327HRS, tactical teams responded to a distress call concerning an attempted bandit attack on Karofi Village, Dutsin-Ma LGA.
✅ Police operatives intercepted the hoodlums and engaged them in a gun duel, forcing the attackers to abandon their mission and retreat into the bush.
✅ No casualty was recorded among security personnel or civilians, while combined patrols and bush-combing operations continue.
🔹 Status: SCID Katsina Investigating.

6. LAGOS STATE: POLICE ARREST CULTIST SUSPECT AFTER ARMED ROBBERY/MURDER, RECOVER FIREARM
✅ On 31/10/2026 at about 1130HRS, police operatives responded swiftly to an ongoing robbery at Desa Bus Stop, Ibeju-Lekki.
✅ Operatives arrested Ojo/Ojomu Bolanle, 28, aka “Burna”, a suspected Aiye confraternity member, following the shooting of POS operator Ibrahim Adewale Moronfade, who later died.
✅ A search led to the recovery of one locally-made pistol, one expended cartridge and charms, while the stolen handbag and other property were traced to the robbery.
🔹 Status: SCID Panti Investigating.

CSP ANI INIEDU, anipr

https://x.com/cspiniedu/status/211678928.snippet_zh:
🚨 今日热议：尼日利亚警察部队过去48小时行动成果 🚨

请查阅以下 @policeNG 过去48小时各州行动成果前15名行政长官摘要：

1. 扎姆法拉州：警察协同地方治安人员迫使绑架团伙遗弃5名被绑架妇女
✅ 2026年10月29日约12时30分，武装绑架团伙袭击马鲁地方政府辖区 Dansadau 的一座农场，枪杀一名35岁农民，并绑架5名正在收获豆子的老年妇女。
✅ 警察战术小队和地方治安人员追击袭击者，与其发生枪战，迫使绑架团伙遗弃全部5名人质并逃离。
✅ 5名被绑架妇女均已安全获救，警方仍在持续开展林地搜捕和追踪行动，以缉拿案犯。
🔹 状态：古绍州州安全调查局正在调查。

2. 尼杰尔州：联合救援行动解救6名被绑架农民
✅ 2026年10月29日，警察、军方、国家安全局、专业猎手和地方治安人员追踪武装绑架团伙至拉菲地方政府辖区的藏身点。
✅ 联合行动成功解救了6名受害者；他们是在经潘多加里前往马汉吉村务农时被绑架的。
✅ 获救人员已被送往分局登记身份信息，随后将与亲属团聚。
🔹 状态：米纳州州安全调查局正在调查。

3. 凯比州：联合安全部队挫败武装分子对里巴的袭击
✅ 2026年10月30日约20时15分，疑似绑架团伙的武装人员袭击丹科·瓦萨古地方政府辖区里巴镇；此前，联合安全部队挫败了他们封锁兰博路口的企图。
✅ 袭击者重新集结并从不同方向开火，联合部队随即与其交火，击退此次袭击。
🔹 状态：比尔宁凯比州州安全调查局正在调查。

4. 卡诺州：警察逮捕5名嫌疑人，追回48头牛、43只羊和2辆摩托车
✅ 警察反绑架特遣队突袭涉嫌参与绑架罗戈地方政府辖区全州人民大会党主席 Alh. Abdu Fanka 的嫌疑住处。
✅ 尽管主要嫌疑人在发出警报后逃脱，特遣队仍逮捕了5名涉嫌窝藏罪犯的人员。
✅ 警方在行动中追回48头牛、43只羊和2辆 Bajaj Boxer 摩托车。
🔹 状态：邦派州州安全调查局正在调查。

5. 卡钦纳州：警察挫败武装绑架团伙对卡罗菲村的袭击
✅ 2026年10月29日约23时27分，战术小队接到求救警报，赶往杜钦马地方政府辖区卡罗菲村，处理武装绑架团伙企图袭击该村的事件。
✅ 警员截住歹徒并与其发生枪战，迫使袭击者放弃行动并逃入林地。
✅ 安全人员和平民均无人伤亡，联合巡逻和林地搜捕行动仍在持续。
🔹 状态：卡钦纳州州安全调查局正在调查。

6. 拉各斯州：警察在武装抢劫和谋杀案后逮捕邪教嫌疑人，并追回枪支
✅ 2026年10月31日约11时30分，警员迅速赶赴伊贝朱-莱基 Desa 公交站，处理一起正在发生的抢劫案。
✅ POS 运营商 Ibrahim Adewale Moronfade 遭枪击后伤重身亡，警员随后逮捕28岁的 Ojo/Ojomu Bolanle，又名“Burna”；此人涉嫌是“艾耶”兄弟会成员。
✅ 搜查行动中追回1支本地制造的手枪、1枚弹壳和护身符；警方还追查了抢劫案中失窃的手提包及其他财物。
🔹 状态：潘蒂州州安全调查局正在调查。

https://x.com/naijatruths/status/2116767.snippet:
OPay’s $19 US IPO Faces Setback as US Investors Question Valuation, Nigerians Compare Dangote’s Share Offer

OPay’s planned $304 million initial public offering (IPO) in the United States has suffered a major setback after indications emerged that investors were unwilling to meet its proposed $19-per-share price.

The Chinese-backed Nigerian fintech company had planned to offer approximately 16 million American Depositary Shares (ADSs) on the New York Stock Exchange, allowing American investors to acquire stakes without directly accessing Nigeria’s stock market.

However, reports indicated that prospective investors were offering between $16.25 and $16.75 per share, considerably below the proposed $19 price.

OPay subsequently suspended the offering, citing an outstanding regulatory inquiry in an undisclosed foreign jurisdiction.

The development has triggered discussions among Nigerians, with many comparing OPay’s proposed dollar-denominated share offer with Dangote Refinery’s share offering in Nigeria.

While Dangote's shares were offered at ₦525 each, OPay's proposed $19 price translated to approximately ₦25,650 at an exchange rate of ₦1,350 to the dollar.

Some commentators have questioned whether OPay overestimated its valuation by targeting American investors instead of testing demand in its home market.

The setback has also reignited conversations about corporate valuation, investor confidence and the importance of understanding market expectations before launching a public offering.

OPay has not confirmed that pricing concerns caused the suspension.

https://x.com/naijatruths/status/2116767.snippet_zh:
OPay拟以19美元在美国上市遇挫，美国投资者质疑其估值，尼日利亚人则拿其与Dangote的股份发行作比较

OPay计划在美国进行的3.04亿美元首次公开募股（IPO）遭遇重大挫折。有迹象显示，投资者不愿接受其拟定的每股19美元发行价。

这家获得中国支持的尼日利亚金融科技公司原计划在纽约证券交易所发行约1600万股美国存托股份（ADS），使美国投资者无需直接进入尼日利亚股市即可购买股份。

不过，报道显示有意投资者愿意出的价格介于每股16.25美元至16.75美元之间，明显低于拟定的19美元。

随后，OPay暂停了发行，并称未公开的外国司法管辖区正在进行一项尚未结束的监管调查。

这一进展引发了尼日利亚人的讨论，许多人将OPay拟议的美元计价股份发行方案与Dangote Refinery在尼日利亚的股份发行进行比较。

Dangote的股份发行价为每股₦525，而OPay拟定的每股19美元按₦1,350兑1美元的汇率计算，约合₦25,650。

一些评论者质疑，OPay是否高估了自身估值，没有先在本国市场检验需求，反而将美国投资者作为目标。

此次遇挫还再次引发了关于企业估值、投资者信心，以及在启动公开发行前了解市场预期的重要性的讨论。

OPay尚未证实定价疑虑是导致暂停发行的原因。

https://x.com/elmercurioaon/status/21165.snippet:
🇨🇳 China consigue un descuento del 56 % en el Gas ruso mientras Moscú pierde poder de gegociación y Pekín impone sus condiciones 👇

Según proyecciones del gobierno ruso citadas por The Moscow Times, China pagará en 2026 unos 248 dólares por mil metros cúbicos de gas por gasoducto, frente a los 562 dólares que Gazprom cobra a otros clientes extranjeros fuera de la antigua Unión Soviética. 

Eso equivale a un descuento de aproximadamente el 56 %. 

El precio rebajado se interpreta como el coste del apoyo político de Pekín a la guerra de Rusia en Ucrania, en un contexto en el que las sanciones occidentales y la pérdida del mercado europeo han dejado a Gazprom con grandes reservas de gas en Siberia sin compradores claros.

Las conversaciones sobre el gasoducto Power of Siberia 2 siguen estancadas por diferencias de precio, y China llega a pagar más a Turkmenistán que a Rusia. 

Mientras tanto, Pekín avanza con inversiones en cobre, puertos, energía y conectividad digital en Asia Central, reforzando su influencia regional y aprovechando la posición debilitada de Moscú tanto en el sector energético como en el conjunto de la región.

https://x.com/sahelalerte/status/2116510.snippet:
🔴 MALI 🇲🇱 | 💥 SIKASSO FRAPPÉE DEUX FOIS EN TROIS JOURS : LE JNIM INSTALLE LA GUERRE DES AXES JUSQU'AU SUD DU PAYS

Entre le 23 et le 30 octobre 2026, sept incidents distincts ont visé les FAMa et leurs partenaires d'Africa Corps. Le 23 : embuscade du JNIM contre une patrouille à Sikasso, dans la soirée. Le 24 : embuscade contre une patrouille à Diabaly. Le 25 : attaque à l'engin explosif improvisé contre un convoi entre Héremakono et Sikasso. Le 28 : attaque à l'IED du JNIM contre un poste de l'armée à Nampala. Le 29 : IED contre un véhicule FAMa et Africa Corps entre Mourdiah et Kwala, et revendication du FLA contre le camp FAMa et Africa Corps de Léré, dans la région de Tombouctou. Le 30 : IED contre un véhicule des FAMa entre Zangossou et Bourasso. [1]

Trois constats ressortent de cette séquence. Le premier est le mode opératoire : quatre incidents sur sept sont des attaques à l'IED, deux sont des embuscades, un est une revendication d'attaque de camp. Le JNIM et le FLA frappent ici les déplacements, bien plus que les garnisons. Le deuxième est la géographie. Sikasso est touché deux fois en trois jours (23 et 25 octobre), alors que le sud du Mali restait à l'écart des principaux fronts. Les autres incidents se répartissent entre le centre-ouest (Diabaly, Nampala, Mourdiah-Kwala) et le nord-ouest (Léré). Le troisième est la présence de deux acteurs : le JNIM est mis en cause pour Sikasso et Nampala, le FLA revendique Léré, un mois après le repli de Kidal.

Les sources ne donnent aucun bilan humain pour ces sept incidents. Ce vide a lui-même un sens : après Dioura, Sévaré et le silence de l'État-Major sur ses pertes, l'absence de chiffres ne permet pas de conclure à l'absence de victimes. Pour les familles des soldats, les convois se déplacent désormais sur des axes où chaque trajet comporte un risque d'IED. L'État-Major avait annoncé, après Kidal, la reprise du contrôle du nord. Ces incidents montrent que la route entre les villes reste, elle, contestée.

Par Djabire Marwan Ouédraogo | Dans l'œil de DMO©

🔴 马里 🇲🇱 | 💥 锡卡索三天内两遭袭击：JNIM将战火延伸至该国南部

2026年10月23日至30日，FAMa及其Africa Corps伙伴共遭7起不同事件。23日晚，JNIM在锡卡索伏击了一支巡逻队。24日，JNIM在迪亚巴利伏击了一支巡逻队。25日，袭击者在赫雷马科诺与锡卡索之间用简易爆炸装置袭击了一支车队。28日，JNIM用简易爆炸装置袭击了南帕拉一处军营。29日，袭击者在穆尔迪亚与夸拉之间用简易爆炸装置袭击了一辆FAMa和Africa Corps车辆；FLA还宣称袭击了位于通布图地区的莱雷FAMa和Africa Corps营地。30日，袭击者在赞戈苏与布拉索之间用简易爆炸装置袭击了一辆FAMa车辆。[1]

这一系列事件呈现出三个特点。第一是作案方式：7起事件中有4起属于简易爆炸装置袭击，2起是伏击，另有1起是针对军营袭击的宣称。JNIM和FLA在这里主要打击的是人员移动，而非驻军。第二是地理分布。锡卡索在三天内两遭袭击，分别发生在10月23日和25日，而此前马里南部一直远离主要战线。其余事件分布在中西部（迪亚巴利、南帕拉、穆尔迪亚—夸拉）和西北部（莱雷）。第三是出现了两个行为主体：锡卡索和南帕拉事件均指向JNIM，FLA则宣称制造了莱雷事件，而此时距基达尔撤离仅一个月。

消息人士没有提供这7起事件造成的人员伤亡数字。这一空白本身也说明问题：在迪乌拉、塞瓦雷事件以及总参谋部对自身损失保持沉默之后，没有伤亡数字并不能得出无人遇袭遇难的结论。对士兵家属而言，车队如今行驶的路线上，每一段行程都面临简易爆炸装置威胁。总参谋部曾在基达尔事件后宣布重新控制该国北部。这些事件显示，城市之间的道路仍处于争夺之中。

作者：Djabire Marwan Ouédraogo | 载于DMO©
